Q82154

According to a state law, state employees may be fired only "for good cause." A woman who was both a resident and an employee of the state was summarily fired on the sole ground that she had notified federal officials that the state was not following federal rules governing the administration of certain federally funded state programs on which she worked. The state denied the woman's request for a hearing to allow her to contest the charge. There is no record of any other state employee having been terminated for this reason.

In a suit to reinstate her employment, which of the following claims provides the LEAST support for the woman?

根据州法律，州雇员只有在“有正当理由”的情况下才能被解雇。一名既是该州居民又是该州雇员的女性，仅因其通知联邦官员该州未遵守管理其所从事的某些联邦资助的州项目的联邦规定，而被立即解雇。该州拒绝了该女性提出的举行听证会以反驳指控的请求。没有记录显示有其他州雇员因此原因被解雇。

在要求恢复其雇佣关系的诉讼中，以下哪项主张为该女性提供的支持最少？
options:
A. The state's firing of her unconstitutionally abridged her freedom of speech.
该州解雇她的行为违宪地剥夺了她的言论自由。

B. The state's firing of her unconstitutionally denied her a privilege or immunity of state citizenship protected by Article IV.
该州解雇她的行为违宪地剥夺了她受 Article IV 保护的州公民身份所享有的特权或豁免权。

C. The state's firing of her violated the supremacy clause of Article VI, because it interfered with the enforcement of federal rules.
该州解雇她的行为违反了 Article VI 的至上条款，因为它干扰了联邦法规的执行。

D. The state's firing of her without affording her an opportunity for a hearing was an unconstitutional denial of procedural due process.
该州在未给予她听证会机会的情况下解雇她的行为，构成了对程序性正当程序的违宪剥夺。
data.explanation:
Privileges & immunities clauses


ProvisionApplicability
Article IVDiscrimination against citizens of other states Interference with right of state citizenship
Fourteenth AmendmentInterference with right of national citizenship
The Article IV privileges and immunities clause prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states by denying them a right of state citizenship. But this clause does not apply here since (1) the woman is a resident (ie, citizen) of the state that fired her and (2) public employment is not a right of state citizenship. Therefore, this clause provides the least support for the woman in a suit to reinstate her employment.

(Choice A) The state fired the woman solely because she notified federal officials that the state was not complying with federal rules. As a result, that firing may have unconstitutionally abridged her right to free speech as a public employee.

(Choice C) The Article VI supremacy clause renders state action void when federal law preempts it - eg, when state action interferes with the achievement of federal objectives. Here, the state's firing of the woman for notifying federal officials that the state was not following federal rules likely interfered with the enforcement of those rules in violation of the supremacy clause.

(Choice D) The Fourteenth Amendment right to procedural due process requires states to give persons notice and a meaningful opportunity to be heard when depriving them of life, liberty, or property. And public employees who can only be fired for cause - like the woman - have a property interest in their jobs. Therefore, it was an unconstitutional denial of procedural due process to fire her without giving her an opportunity for a hearing.

Educational objective: The Article IV privileges and immunities clause prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states by denying them a right of state citizenship.

选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 62%（正确选项），C选项 21%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

特权与豁免权条款


条款适用性
Article IV歧视其他州的公民
干涉州公民身份的权利
Fourteenth Amendment干涉国家公民身份的权利
Article IV 的特权与豁免权条款禁止各州通过剥夺其他州公民的州公民身份权利来歧视他们。但该条款在此不适用，因为 (1) 该女性是解雇她的州的居民（即公民），以及 (2) 公职并非州公民身份的一项权利。因此，在要求恢复其雇佣关系的诉讼中，该条款为该女性提供的支持最少。

(选项 A) 该州解雇该女性的唯一原因是她通知联邦官员该州未遵守联邦法规。因此，该解雇行为可能违宪地剥夺了她作为公职人员的言论自由权。

(选项 C) 当联邦法律优先适用时——例如，当州的行为干扰了联邦目标的实现时——Article VI 的至上条款会使州的行为无效。在此案中，该州因该女性通知联邦官员其未遵守联邦法规而将其解雇，此行为可能干扰了这些法规的执行，从而违反了至上条款。

(选项 D) Fourteenth Amendment 规定的程序性正当程序权利要求各州在剥夺个人生命、自由或财产时，必须给予其通知和有意义的听证机会。而只能因故被解雇的公职人员——如此案中的女性——在其工作中拥有财产权益。因此，在未给予她听证机会的情况下解雇她，是对程序性正当程序的违宪剥夺。

教学目标：Article IV 的特权与豁免权条款禁止各州通过剥夺其他州公民的州公民身份权利来歧视他们。

References

Paul v. Virginia, 75 U.S. 168, 180 (1869) (holding that the Article IV privileges and immunities clause only applies when a state discriminates against citizens of other states).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

宪法：个人权利 (Individual Rights)
正确答案：选项 B 题目要求选出支持力度最小 (LEAST support) 的主张。选项 B 关于 Article IV 特权与豁免权条款的主张在法律上完全站不住脚，因此是正确答案。
核心考点：Article IV 特权与豁免权

Article IV Privileges and Immunities Clause（也称为 Comity Clause）的核心规则是：

  • 禁止歧视外州人： 禁止各州在基本权利或重要经济活动上，歧视其他州的公民 (Citizens of other states)。
  • 适用前提： 原告必须是非居民 (Non-resident)。

为什么选项 B 支持力度最小？

法律依据不足

在本案中，原告不仅是该州的雇员，更是该州的居民 (Resident)。

Article IV 的特权与豁免权条款旨在保护“外地人”免受“本地人”的歧视。既然原告是本州居民，该条款根本不适用 (Inapplicable)。她不能起诉自己的州违反了保护外州人的条款。

因此，这项主张在法律上是死胡同，提供的支持最少。

为什么其他选项是有力支持？

题目问的是“最少支持”，意味着其他三个选项在法律上都是站得住脚的（即如果作为原告律师，你会优先使用这些论点）。

选项 A：言论自由

Free Speech

公职人员 (Public Employee) 就公共利益 (Public Concern) 发表言论受第一修正案保护。揭发政府滥用联邦资金显然涉及公共利益。因此，因言获罪构成违宪。

选项 C：至上条款

Supremacy Clause

如果州政府因雇员遵守或报告联邦规则而将其解雇，这种行为会阻碍联邦法律的执行 (Obstacle to the execution of federal law)。根据至上条款，联邦法优于州法/州行为，因此该解雇行为可能无效。

选项 D：程序性正当程序

Procedural Due Process

这是最强的论点之一：

  1. 财产权益 (Property Interest)： 法律规定只能“因正当理由” (For good cause) 解雇，这赋予了雇员对自己职位的财产权益。
  2. 正当程序： 剥夺财产权益前，必须给予通知 (Notice) 和听证机会 (Hearing)。
本案中，州政府拒绝给予听证机会，直接违反了第十四修正案的正当程序条款。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

1. 警惕 "LEAST Support" 题型： 这类题目实际上是在找“错误”或“无关”的法律理论。你需要找出那个在给定的事实模式下完全无法适用的选项。

2. 区分两个 P&I 条款：

  • Article IV P&I: 保护外州人不受歧视（常考）。
  • 14th Amendment P&I: 保护国家公民权利（如跨州迁徙权），极少适用（除了 Saenz v. Roe 等少数判例），通常是错误选项的陪跑员。

口诀： 本州人告本州，不用 Article IV。

questions.question:
Several public high school students asked the superintendent of their public school district whether the minister of a local church could deliver an interdenominational prayer at their graduation ceremony in the school auditorium. None of the students or their guests at graduation would be required to pray while the minister delivered the prayer.
Would the minister's delivery of such a prayer at the public high school graduation be constitutional?

choices.a: No, because it would be an unconstitutional establishment of religion.
choices.b: No, because it would deny attendees who are not members of the minister's denomination the right to freely exercise their religion.
choices.c: Yes, because none of the students or their guests would be required to pray at the graduation ceremony.
choices.d: Yes, because the idea for the prayer originated with the students and not with school officials.

几名公立高中的学生询问其学区负责人，一名当地教堂的牧师是否可以在学校礼堂举行的毕业典礼上进行跨教派的祈祷。在牧师祈祷时，毕业典礼上的学生或其宾客均不被要求一同祈祷。

在公立高中的毕业典礼上，由牧师进行这样的祈祷是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because it would be an unconstitutional establishment of religion.
不合宪，因为这将构成违宪的国教确立。

B. No, because it would deny attendees who are not members of the minister's denomination the right to freely exercise their religion.
不合宪，因为这将剥夺那些非该牧师所属教派成员的与会者自由信奉其宗教的权利。

C. Yes, because none of the students or their guests would be required to pray at the graduation ceremony.
合宪，因为毕业典礼上的学生或其宾客均不被要求进行祈祷。

D. Yes, because the idea for the prayer originated with the students and not with school officials.
合宪，因为祈祷的想法源于学生，而非学校官员。
data.explanation:
Establishment clause tests


TestRequirementsApplicability
Historical†
  • Longstanding tradition &
    historical foundation
Default
Endorsement
  • No appearance that government endorses religion
Public displays or monuments
(eg, holiday displays)
Coercion
  • No forced conformity with
    religious belief or practice
Public schools (eg, convocation prayer)
Courts may apply strict scrutiny if government directly benefits/burdens religion.

The First Amendment establishment clause prohibits the government from expressing a religious preference or otherwise violating the separation of church and state. In Lee v. Weisman, the Supreme Court held that school-sponsored prayer must be reviewed under the coercion test, which considers whether the government forced participation in a religious exercise.

Since elementary and secondary school students are more susceptible to social and peer pressure than adults, school-sponsored prayer in these public schools is inherently coercive—even when participation is voluntary (Choice C). As a result, the minister's delivery of a prayer at the public high school graduation would be an unconstitutional establishment of religion.

(Choice B) Since participation would be voluntary, the minister's prayer would not deny attendees the right to freely exercise their own religion. But the prayer would still violate the establishment clause—despite being interdenominational—because it would show government preference for religion in general.

(Choice D) Although the graduation prayer was the students' idea, the school still must abide by the Constitution if it approves that idea and sponsors the prayer.

Educational objective:
Under the coercion test, school-sponsored prayer in public schools violates the establishment clause even when participation is voluntary.

政教分离条款测试


测试要求适用性
历史测试†
  • 长期的传统与
    历史基础
默认
认可测试
  • 政府没有表现出
    认可宗教的迹象
公共展示或纪念碑
（如节日装饰）
胁迫测试
  • 没有强迫遵从
    宗教信仰或实践
公立学校（如集会祈祷）
如果政府直接有益于或加重宗教负担，法院可适用严格审查。

第一修正案的国教条款（establishment clause）禁止政府表达宗教偏好或以其他方式违反政教分离原则。在 Lee v. Weisman 案中，最高法院裁定，由学校发起的祈祷必须依据胁迫测试（coercion test）进行审查，该标准考量政府是否强迫参与宗教活动。

由于中小学生比成年人更容易受到社会和同伴的压力，在这些公立学校中由校方发起的祈祷具有内在的胁迫性——即使参与是自愿的（选项C）。因此，在公立高中毕业典礼上由牧师进行祈祷，将构成违宪的国教确立。

（选项B）由于参与是自愿的，牧师的祈祷不会剥夺与会者自由信奉其宗教的权利。但该祈祷——尽管是跨教派的——仍然会违反国教条款，因为它显示了政府对所有宗教的普遍偏好。

（选项D）尽管毕业典礼上的祈祷是学生的想法，但如果学校批准了这一想法并发起了该祈祷，学校仍必须遵守宪法。

教学目标：
根据胁迫测试，在公立学校中由校方发起的祈祷，即使参与是自愿的，也违反了国教条款。

References

Lee v. Weisman, 505 U.S. 577, 592–93 (1992) (holding that an interdenominational prayer at middle school graduation ceremony coerces religious participation in violation of the establishment clause).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：个人权利 / 国教条款

✅ 正确答案：A

不合宪，因为这将构成违宪的国教确立 (Unconstitutional Establishment of Religion)。

⚖️ 法律依据：胁迫测试 (Coercion Test)

本题的核心考点在于宪法第一修正案的国教条款 (Establishment Clause) 在公立学校环境中的适用。

最高法院在处理公立学校祈祷问题时，主要适用胁迫测试 (Coercion Test)。该测试认为，政府不得强迫任何人支持或参与宗教活动。

📜 关键判例：Lee v. Weisman (1992)
最高法院裁定，在公立学校毕业典礼上邀请神职人员进行祈祷是违宪的。

推理逻辑如下：

  • 环境的特殊性：中小学生比成年人更容易受到同伴压力 (Peer Pressure) 和社会压力。
  • 心理胁迫 (Psychological Coercion)：虽然学校声称“不要求一同祈祷”，但在毕业典礼这种重要场合，学生为了出席典礼，实际上被迫处于一种必须表现出尊重的宗教氛围中。
  • 实质上的强制：对于持不同信仰或无信仰的学生来说，如果不愿参与，他们唯一的选择就是缺席毕业典礼，这构成了实质上的强制参与。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B 错误：虽然祈祷可能让非信徒感到不适，但宪法禁止它的主要理由是政府确立 (Establishment) 了宗教，而不仅仅是阻碍了自由行使 (Free Exercise)。此外，自愿参与并未解决政府偏袒宗教的问题。
选项 C 错误：“自愿参与” (Voluntary) 在公立学校语境下是一个陷阱。根据 Lee v. Weisman，在学校组织的官方活动中，所谓的“自愿”往往带有内在的强制性。
选项 D 错误：即使想法源于学生，但只要学校官员（如学区负责人）批准、组织或发起了该活动，这就变成了“政府行为” (State Action)，必须受到宪法约束。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊

在处理 Establishment Clause 问题时，请注意区分场景：

  1. 公立学校 (Public Schools)：审查最严格。通常适用胁迫测试 (Coercion Test)。凡是学校发起、组织或背书的祈祷（如毕业典礼、球赛广播），即使名义上自愿，通常也违宪。
  2. 立法机构/成人环境：审查较宽松。通常适用历史传统测试 (Historical/Tradition Test)（如议会开场祈祷通常是合宪的）。
  3. 私人言论 vs. 政府言论：如果学生在午餐时私下祈祷，受 Free Exercise Clause 保护；如果是学校邀请牧师上台，受 Establishment Clause 禁止。

questions.question:
An environmental organization's stated mission is to support environmental causes. The organization's membership is generally open to the public, but its bylaws permit its officers to refuse membership to anyone who does not adhere to the organization's mission statement.
In a recent state administrative proceeding, the organization opposed plans to begin mining operations in the mountains surrounding a small town. Its opposition prevented the mine from being opened on schedule. In an effort to force the organization to withdraw its opposition, certain residents of the town attended a meeting of the organization and tried to become members, but the officers refused to admit them. The residents sued the organization, claiming that the refusal to admit them was discriminatory and violated a local ordinance that prohibits any organization from discriminating on the basis of an individual's political views. The organization responded that the ordinance is unconstitutional as applied to its membership decisions.
Are the residents likely to prevail in their claim?

choices.a: No, because the membership policies of a private organization are not state action.
choices.b: No, because the organization's right to freedom of association allows it to refuse to admit potential members who do not adhere to its mission statement.
choices.c: Yes, because the action of the officers in refusing to admit the residents as members violates equal protection of the laws.
choices.d: Yes, because the ordinance serves the compelling interest of protecting the residents' free speech rights.

data.questionStem:
Q82072

An environmental organization's stated mission is to support environmental causes. The organization's membership is generally open to the public, but its bylaws permit its officers to refuse membership to anyone who does not adhere to the organization's mission statement.

In a recent state administrative proceeding, the organization opposed plans to begin mining operations in the mountains surrounding a small town. Its opposition prevented the mine from being opened on schedule. In an effort to force the organization to withdraw its opposition, certain residents of the town attended a meeting of the organization and tried to become members, but the officers refused to admit them. The residents sued the organization, claiming that the refusal to admit them was discriminatory and violated a local ordinance that prohibits any organization from discriminating on the basis of an individual's political views. The organization responded that the ordinance is unconstitutional as applied to its membership decisions.

Are the residents likely to prevail in their claim?

一个环保组织的既定使命是支持环保事业。该组织的会员资格通常向公众开放，但其章程允许其管理人员拒绝任何不遵守该组织使命宣言的人成为会员。

在最近一次州行政程序中，该组织反对在一个小镇周围的山区开展采矿作业的计划。其反对意见使矿场未能按时开放。为了迫使该组织撤回其反对意见，该镇的某些居民参加了该组织的一次会议并试图成为会员，但其管理人员拒绝接纳他们。这些居民起诉了该组织，声称拒绝接纳他们的行为具有歧视性，并违反了一项禁止任何组织基于个人政治观点进行歧视的地方法令。该组织回应称，该法令适用于其会员资格决定是违宪的。

这些居民的诉求是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the membership policies of a private organization are not state action.
不会，因为私人组织的会员政策不属于州政府行为。

B. No, because the organization's right to freedom of association allows it to refuse to admit potential members who do not adhere to its mission statement.
不会，因为该组织的结社自由权允许其拒绝接纳不遵守其使命宣言的潜在会员。

C. Yes, because the action of the officers in refusing to admit the residents as members violates equal protection of the laws.
会，因为该组织管理人员拒绝接纳这些居民为会员的行为违反了法律的平等保护原则。

D. Yes, because the ordinance serves the compelling interest of protecting the residents' free speech rights.
会，因为该法令服务于保护居民言论自由权的迫切利益。
data.explanation:
Freedom of association


General ruleInfringing upon right to associate barred unless: necessary to achieve compelling interest
SubversiveorganizationPunishing member of subversive organization permitted if person: is active member knows of organization's illegal objectives and specifically intends to further them
Loyalty oathRequiring loyalty oath for public employment permitted unless: overbroad - infringes on constitutionally protected behavior or vague - reasonable person would not understand oath
Forced inclusionInterfering with organization's discriminatory policy barred unless: no significant burden on organization's mission and necessary to achieve compelling interest
Electoral processImposing restriction on electoral process: ordinary - permitted if rationally related to legitimate interest severe - barred unless necessary to achieve compelling interest
The First Amendment freedom of association allows persons to form groups to express certain viewpoints. The government interferes with this right when it forces a group to accept members who would significantly burden the group's ability to express its views or carry out its mission - eg, forced inclusion of a homophobe in a gay-rights organization. Such interference is only justified if it is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest unrelated to the suppression of ideas.

Here, residents allege that an environmental organization violated an ordinance prohibiting political-viewpoint discrimination when the organization refused to admit them. But the ordinance is unconstitutional as applied to the organization because it significantly burdens the organization's right to oppose the mining operation. And the ordinance is not necessary to achieve the government's compelling interest in protecting free speech (Choice D). Therefore, the residents' claim against the organization will likely fail.

(Choice A) The Constitution - excluding the Thirteenth Amendment - only applies to state (ie, government) action. Since private organizations are not state actors, their membership policies need not comply with the Constitution. But since the ordinance under which the residents sued is state action, the ordinance must respect the organization's constitutional rights - including its freedom of association.

(Choice C) Since the environmental organization is a private (not state) actor, its conduct is not subject to the Fourteenth Amendment's guarantee that individuals will be afforded the equal protection of the laws.

Educational objective: Under the First Amendment freedom of association, the government cannot force a group to accept members who would significantly burden its views unless that interference is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 43%，B选项 54%（正确选项），C选项 0%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

结社自由


一般规则侵犯结社权被禁止，除非：为实现迫切利益所必需
颠覆性组织惩罚颠覆性组织的成员被允许，如果此人：是活跃成员，知晓该组织的非法目标，并且有具体意图去推进这些目标
忠诚宣誓要求公职人员进行忠诚宣誓被允许，除非：过于宽泛 - 侵犯了宪法保护的行为或含糊不清 - 一个理性人无法理解该誓言
强制接纳干涉组织的歧视性政策被禁止，除非：不会对组织的使命构成重大负担并且为实现迫切利益所必需
选举程序对选举程序施加限制：普通限制 - 被允许，如果与合法利益有合理关联；严重限制 - 被禁止，除非为实现迫切利益所必需
《第一修正案》的结社自由权允许个人组成团体以表达某些观点。当政府强迫一个团体接纳那些会严重妨碍该团体表达其观点或执行其使命能力的成员时，就干涉了这项权利——例如，强迫一个同性恋权利组织接纳一个恐同者。只有当这种干涉对于实现与压制思想无关的迫切政府利益是必要的时，它才是正当的。

在本案中，居民声称一个环保组织在拒绝接纳他们时，违反了一项禁止政治观点歧视的法令。但是，该法令适用于该组织是违宪的，因为它严重妨碍了该组织反对采矿作业的权利。并且，该法令对于实现政府保护言论自由的迫切利益并非必要（选项D）。因此，居民对该组织的诉求很可能会失败。

（选项A） 宪法——除《Thirteenth Amendment》外——仅适用于州政府（即政府）行为。由于私人组织不是州政府行为体，其会员政策无需遵守宪法。但由于居民据以起诉的法令是州政府行为，该法令必须尊重该组织的宪法权利——包括其结社自由权。

（选项C） 由于该环保组织是一个私人（而非州政府）行为体，其行为不受《Fourteenth Amendment》关于个人应获得法律平等保护的保障的约束。

教学目标：根据《First Amendment》的结社自由权，政府不能强迫一个团体接纳会严重妨碍其观点的成员，除非这种干涉对于实现迫切的政府利益是必要的。

References

Boy Scouts of Am. v. Dale, 530 U.S. 640, 659 (2000) (striking down a state law requiring the Boy Scouts to retain a homosexual scoutmaster since his presence seriously impacted the group's ability to advocate viewpoints).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：结社自由 vs. 反歧视条例

核心考点：表达性结社自由
本题考察的是美国宪法第一修正案中的结社自由 (Freedom of Association)。
规则 (Rule):
政府不能强迫一个私人团体接纳那些会严重损害 (Significantly Burden) 该团体表达其观点或执行其使命能力的成员。
这被称为表达性结社 (Expressive Association)。如果强迫接纳某些成员会稀释或改变该团体想要传达的信息，那么该团体的第一修正案权利通常优先于反歧视法。
经典判例参考: Boy Scouts of America v. Dale (2000)
正确 选项 B 解析
为什么居民不会胜诉？
  • 组织的性质： 这是一个环保组织，其核心使命是支持环保事业（反对采矿）。
  • 冲突点： 试图加入的居民是支持采矿的（为了迫使组织撤回反对意见）。
  • 法律适用： 如果政府（通过执行反歧视条例）强迫该组织接纳这些意图破坏其使命的居民，将直接破坏该组织的言论表达能力。
因此，该组织有权依据Freedom of Association拒绝接纳不认同其核心使命的成员。地方法令在此处若强制执行则违宪。
易错项辨析
A 错误原因：州政府行为 (State Action)
虽然私人组织本身不是州政府行为体，但本案中居民依据的是一项地方法令 (Local Ordinance) 并通过法院起诉。法院执行该法令的行为构成了“州政府行为”。因此，宪法是适用的（作为组织的防御手段），不能简单地说“因为是私人组织所以宪法不适用”。
C 错误原因：平等保护 (Equal Protection)
第十四修正案的平等保护条款仅限制政府行为，不限制私人行为。该环保组织是私人实体，其歧视行为不直接违反第十四修正案。
D 错误原因：迫切利益 (Compelling Interest)
虽然消除歧视通常是政府的重要利益，但在这种情况下（强迫接纳政治对手进入倡导团体），政府并没有“迫切利益”去牺牲该团体的第一修正案权利。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 宪法题中，遇到“私人团体拒绝接纳成员” vs “反歧视法” 的冲突时：
  1. 判断该团体是否有明确的表达性目的 (Expressive Purpose)。
  2. 判断强迫接纳该成员是否会破坏这一目的。
如果答案是肯定的，结社自由 (Freedom of Association) 通常会胜出。
© MBE 备考助手 | 宪法篇

questions.question:
A city ordinance prohibited individuals from picketing in residential neighborhoods unless the picketing related to the neighborhood zoning requirements. This exception to the ordinance was adopted in response to local citizens' strong views about proposed rezoning of residential neighborhoods.
A group that wished to picket in front of a business owner's home because of the business owner's employment practices challenged the ordinance as unconstitutional under the First Amendment.
Will the group's challenge likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because the ordinance is a content-neutral regulation of speech.
choices.b: No, because the ordinance regulates conduct rather than speech.
choices.c: Yes, because the ordinance irrationally discriminates between different types of protesters.
choices.d: Yes, because the ordinance is a content-based regulation of speech.

data.questionStem:
Q82128

A city ordinance prohibited individuals from picketing in residential neighborhoods unless the picketing related to the neighborhood zoning requirements. This exception to the ordinance was adopted in response to local citizens' strong views about proposed rezoning of residential neighborhoods.

A group that wished to picket in front of a business owner's home because of the business owner's employment practices challenged the ordinance as unconstitutional under the First Amendment.

Will the group's challenge likely prevail?

一项市政条例禁止个人在居民区进行纠察示威，除非该示威与社区的区划要求有关。条例的这项例外规定是为了回应当地居民对居民区拟议重新区划的强烈意见而通过的。

一个团体因某企业主的雇佣行为而希望在其家门前进行纠察示威，该团体以该条例违反《First Amendment》为由，质疑其合宪性。

该团体的质疑是否可能成功？
options:
A. No, because the ordinance is a content-neutral regulation of speech.
不会，因为该条例是一项内容中立的言论规制。

B. No, because the ordinance regulates conduct rather than speech.
不会，因为该条例规制的是行为而非言论。

C. Yes, because the ordinance irrationally discriminates between different types of protesters.
会，因为该条例不合理地歧视不同类型的抗议者。

D. Yes, because the ordinance is a content-based regulation of speech.
会，因为该条例是一项基于内容的言论规制。
data.explanation:
The First Amendment's preeminent task is to protect the free flow of ideas, so content-based restrictions on speech are presumptively unconstitutional and subject to strict scrutiny. As a result, the government can only regulate speech based on what is said (ie, its message or ideas) by showing that the regulation is necessary and narrowly tailored to achieve a compelling government interest - a nearly impossible task.

The ordinance here is a content-based regulation because it allows speech on one topic (neighborhood zoning requirements) but no other. And since it is highly unlikely that the ordinance can survive strict scrutiny, the group's challenge will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Unlike content-based restrictions (as seen here), content- neutral regulations are constitutional if they pass intermediate scrutiny - ie, the government proves that the regulation
  • is narrowly tailored to achieve an important or substantial government interest and
  • leaves open alternative channels of communication.
†

†Content-neutral restrictions that likely satisfy intermediate scrutiny include those penalizing trespasses on private property and prohibiting protests on streets during rush-hour traffic.

(Choice B) A person's conduct is protected by the First Amendment if it is expressive - ie,
  • the person intends to communicate a message and
  • the audience is likely to understand that message.
And since the ordinance unjustifiably restricts the expressive aspect of picketing, it is likely unconstitutional.

(Choice C) Had the ordinance regulated a nonpublic forum, rational basis scrutiny would require the group to show that the ordinance irrationally discriminates between different types of protesters. However, residential neighborhoods are public forums because they contain public streets and sidewalks.

Educational objective: Since content-based restrictions on speech are heavily disfavored, they are unconstitutional unless they survive strict scrutiny - ie, the government proves that the restriction is necessary and narrowly tailored to achieve a compelling government interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 7%，C选项 7%，D选项 77%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《First Amendment》的首要任务是保护思想的自由流动，因此对言论的基于内容的限制被推定为违宪，并须接受严格审查。因此，政府只有在证明该规制是为实现某项紧迫政府利益所必需且为狭义定制的情况下，才能根据言论所表达的内容（即其信息或思想）对言论进行规制——这几乎是一项不可能完成的任务。

本案中的条例是一项基于内容的规制，因为它只允许关于一个主题（社区区划要求）的言论，而禁止其他所有主题。并且，由于该条例极不可能通过严格审查，该团体的质疑很可能会成功。

(选项 A) 与基于内容的限制（如本案所示）不同，内容中立的规制如果通过中度审查，即为合宪——即，政府证明该规制
  • 是为实现重要或重大的政府利益而狭义定制的，并且
  • 留有其他可替代的沟通渠道。
†

†可能满足中度审查的内容中立限制包括：惩罚侵入私有财产的行为，以及禁止在交通高峰时段在街道上进行抗议。

(选项 B) 如果一个人的行为具有表达性，那么该行为受《First Amendment》保护——即，
  • 该人意图传达某一信息，并且
  • 受众有可能理解该信息。
并且，由于该条例不合理地限制了纠察示威的表达性方面，它很可能是违宪的。

(选项 C) 如果该条例规制的是一个非公共论坛，合理基础审查将要求该团体证明该条例不合理地歧视了不同类型的抗议者。然而，居民区是公共论坛，因为它们包含公共街道和人行道。

教学目标：由于基于内容的言论限制受到强烈质疑，它们是违宪的，除非能通过严格审查——即，政府证明该限制是为实现某项紧迫政府利益所必需且为狭义定制的。

References

United States v. Playboy Entm't Group, 529 U.S. 803, 816 - 17 (2000) (explaining that content-based restrictions on speech require the government to satisfy strict scrutiny).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: First Amendment
核心考点：基于内容的规制 (Content-Based Regulation) 当政府根据言论的主题或信息内容来限制言论时，这种限制被视为“基于内容的”。此类限制通常被推定为违宪。
1 识别论坛类型：
居民区的街道和人行道属于传统公共论坛 (Traditional Public Forum)。在这里，政府对言论的限制受到最严格的约束。
2 分析限制的性质：
本题中的条例禁止纠察示威，但例外允许涉及“区划要求” (zoning requirements) 的示威。

这意味着警察必须听示威者在说什么（内容），才能决定是否逮捕他们。如果谈论“区划”，合法；如果谈论“雇佣行为”，非法。这就是典型的基于内容的规制 (Content-Based Regulation)。
3 适用审查标准：
基于内容的言论规制必须通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。
  • 政府必须证明该限制是为实现紧迫的政府利益 (Compelling Government Interest)。
  • 且手段必须是狭义定制的 (Narrowly Tailored)。
这种标准极难满足，因此该条例极可能违宪。
⚖️ 经典判例：Carey v. Brown (1980) 美国最高法院曾推翻了一项类似的伊利诺伊州法规，该法规禁止在居民区进行纠察，但豁免了劳资纠纷的纠察。法院裁定，这种基于主题（Subject Matter）的区别对待违反了第一修正案。
✅ 正确答案：D
会胜诉，因为该条例是一项基于内容的言论规制。
❌ 选项 A (内容中立)：
如果条例禁止所有居民区纠察（无论主题如何），那才是内容中立的（如 Frisby v. Schultz 案）。本题中的“例外条款”破坏了中立性。
❌ 选项 B (行为 vs 言论)：
纠察 (Picketing) 被视为Expressive Conduct（表达性行为），受第一修正案保护。政府不能随意禁止。
❌ 选项 C (不合理歧视)：
虽然结论是对的（会胜诉），但理由中的标准太低。这里不仅仅是“不合理” (Irrational)，而是未能通过“严格审查”。选项 C 暗示的是合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)，这不适用于公共论坛的言论限制。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
看到言论限制题，先问自己：“警察需要听内容才能开罚单吗？”
  • 如果需要（如本题，需区分是谈区划还是谈雇佣），则是基于内容 ➔ 严格审查 ➔ 通常违宪。
  • 如果不需要（如“禁止在午夜后使用扩音器”），则是内容中立 ➔ 中度审查 (Intermediate Scrutiny)。

Congress enacted a statute authorizing the denial of all federal funding to public school districts in which a specified percentage of the students enrolled in the public schools fail to pass a national achievement test. According to the terms of the federal statute, the first national achievement test was scheduled for administration five years from the effective date of the statute.
After reviewing then-current levels of public school student performance, the officials of a state became concerned that several of its public school districts would lose their federal funding after the administration of the first national achievement test. Then-current levels of private school student performance were substantially higher.
In order to improve the chances of those school districts retaining their federal funding, the state recently enacted a law that requires all children of elementary and secondary school age to attend the schools operated by their respective local public school districts. The law is to take effect at the beginning of the next school year.
Parents of children enrolled in private schools within the state have filed suit to challenge the constitutionality of this state law.
Should the court uphold the law?

choices.a: No, because it is not necessary to further a compelling state interest.
choices.b: No, because it is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
choices.c: Yes, because it is necessary to further a compelling state interest.
choices.d: Yes, because it is rationally related to a legitimate state interest.

国会颁布了一项法规，授权对那些在全国性学业成绩测试中，有特定比例在册学生未能通过的公立学区，拒绝拨付所有联邦资金。

根据该联邦法规的条款，首次全国性学业成绩测试定于该法规生效之日起五年后举行。

在审查了当时公立学校学生的学业表现水平后，某州官员开始担忧，在首次全国性学业成绩测试举行后，其州内几个公立学区将会失去联邦资金。当时，私立学校学生的学业表现水平要高得多。

为了提高这些学区保留其联邦资金的机会，该州最近颁布了一项法律，要求所有中小学学龄儿童必须就读于其各自地方公立学区运营的学校。该法律将于下一学年开始时生效。

州内就读于私立学校的儿童的家长已经提起诉讼，以质疑该州法律的合宪性。

法院应否维持该法律？
options:
A. No, because it is not necessary to further a compelling state interest.
否，因为它并非为促进一项迫切的州利益所必需。

B. No, because it is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
否，因为它与一项合法的州利益没有理性关联。

C. Yes, because it is necessary to further a compelling state interest.
是，因为它是为促进一项迫切的州利益所必需的。

D. Yes, because it is rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
是，因为它与一项合法的州利益有理性关联。
data.explanation:
Fourteenth Amendment substantive due process principles prevent states from depriving individuals of life, liberty, or property without adequate justification. State laws that substantially impair a fundamental right - eg, the right to privacy , which encompasses parents' right to control their children's upbringing and education† - must undergo strict scrutiny. This difficult test requires the state to show that its law is necessary to achieve a compelling state interest.

Here, the state law substantially impairs parents' fundamental right to control their children's upbringing and education by requiring all children to attend public school. And though the state may have a compelling interest in raising test scores to retain federal funding, the law is not necessary to further that interest. This is because the state can do so with less restrictive measures - eg, improving teaching and test preparation in public schools (Choice C). Therefore, the law should not be upheld under strict scrutiny.

†The right to education is an ordinary right that is subject to rational basis review. But this right has not been impaired by the state law because each child is still receiving an education through the public school system.

(Choices B & D) The law is rationally related to the state's legitimate interest in raising test scores to retain federal funding. But the easy-to-pass rational basis test does not apply here since the law substantially impairs a fundamental right.

Educational objective: Laws that substantially impair a fundamental right - eg, parents' right to control their children's upbringing and education - can be challenged on substantive due process grounds. Such laws are reviewed under strict scrutiny and rarely survive.



选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 16%，C选项 1%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《第十四修正案》(Fourteenth Amendment) 的实质性正当程序 (substantive due process) 原则，禁止各州在没有充分理由的情况下剥夺个人的生命、自由或财产。实质性损害基本权利的州法律——例如，隐私权 (right to privacy)，其涵盖了父母控制其子女养育和教育的权利†——必须接受严格审查 (strict scrutiny)。这项严苛的审查标准要求州政府证明其法律对于实现一项迫切的州利益 (compelling state interest) 是必要的。

在本案中，该州法律要求所有儿童必须就读公立学校，从而实质性地损害了父母控制其子女养育和教育的基本权利。尽管州政府在提高考试成绩以保留联邦资金方面可能拥有迫切的利益，但该法律对于促进该利益而言并非必要。这是因为州政府可以通过限制性较小的措施来达到此目的——例如，改善公立学校的教学和备考（选项C）。因此，根据严格审查标准，该法律不应被维持。

†受教育权是一项普通权利，适用理性基础审查 (rational basis review)。但该州法律并未损害此项权利，因为每个孩子仍然通过公立学校系统接受教育。

（选项B和D）该法律确实与州政府在提高考试成绩以保留联邦资金方面的合法利益存在理性关联。但由于该法律实质性地损害了一项基本权利，因此，容易通过的理性基础审查标准在此并不适用。

教学目标：实质性损害基本权利的法律——例如，父母控制其子女养育和教育的权利——可基于实质性正当程序为由受到质疑。此类法律将受到严格审查，且很少能通过审查。

References

Pierce v. Soc'y of Sisters, 268 U.S. 510, 534 - 35 (1925) (holding that a law eliminating private schools violates the fundamental right of parents to direct the upbringing and education of their children).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law | Substantive Due Process
正确答案: A
难度: 高

本题考察的是美国宪法第十四修正案下的实质性正当程序 (Substantive Due Process) 以及父母对子女教育的权利。

核心考点：父母的权利

基本规则：父母拥有控制其子女养育和教育的权利，这被视为一项基本权利 (Fundamental Right)。

经典判例： Pierce v. Society of Sisters (1925)。在该案中，最高法院裁定，州政府不能强迫所有儿童就读公立学校，因为这不合理地干涉了父母指导其子女教育的自由。

审查标准：严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)

当一项法律实质性地损害了基本权利（如隐私权、父母权、投票权等）时，法院必须适用严格审查标准。

严格审查的三要素：

  • 举证责任： 在政府 (Government)。
  • 目的： 必须是为了实现一项迫切的州利益 (Compelling State Interest)。
  • 手段： 法律手段必须是实现该利益所必需的 (Necessary)，且通常要求是限制性最小的手段 (Least Restrictive Means)。
案情分析

在本题中：

  1. 权利受损： 州法律强制所有儿童上公立学校，剥夺了父母选择私立教育的权利，侵犯了基本权利。
  2. 州利益： 州政府希望通过提高平均分来保留联邦资金。这可能被视为一项“迫切的利益”。
  3. 手段是否必要？ 否。 强制所有私立学校学生转入公立学校并不是提高成绩的唯一或必要手段。州政府完全可以采取其他限制性更小的措施（如改进公立学校教学质量、增加辅导等）。
选项解析

选项 A (正确)：
"No, because it is not necessary to further a compelling state interest."
这是严格审查标准的正确表述。虽然州可能有迫切利益，但该法律手段过于宽泛，并非“必需”。

选项 B & D (错误)：
这两个选项提到了“理性关联 (Rationally Related)”和“合法利益 (Legitimate Interest)”。这是理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review) 的标准。由于本案涉及基本权利，必须使用更严格的标准，不能仅适用理性基础审查。

选项 C (错误)：
虽然它正确地引用了严格审查的标准（迫切利益+必需），但结论是错误的。该法律并非必需的，因为存在限制性更小的替代方案。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 宪法题中，首先判断受影响的权利是否为基本权利 (Fundamental Right)。

  • 如果是（如：隐私、婚姻、父母权、州际旅行），直接寻找包含 "Compelling Interest" 和 "Necessary" 关键词的选项。
  • 如果是普通社会/经济权利（如：受教育权本身、商业经营），则适用理性基础审查。

注意：虽然受教育权本身不是基本权利，但父母选择教育方式的权利是基本权利。

A city passed an ordinance requiring individuals to obtain a license in order to care for children under the age of 12 for pay. City officials who promoted the ordinance said that the licensing process would ensure that child-care workers were adequately regulated for the health and safety of the city's children. To receive a license, the ordinance requires an individual to complete 10 hours of instruction in child care, undergo a background check, and pay a $100 fee. The ordinance affects women disproportionately to men, because female child-care workers far outnumber male child-care workers in the city.
Is the ordinance constitutional?

choices.a: No, because it has a disparate impact on women without a showing that the ordinance is necessary to serve a compelling government interest.
choices.b: No, because it infringes on the freedom of contract without a compelling government interest.
choices.c: Yes, because any burden it imposes is clearly outweighed by an important government objective.
choices.d: Yes, because it is rationally related to a legitimate government objective.

Q82107

A city passed an ordinance requiring individuals to obtain a license in order to care for children under the age of 12 for pay. City officials who promoted the ordinance said that the licensing process would ensure that child-care workers were adequately regulated for the health and safety of the city's children. To receive a license, the ordinance requires an individual to complete 10 hours of instruction in child care, undergo a background check, and pay a $100 fee. The ordinance affects women disproportionately to men, because female child-care workers far outnumber male child-care workers in the city.

Is the ordinance constitutional?

某市通过一项法令，要求为12岁以下儿童提供有偿看护服务的个人必须获得执照。推动该法令的市政官员表示，执照审批程序将确保托儿工作者受到充分监管，以保障本市儿童的健康与安全。根据该法令，要获得执照，个人必须完成10小时的托儿指导课程，接受背景调查，并支付100美元的费用。该法令对女性的影响不成比例地大于男性，因为在该市，女性托儿工作者的数量远超男性。

该法令是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because it has a disparate impact on women without a showing that the ordinance is necessary to serve a compelling government interest.
不合宪，因为它对女性产生了不成比例的影响，且未能证明该法令对于服务于一项迫切的政府利益是必要的。

B. No, because it infringes on the freedom of contract without a compelling government interest.
不合宪，因为它在没有迫切政府利益的情况下，侵犯了合同自由。

C. Yes, because any burden it imposes is clearly outweighed by an important government objective.
合宪，因为它所施加的任何负担显然被一项重要的政府目标所超越。

D. Yes, because it is rationally related to a legitimate government objective.
合宪，因为它与一项合法的政府目标具有理性关联。
data.explanation:
Discriminatory laws challenged under the equal protection clause are generally subject to rational basis scrutiny, which requires that a law be rationally related to a legitimate government objective. But heightened scrutiny is used when a law (1) substantially impacts a fundamental right or (2) intentionally discriminates against a suspect or quasi-suspect class. Intentional discrimination can be seen on a law's:
  • face - the language of the law distinguishes between different classes (intent presumed)
  • application - a facially neutral law is purposefully applied differently to different classes or
  • motive - an otherwise neutral law was enacted to disproportionately impact a protected class.
Here, although the ordinance disproportionately affects women (quasi-suspect class), it is not subject to heightened scrutiny since there is no evidence that this discrimination was intentional. That is because the ordinance:
  • requires that all child-care workers obtain a license (no facial discrimination)
  • is applied equally to men and women (no discriminatory application) and
  • was not enacted to target women (no discriminatory motive).
And since the ordinance is rationally related to the government's legitimate interest in the health and safety of children, it is constitutional.

(Choice A) The city would have had to prove that the ordinance was necessary to serve a compelling government interest (ie, strict scrutiny) had it substantially impacted a fundamental right or intentionally discriminated against a suspect class. Since the ordinance does neither, it need only survive rational basis review.

(Choice B) The freedom of contract is protected by the contracts clause, which restricts state and local legislatures from impairing existing contracts. Since the ordinance affects the ability to enter into future contracts for child-care services, it does not violate this clause.

(Choice C) Had the ordinance intentionally discriminated against women, the city would have had to prove that the ordinance is substantially related to an important government objective (ie, intermediate scrutiny) - not that this objective clearly outweighs any burden the ordinance imposes.

Educational objective: Heightened equal protection review is appropriate when a law intentionally discriminates - on its face, in its application, or in its motive - against a quasi-suspect or suspect class.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 0%，C选项 22%，D选项 73%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在平等保护条款 (equal protection clause)下受到挑战的歧视性法律，通常需接受理性基础审查，该审查要求法律与合法的政府目标之间存在理性关联。但是，当一项法律 (1) 实质性地影响一项基本权利，或 (2) 有意歧视某个可疑分类或准可疑分类时，则采用更严格的审查标准。有意歧视可以从法律的以下方面看出：
  • 法律文本 - 法律条文本身对不同阶层作出区分 (推定具有意图)
  • 适用 - 一项表面中立的法律被有目的地对不同阶层进行区别适用或
  • 动机 - 一项表面中立的法律被制定出来，旨在对受保护阶层产生不成比例的影响。
在本案中，尽管该法令对女性 (准可疑分类) 产生了不成比例的影响，但由于没有证据表明这种歧视是有意的，因此它不受更严格的审查。这是因为该法令：
  • 要求所有托儿工作者都获得执照 (无法律文本上的歧视)
  • 对男性和女性的适用是平等的 (无歧视性适用) 并且
  • 其制定并非为了针对女性 (无歧视性动机)。
并且，由于该法令与政府在保障儿童健康与安全方面的合法利益具有理性关联，因此它是合宪的。

(选项 A) 如果该法令实质性地影响了一项基本权利，或有意歧视了一个可疑分类，那么市政府将必须证明该法令对于服务于一项迫切的政府利益是必要的 (即，严格审查)。由于该法令两者皆非，它只需通过理性基础审查即可。

(选项 B) 合同自由受到合同条款的保护，该条款限制州和地方立法机构损害现有合同。由于该法令影响的是签订未来托儿服务合同的能力，因此它不违反该条款。

(选项 C) 如果该法令有意歧视女性，市政府将必须证明该法令与一项重要的政府目标有实质性关联 (即，中度审查)，而非证明该目标明显超越了法令所施加的任何负担。

教学目标：当一项法律在法律文本、适用或动机上有意歧视准可疑分类或可疑分类时，适用更严格的平等保护审查标准。

References

U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).

Pers. Adm'r of Mass. v. Feeney, 442 U.S. 256, 274 (1979) (explaining that a neutral law's disparate impact on a quasi-suspect or suspect class, standing alone, is insufficient to require heightened scrutiny).

MBE 考点解析：平等保护与差别影响

本题考查宪法第十四修正案平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause) 中的核心原则：如何审查表面中立但具有歧视性后果的法律。

核心法则 (The Rule):
仅有差别影响 (Disparate Impact) 不足以触发严格审查或中度审查。必须证明存在歧视意图 (Discriminatory Intent)。

如果法律表面中立且无歧视意图，即使它对某一受保护群体（如女性）产生不成比例的影响，也仅适用理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。

⚖️ 法律推理逻辑

1
识别分类：
题目提到该法令对女性的影响大于男性。性别 (Gender) 通常属于“准可疑分类” (Quasi-suspect classification)，一般适用中度审查 (Intermediate Scrutiny)。
2
检查歧视形式：
  • 表面歧视 (Facial Discrimination)？ 无。法律文本写的是“个人 (individuals)”，未提及性别。
  • 歧视性适用 (Discriminatory Application)？ 无。题目未提及只针对女性执法。
  • 歧视性动机 (Discriminatory Motive)？ 无。题目明确指出目的是“儿童健康与安全”。
3
确定审查标准：
根据最高法院判例（如 Washington v. Davis），没有歧视意图的表面中立法律，仅需通过理性基础审查。
4
应用标准：
政府目标（儿童安全）是合法的 (Legitimate)，手段（执照许可）与目标理性相关 (Rationally related)。因此合宪。

🔍 选项深度解析

✅ 选项 D 正确
它准确描述了理性基础审查的标准：“与合法的政府目标具有理性关联”。这是本案适用的正确标准，因为缺乏歧视意图。
❌ 选项 A 错误
这是一个常见的干扰项。它错误地认为仅凭“差别影响”就需要政府证明“迫切利益” (Compelling interest，即严格审查)。实际上，如果没有歧视意图，不需要严格审查，甚至不需要中度审查。
❌ 选项 B 错误
涉及合同自由 (Freedom of Contract)。自 Lochner 时代结束后，法院不再视合同自由为基本权利。经济和社会福利立法只需通过理性基础审查。此外，合同条款 (Contracts Clause) 仅禁止损害现有合同，不限制对未来商业行为的监管。
❌ 选项 C 错误
该选项描述了一种类似“利益平衡”或中度审查的测试。虽然结果是“合宪”，但理由错误。本案不需要权衡负担是否被目标“超越”，只需证明手段与目的之间有理性关联即可。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip):
看到“不成比例的影响” (Disproportionate impact) 时，立即寻找是否有意图 (Intent) 的证据。
  • 如果有意图 ➡️ 严格/中度审查。
  • 如果只是意外后果（即使政府知道会有此后果）➡️ 理性基础审查 (Rational Basis)。

questions.question:
A state law imposes penalties for "any public statement containing false or misleading information about a service or product." An airline falsely claimed in an advertisement that its competitor had an inferior safety record. The claim was based on erroneous information, found on the website of a nonprofit consumer advocacy group, that the airline assumed to be true. The airline was charged under the state law for making a false statement. No federal statute applies.
Which of the following best supports the airline in a defense based on the First Amendment?

choices.a: Its statement about the safety record was made without malice.
choices.b: Its statement about the safety record was protected noncommercial speech.
choices.c: The state law is a prior restraint.
choices.d: The state law is overbroad.

data.questionStem:
Q82813 A state law imposes penalties for "any public statement containing false or misleading information about a service or product." An airline falsely claimed in an advertisement that its competitor had an inferior safety record. The claim was based on erroneous information, found on the website of a nonprofit consumer advocacy group, that the airline assumed to be true. The airline was charged under the state law for making a false statement. No federal statute applies.

Which of the following best supports the airline in a defense based on the First Amendment? 某州法律规定，对“任何包含关于服务或产品的虚假或误导性信息的公开声明”处以刑罚。一家航空公司在一则广告中谎称其竞争对手的安全记录较差。该主张基于一家非营利性消费者权益保护组织网站上的错误信息，而该航空公司想当然地认为该信息是真实的。该航空公司因发表虚假声明而根据州法律被起诉。没有适用的联邦法规。

以下哪一项最能支持该航空公司基于第一修正案的辩护？
options:
A. Its statement about the safety record was made without malice.
其关于安全记录的声明是在没有恶意的情况下作出的。

B. Its statement about the safety record was protected noncommercial speech.
其关于安全记录的声明是受保护的非商业言论。

C. The state law is a prior restraint.
该州法律是一种事先限制。

D. The state law is overbroad.
该州法律过于宽泛。
data.explanation:
Constitutional challenges


Facial
  • No application of law would be constitutional
  • Strike down law in its entirety
    • As applied
  • Generally valid law is unconstitutional as to challenger
  • Overturn application of law against challenger
    • The state law cannot be challenged as applied to the airline's false advertisement because the First Amendment does not protect commercial speech that is (1) false or misleading or (2) concerns an unlawful activity. But the airline can still use the First Amendment to challenge the law on its face based on the overbreadth doctrine. Under this doctrine, a law is unenforceable against anyone—including those engaged in unprotected speech—if it restricts a substantial amount of constitutionally protected speech.

    Here, the law penalizes "any public statement containing false or misleading information about a service or product." And though this encompasses unprotected commercial speech, it also impacts a substantial amount of protected speech—eg, false or misleading noncommercial speech. Therefore, the airline's best defense is that the law is overbroad.

    (Choice A) Defamation of a public official or figure (eg, the airline's competitor) requires proof that the speaker acted with malice—ie, knowingly or recklessly disregarded the falsity of its published statement. And though the airline's lack of malice may show that its advertisement was not defamatory, the false advertisement is still unprotected speech. Therefore, this evidence would not aid the airline's defense.

    (Choice B) The airline's claim about the competitor's safety record was commercial speech because it was used in an advertisement—a type of economically-oriented expression. And it was unprotected commercial speech because it contained false information.

    (Choice C) A prior restraint is a government action (eg, an injunction) that prohibits speech before it occurs. But the state law is not a prior restraint since it imposes penalties after speech occurs.

    Educational objective: Under the overbreadth doctrine, a law is unenforceable against anyone—including those engaged in unprotected speech—if it restricts a substantial amount of constitutionally protected speech.

    宪法挑战


    表面挑战 (Facial)
  • 法律的任何适用都是违宪的
  • 将法律完全废除
    • 具体适用挑战 (As applied)
  • 通常有效的法律对挑战者而言是违宪的
  • 推翻针对挑战者的法律适用
    • 该州法律不能就其适用于该航空公司的虚假广告而受到挑战，因为第一修正案不保护(1)虚假或误导性的，或(2)涉及非法活动的商业言论。但该航空公司仍然可以依据过度宽泛原则（overbreadth doctrine），使用第一修正案对该法律进行表面挑战。根据该原则，如果一部法律限制了大量的受宪法保护的言论，那么该法律对任何人——包括那些从事不受保护言论的人——都不可执行。

    在本案中，该法律惩罚“任何包含关于服务或产品的虚假或误导性信息的公开声明”。尽管这涵盖了不受保护的商业言论，但它也影响了大量的受保护言论——例如，虚假或误导性的非商业言论。因此，该航空公司的最佳辩护理由是该法律过于宽泛。

    (选项 A) 诽谤公职人员或公众人物（例如，该航空公司的竞争对手）需要证明言论发表者具有恶意——即，明知其发表的声明是虚假的或罔顾其真伪。尽管该航空公司没有恶意可能表明其广告不构成诽谤，但虚假广告仍然是不受保护的言论。因此，这一证据对该航空公司的辩护没有帮助。

    (选项 B) 该航空公司关于其竞争对手安全记录的主张属于商业言论，因为它被用于广告中——这是一种以经济为导向的表达方式。并且由于其包含虚假信息，因此是不受保护的商业言论。

    (选项 C) 事先限制（prior restraint）是一种在言论发生之前禁止言论的政府行为（例如，禁令）。但该州法律并非事先限制，因为它是在言论发生后施加惩罚。

    教学目标： 根据过度宽泛原则，如果一部法律限制了大量的受宪法保护的言论，那么该法律对任何人——包括那些从事不受保护言论的人——都不可执行。

    References

  • Houston v. Hill, 482 U.S. 451, 458–59 (1987) (explaining the overbreadth doctrine).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：第一修正案与过度宽泛原则

本题考察的是宪法第一修正案（First Amendment）中关于言论自由的一个核心例外原则：过度宽泛原则 (Overbreadth Doctrine)。

正确答案：D
该州法律过于宽泛 (The state law is overbroad)。

⚖️ 核心法律逻辑分析

第一步：分析航空公司的言论性质
航空公司的广告属于商业言论 (Commercial Speech)。由于广告内容是虚假的（即使没有恶意），根据宪法判例，虚假或误导性的商业言论不受第一修正案保护。
False or misleading commercial speech is not protected by the First Amendment.
第二步：识别辩护困境
既然航空公司的言论本身不受保护，它无法主张该法律在“具体适用”于它时违宪（As-Applied Challenge）。通常情况下，如果你的行为不被保护，你不能抱怨法律违宪。
第三步：应用“过度宽泛原则” (The Overbreadth Doctrine)
这是第一修正案的一个特殊规则。即使原告自己的言论不受保护（如本案中的虚假商业广告），如果一条法律写得太宽，以至于限制了大量受保护的言论（Substantial amount of protected speech），原告可以对该法律发起表面挑战 (Facial Challenge)。
第四步：结合案情
该州法律禁止“任何包含关于服务或产品的虚假或误导性信息的公开声明”。
  • 这不仅覆盖了不受保护的虚假商业广告；
  • 还覆盖了受保护的非商业言论（例如：消费者在博客上的评论、非营利组织的批评、政治辩论中的比喻等）。
因为该法律“一刀切”地禁止了受保护的非商业言论，所以它是过度宽泛 (Overbroad) 的，因此整部法律无效。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A (无恶意)：
    “恶意” (Malice) 标准通常适用于针对公众人物的诽谤 (Defamation) 案件。但在商业言论领域，只要是虚假的，就不受保护，无论是否有恶意。
  • 选项 B (受保护的非商业言论)：
    这是对事实的错误定性。广告是典型的商业言论。且因为它是虚假的，所以它不受保护。
  • 选项 C (事先限制)：
    事先限制 (Prior Restraint) 指的是政府在言论发表之前就予以禁止（如法院禁令）。本案是言论发表后进行的刑事/行政处罚，属于事后惩罚，而非事先限制。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 宪法题中，如果你看到一个当事人的言论明显不受保护（如淫秽、虚假广告、煽动暴力），但题目问“最好的辩护理由是什么”，请立即联想 Overbreadth (过度宽泛) 或 Vagueness (模糊不清)。

这通常是当事人自身行为不占理时，唯一可用的“核武器”——攻击法律本身写得太烂，伤及了无辜的第三方言论。

questions.question:
The legislature of State B enacted a statute requiring that all law enforcement officers in that state be United States citizens. A lawfully admitted noncitizen became a permanent resident five years before the enactment of this statute. He sought employment as a forensic pathologist in the state coroner's office. He was denied that job solely because he was not a citizen. The resident noncitizen thereupon brought suit in federal district court against appropriate state officials seeking to invalidate this citizenship requirement on federal constitutional grounds.
Which of the following is the strongest ground upon which to attack this citizenship requirement?

choices.a: The requirement constitutes an ex post facto law as to previously admitted noncitizens.
choices.b: The requirement denies noncitizens equal protection of the laws guaranteed by the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.c: The requirement denies noncitizens the right to employment in violation of the privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.d: The requirement deprives noncitizens of a fundamental right to employment without the due process of law under the Fourteenth Amendment.

questions.question:

In response, Congress enacted a statute imposing stringent new airport and airline security measures only on individuals of that race seeking to board airplanes in the United States.
Which of the following provides the best ground for challenging the constitutionality of this statute?

choices.a: The commerce clause of Article I, Section 8.
choices.b: The due process clause of the Fifth Amendment.
choices.c: The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.
choices.d: The privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

美国政府证明，涉及商用客机的恐怖袭击完全是由某一特定种族的个人所为。作为回应，国会颁布了一项法规，仅对在美国寻求登机的该种族个人实施严格的新机场和航空公司安保措施。

以下哪一项为挑战该法规的合宪性提供了最佳依据？
options:
A. The commerce clause of Article I, Section 8.
Article I, Section 8 的商业条款。

B. The due process clause of the Fifth Amendment.
Fifth Amendment 的正当程序条款。

C. The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.
Article IV 的特权与豁免条款。

D. The privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
Fourteenth Amendment 的特权或豁免条款。
data.explanation:
A law that treats similarly situated persons differently may violate the constitutional principle of equal protection , which applies to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause. This is especially likely when the law intentionally discriminates against a suspect class (eg, race). That is because the government must clear the highest hurdle - strict scrutiny - to justify such a law. And since this federal statute intentionally targets a particular race, due process provides the best ground to challenge the statute.

  • The equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment applies only to states and localities - not the federal government.


(Choice A) The commerce clause grants Congress broad plenary power to regulate the instrumentalities of interstate commerce - eg, planes, trains, automobiles. Therefore, this clause supports Congress's authority to regulate airports and airlines.

(Choice C) The Article IV privileges and immunities clause generally prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states. But it does not apply to the federal government.

(Choice D) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause applies to states - not the federal government - and bars them from depriving individuals of the very limited rights of national citizenship.

Educational objective: Equal protection principles apply to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause. And under this clause, federal laws that intentionally discriminate against a suspect class (eg, race) are almost always invalidated under strict scrutiny.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 12%，D选项 16%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一项对处境相似者区别对待的法律，可能违反平等保护的宪法原则，该原则通过 Fifth Amendment 的正当程序条款适用于联邦政府。当法律有意歧视某一可疑分类（例如，种族）时，尤其可能发生这种情况。这是因为政府必须通过最高门槛的审查——即严格审查——才能证明该法律的正当性。而且，由于该联邦法规有意针对特定种族，正当程序为挑战该法规提供了最佳依据。

  • Fourteenth Amendment 的平等保护条款仅适用于州和地方政府，而不适用于联邦政府。


(选项 A) 商业条款授予国会广泛且完全的权力以监管州际贸易的工具——例如，飞机、火车、汽车。因此，该条款支持国会监管机场和航空公司的权力。

(选项 C) Article IV 的特权与豁免条款通常禁止州歧视其他州的公民。但它不适用于联邦政府。

(选项 D) Fourteenth Amendment 的特权或豁免条款适用于州——而非联邦政府——并禁止它们剥夺个人极为有限的国民公民权。

教学目标：平等保护原则通过 Fifth Amendment 的正当程序条款适用于联邦政府。并且根据该条款，有意歧视可疑分类（例如，种族）的联邦法律在严格审查下几乎总被宣告无效。

References

Bolling v. Sharpe, 347 U.S. 497, 499 - 500 (1954) (holding that equal protection principles apply to the federal government through the Fifth Amendment due process clause).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: Individual Rights

正确答案：选项 B

Fifth Amendment 的正当程序条款 (Due Process Clause)。

这是本题挑战该联邦法规合宪性的最佳依据。

核心考点：联邦政府与平等保护

本题考察的是一个经典的宪法学“弯路”：如何用宪法约束联邦政府的歧视行为。

逻辑链条：
  • 平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause) 原文出现在第十四修正案 (14th Amendment)，但该修正案明确规定针对的是州 (State)。
  • 联邦政府 (Federal Government) 不受第十四修正案直接约束。
  • 但是，最高法院在 Bolling v. Sharpe (1954) 案中确立，第五修正案的正当程序条款 (Due Process Clause) 包含了平等保护的原则。

因此，当联邦政府（如本题中的国会 Congress）制定法律基于种族 (Race) 进行分类时，必须通过第五修正案的正当程序条款进行挑战。

审查标准：严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)

由于该法律涉及种族这一可疑分类 (Suspect Classification)，法院将适用严格审查标准。

政府必须证明该法律：

  1. 是为了实现迫切的政府利益 (Compelling Government Interest)（如国家安全）；且
  2. 手段是狭义以此为目的 (Narrowly Tailored) 的。

虽然反恐是迫切利益，但仅针对单一特定种族进行限制通常被认为过于宽泛或包含不足，难以通过严格审查。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A: Commerce Clause (商业条款)

商业条款是国会权力的来源 (Source of Power)，赋予国会监管航空业的权力。它是支持该法律存在的依据，而不是挑战该法律侵犯人权的依据。

❌ 选项 C: Art. IV Privileges and Immunities (特权与豁免条款)

该条款（又称 Comity Clause）禁止州歧视来自其他州的公民。它不适用于联邦政府，也不涉及种族歧视。

❌ 选项 D: 14th Am. Privileges or Immunities (特权或豁免条款)

该条款保护范围极窄（如跨州迁徙权），且仅适用于州对国民权利的剥夺。它不是挑战种族歧视的主要依据。

💡 MBE 实战技巧

做题时请务必先看主体 (Actor)：

  • 如果是州 (State) 歧视 ➡️ 选 14th Amendment Equal Protection。
  • 如果是联邦 (Federal/Congress) 歧视 ➡️ 选 5th Amendment Due Process。

这是MBE中极易混淆但非常固定的考点，看到 "Federal statute" 和 "Discrimination" 同时出现，直奔第五修正案！

questions.question:
A state statute provided state monetary grants to private dance, theater, and opera groups located in that state. The statute required recipients of such grants to use the granted monies for the acquisition, construction, and maintenance of appropriate facilities for the public performance of their performing arts. The last section of the statute conditioned the award of each such grant on the recipient's agreement to refrain from all kinds of political lobbying calculated to secure additional tax support for the performing arts.
Which of the following provides the strongest constitutional basis to attack the validity of the last section of the statute?

choices.a: Commerce clause.
choices.b: Fifth Amendment.
choices.c: First and Fourteenth Amendments.
choices.d: Obligation of contracts clause.

data.questionStem:
Q82161

A state statute provided state monetary grants to private dance, theater, and opera groups located in that state. The statute required recipients of such grants to use the granted monies for the acquisition, construction, and maintenance of appropriate facilities for the public performance of their performing arts. The last section of the statute conditioned the award of each such grant on the recipient's agreement to refrain from all kinds of political lobbying calculated to secure additional tax support for the performing arts.

Which of the following provides the strongest constitutional basis to attack the validity of the last section of the statute?

一部州法规定，向位于该州的私立舞蹈、戏剧和歌剧团体提供州政府的资金补助。该法规定，此类补助金的受领人必须将所获资金用于购置、建造和维护适合其表演艺术公开演出的设施。该法的最后一节规定，每笔此类补助金的授予，都以受领人同意不进行任何旨在为表演艺术争取额外税收支持的政治游说为条件。

以下哪项为质疑该法最后一节的有效性提供了最有力的宪法依据？
options:
A. Commerce clause.
商业条款。

B. Fifth Amendment.
第五修正案。

C. First and Fourteenth Amendments.
第一和第十四修正案。

D. Obligation of contracts clause.
合同义务条款。
data.explanation:
Conditions on government funding


Funded activitiesGovernment can restrict use of funds to authorized purposes
"Grant monies must be used for the acquisition, construction, and maintenance of appropriate performance facilities"
Funding recipientsGovernment cannot restrict protected conduct unrelated to funding's purpose
"Recipient must agree to refrain from all kinds of political lobbying calculated to secure additional tax support for the performing arts"
The last section of the statute conditions state funding on a recipient's agreement to refrain from certain political lobbying efforts. Since this condition interferes with the First Amendment right to free expression - which is applied to the states through the Fourteenth Amendment - the section can be challenged on that basis. But due to the government's countervailing right to decide how to spend its funds, the success of this attack depends on whether the condition is placed on :
  • funded activities - in which case, the government can insist that the funds be used for authorized purposes or
  • funding recipients - in which case, the government cannot restrict the recipient's right to engage in protected conduct that falls outside the funding's purpose or scope (as seen here).


Political lobbying is protected First Amendment conduct that is unrelated to the activities - acquiring, constructing, and maintaining performing arts facilities - that are funded by the statute. And since the statute conditions the award of such grants on the recipient's agreement to refrain from such conduct, the First and Fourteenth Amendments provide the strongest constitutional basis to attack this section of the statute.

(Choice A) The commerce clause bars states from discriminating against interstate commerce by favoring in-state over out-of-state economic interests unless the state acts as a market participant (eg, by providing grants - as seen here). Therefore, this is a weak basis to attack the last section's constitutionality.

(Choice B) The Fifth Amendment does not, by itself, provide a basis to attack the last section since the Fifth Amendment only applies to the states through the Fourteenth Amendment.

(Choice D) The contracts clause restricts state legislatures' ability to substantially impair existing contracts. But since no existing contracts are at issue here, this clause does not apply.

Educational objective: The government can condition funding on the promise that the funds be used for a particular purpose. But it cannot condition funding on a recipient's promise to refrain from engaging in protected First Amendment conduct if that conduct is unrelated to the funding's purpose or scope.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 1%，C选项 91%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

政府资助的条件


受资助的活动政府可以限制资金用于授权目的
“补助金必须用于购置、建造和维护适当的演出设施”
资金受领人政府不能限制与资助目的无关的受保护行为
“受领人必须同意不进行任何旨在为表演艺术争取额外税收支持的政治游说”
该法的最后一节将州政府的资助与受领人同意放弃某些政治游说活动作为条件。由于此条件干涉了第一修正案所保障的自由表达权——该权利通过第十四修正案适用于各州——因此可以基于此对该节提出质疑。但由于政府拥有决定如何使用其资金的对等权利，此次质疑能否成功取决于该条件是施加于：
  • 受资助的活动——在这种情况下，政府可以坚持资金必须用于授权目的 或
  • 资金受领人——在这种情况下，政府不能限制受领人从事超出资助目的或范围的受保护行为的权利（如本案所示）。


政治游说是受第一修正案保护的行为，与该法资助的活动——购置、建造和维护表演艺术设施——无关。并且，由于该法将授予此类补助金的条件建立在受领人同意放弃此类行为的基础上，第一和第十四修正案为质疑该法此节的有效性提供了最有力的宪法依据。

(选项 A) 商业条款禁止州通过偏袒州内经济利益而歧视州际商业，除非该州作为市场参与者行事（例如，如本案中提供补助金）。因此，以此为依据质疑最后一节的合宪性理由薄弱。

(选项 B) 第五修正案本身并不能为质疑最后一节提供依据，因为第五修正案仅通过第十四修正案适用于各州。

(选项 D) 合同条款限制州立法机关实质性损害现有合同的能力。但由于本案不涉及任何现有合同，因此该条款不适用。

教学目的：政府可以将资助的条件设定为承诺将资金用于特定目的。但如果受保护的第一修正案行为与资助的目的或范围无关，政府不能将资助的条件设定为受领人承诺不从事该行为。

References

Agency for Int'l Dev. v. All. for Open Soc'y Int'l, Inc., 570 U.S. 205, 221 (2013) (holding that a state funding program violated the First Amendment by conditioning funds on requirements unrelated to the program's purpose).

Rust v. Sullivan, 500 U.S. 173, 192 - 200 (1991) (upholding a federal funding program that limited fund recipients' ability to provide abortion-related services that were outside the program's scope).

MBE 宪法考点解析
违宪条件原则与政府资助
正确答案

选项 C：第一和第十四修正案

这是最有力的宪法攻击依据。本题的核心考点是违宪条件原则 (Unconstitutional Conditions Doctrine)。

结论：政府不能通过“资助”作为诱饵，迫使受领人放弃其受宪法保护的言论自由权利（如政治游说），特别是当该限制与资助项目的范围无关时。

⚖️ 法律推理深度解析

1. 权利基础 (The Right)

政治游说 (Political Lobbying) 属于核心的政治言论，受到第一修正案 (First Amendment) 的最高级别保护。

2. 法律适用 (Incorporation)

由于本题涉及的是州法律 (State Statute)，第一修正案对联邦政府的限制必须通过第十四修正案 (Fourteenth Amendment) 的正当程序条款 (Due Process Clause) “纳入” (Incorporated) 从而适用于各州。因此，选项必须同时提及这两者。

3. 核心考点：资助的界限

MBE 经常考察政府资助权力的边界。请记住以下区分：

✅ 政府可以限制资金用途 (Subsidized Activities)：
政府可以说：“这笔钱只能用来盖楼，不能用来游说。”
Government can define the limits of the government-funded program.

❌ 政府不能限制受领人本身 (The Recipient)：
政府不能说：“如果你拿了盖楼的钱，你就永远不能用你自己的钱去游说。”
Government cannot condition funding on the recipient's waiver of constitutional rights outside the scope of the program.

本案分析： 州法不仅限制了补助金的使用，还要求受领人同意“不进行任何旨在争取税收支持的政治游说”。这限制了受领人在资助项目之外的言论自由，构成了违宪条件。

🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

A. 商业条款 (Commerce Clause)
虽然通常州不能歧视州际商业，但这里有一个重要例外：市场参与者例外 (Market Participant Exception)。当州政府作为买家或资助者（花自己的钱）时，它可以偏袒本州居民或团体。因此，这不是一个强有力的攻击点。

B. 第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment)
这是一个程序性陷阱。第五修正案直接约束联邦政府。要约束州政府，必须通过第十四修正案。单独引用第五修正案是法律依据上的错误。

D. 合同义务条款 (Contracts Clause)
该条款禁止州通过法律实质性地损害现有的 (Existing) 合同义务。本案中，政府是提供新的资助协议，并没有废除或改变之前的合同，因此该条款不适用。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

当你看到题目涉及“政府福利/资助” (Government Benefit/Grant) 附带了“放弃某项权利” (Condition requiring waiver of rights) 时：

  1. 首先检查该条件是否限制了言论自由 (Free Speech)。
  2. 判断该限制是仅针对资金的使用（通常允许），还是针对受领人的所有活动（通常违宪）。
  3. 如果是州政府的行为，确保答案包含第十四修正案。

questions.question:
In one state, certain advanced diagnostic medical technologies were located only in hospitals, where they provided a major source of revenue. In many other states, such technologies were also available at "diagnostic centers" that were not affiliated with hospitals.
A group of physicians announced its plan to immediately open in the state a diagnostic center that would not be affiliated with a hospital. The state hospital association argued to the state legislature that only hospitals could reliably handle advanced diagnostic medical technologies. The legislature then enacted a law prohibiting the operation in the state of diagnostic centers that were not affiliated with hospitals.
The group of physicians filed suit challenging the constitutionality of the state law. What action should the court take?

choices.a: Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the suit is not ripe.
choices.b: Invalidate the law, because it imposes an undue burden on access to medical services in the state.
choices.c: Uphold the law, because the legislature could rationally believe that diagnostic centers not affiliated with hospitals would be less reliable than hospitals.
choices.d: Uphold the law, because the provision of medical services is traditionally a matter of legitimate local concern that states have unreviewable authority to regulate.

A group of physicians announced its plan to immediately open in the state a diagnostic center that would not be affiliated with a hospital. The state hospital association argued to the state legislature that only hospitals could reliably handle advanced diagnostic medical technologies. The legislature then enacted a law prohibiting the operation in the state of diagnostic centers that were not affiliated with hospitals.

The group of physicians filed suit challenging the constitutionality of the state law. What action should the court take?

在某个州，某些先进的诊断医疗技术仅设于医院内，并成为医院的主要收入来源。在许多其他州，此类技术也可在不隶属于医院的“诊断中心”使用。

一群医生宣布了他们的计划，即刻在该州开设一家不隶属于医院的诊断中心。州医院协会向州立法机关主张，只有医院才能可靠地操作先进的诊断医疗技术。立法机关随后颁布了一项法律，禁止在该州经营不隶属于医院的诊断中心。

该群医生提起诉讼，挑战该州法律的合宪性。法院应采取何种行动？
options:
A. Dismiss the suit without reaching the merits, because the suit is not ripe.
驳回诉讼，不对案情实质进行审理，因为该诉讼尚不成熟。

B. Invalidate the law, because it imposes an undue burden on access to medical services in the state.
宣布该法律无效，因为它对在该州获取医疗服务施加了不当负担。

C. Uphold the law, because the legislature could rationally believe that diagnostic centers not affiliated with hospitals would be less reliable than hospitals.
维持该法律，因为立法机关可以合理地认为，不隶属于医院的诊断中心比医院的可靠性更低。

D. Uphold the law, because the provision of medical services is traditionally a matter of legitimate local concern that states have unreviewable authority to regulate.
维持该法律，因为提供医疗服务传统上是地方正当关切的事项，各州对此拥有不可审查的监管权力。
data.explanation:
The constitutionality of a discriminatory law can be challenged under the equal protection clause. Such challenges are generally reviewed under the rational basis test, which requires that the law be rationally related to any legitimate state interest. And since any reasonable, conceivable purpose that may have motivated the legislature to pass the law will satisfy this test, laws subject to the rational basis test are usually upheld.

Here, a state law discriminates against physicians who wish to operate an unaffiliated diagnostic center by requiring that diagnostic centers be affiliated with hospitals. Since the legislature could rationally believe that unaffiliated diagnostic centers would be less reliable than hospitals, the law is rationally related to a legitimate state interest - providing safe medical services. Therefore, the law satisfies the rational basis test and should be upheld.

(Choice A) A court will dismiss a suit without reaching the merits if it is not ripe - ie, if the plaintiff has yet to suffer actual harm or an imminent threat thereof. But since this law threatens the physicians' immediate plan to open a diagnostic center in the state, their suit is ripe for litigation.

(Choice B) Discriminatory laws that unduly burden a fundamental right are presumptively invalid and reviewed under strict scrutiny, which requires that the law be necessary to serve a compelling state interest. But access to medical services is not a fundamental right, so this law need only survive rational basis scrutiny.

(Choice D) State laws and regulations are always subject to constitutional limits, so the state does not have the unreviewable authority to regulate the provision of medical services - even if it is traditionally a matter of legitimate local concern.

Educational objective: Under the equal protection clause, discriminatory laws are generally reviewed under the rational basis test - ie, the law must be rationally related to any legitimate state interest. And any reasonable, conceivable purpose that may have motivated the legislature in passing the law will satisfy this test.



选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 19%，C选项 53%（正确选项），D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一项歧视性法律的合宪性可以根据《平等保护条款》(Equal Protection Clause) 受到挑战。此类挑战通常在合理基础审查 (rational basis test) 下进行审查，该审查要求法律与任何合法的州利益具有合理关联。并且，由于立法机关通过该法律的任何合理、可想象的目的都能满足此项审查，因此，受合理基础审查约束的法律通常会被维持。

在本案中，一项州法律通过要求诊断中心必须隶属于医院，从而歧视了希望经营独立诊断中心的医生。由于立法机关可以合理地认为，不隶属于医院的诊断中心比医院的可靠性更低，因此该法律与一项合法的州利益——即提供安全的医疗服务——具有合理关联。因此，该法律满足合理基础审查，应予以维持。

(选项A) 如果一个诉讼尚不成熟，法院将在不审查实体问题的情况下驳回该诉讼——即，如果原告尚未遭受实际损害或迫在眉睫的损害威胁。但由于该法律威胁到医生们在该州立即开设诊断中心的计划，他们的诉讼已具备诉讼成熟性。

(选项B) 对某项基本权利施加不当负担的歧视性法律，应被推定为无效，并接受严格审查 (strict scrutiny)。严格审查要求该法律对于达成某项紧迫的州利益是必需的。但获取医疗服务并非一项基本权利，因此该法律只需通过合理基础审查即可。

(选项D) 州的法律和法规始终受宪法限制，因此州政府并不拥有监管医疗服务供应的不可审查的权力——即使这传统上是地方正当关切的事项。

教学目标：根据《平等保护条款》(Equal Protection Clause)，歧视性法律通常根据合理基础审查 (rational basis test) 进行审查——即，法律必须与任何合法的州利益具有合理关联。并且，立法机关在通过该法律时任何合理、可想象的动机都将满足此项审查。

References

U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).

Heller v. Doe, 509 U.S. 312, 319 - 20 (1993) (explaining that any reasonable, conceivable legislative purpose will satisfy rational basis scrutiny).

Barsky v. Board of Regents, 347 U.S. 442, 449 (1954) (finding that a state has broad power to regulate the health profession).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：平等保护与经济监管
✅ 正确答案：C

法院应维持该法律，因为立法机关可以合理地认为，不隶属于医院的诊断中心比医院的可靠性更低。

⚖️ 核心考点：合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)

本题考查的是法院对经济或社会福利立法（Economic or Social Welfare Legislation）进行宪法审查的标准。

当法律不涉及基本权利（Fundamental Rights，如言论自由、投票权）也不涉及可疑分类（Suspect Classifications，如种族、国籍）时，法院适用最低级别的审查标准，即合理基础审查。

严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)
种族、基本权利
中度审查 (Intermediate Scrutiny)
性别、非婚生子女
合理基础审查 (Rational Basis)
经济监管、年龄、财富等

审查标准公式：

  • 举证责任： 原告（挑战者）。
  • 测试内容： 法律必须与一个合法的州利益 (Legitimate State Interest) 具有合理关联 (Rationally Related)。
  • 极度宽容： 只要立法机关的理由是“可想象的”或“理论上合理的”，法律就会被维持。法院不会去判断该法律是否真的明智或有效。
🔍 结合本案分析

1. 权利性质： 医生经营“诊断中心”属于商业行为，不属于宪法保护的基本权利。

2. 分类性质： 法律区分了“隶属于医院的中心”和“独立中心”，这不属于种族或性别分类，仅仅是经济分类。

3. 结论： 适用合理基础审查。

4. 逻辑推演： 州政府声称医院更可靠（合法的健康安全利益）。虽然这可能有争议，但立法机关“可以合理地相信”这一点。这就足够了。

这让人联想到著名的 Williamson v. Lee Optical 案，法院在该案中表明，对于经济监管，法院不会充当“超级立法机关”去纠正不明智的法律。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • A 成熟性 (Ripeness)： 错误。医生们已经有了“立即实施的计划”且法律已经颁布，面临迫在眉睫的执法威胁，因此案件已经成熟，可以审理。
  • B 不当负担 (Undue Burden)： 错误。这个术语通常用于堕胎权（基本权利）的分析。经营医疗业务并非基本权利，因此不需要证明法律施加了不当负担。
  • D 不可审查 (Unreviewable)： 错误。虽然州拥有警察权 (Police Power)，但所有州法律都必须服从美国宪法（至高条款）。没有什么是绝对“不可审查”的。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在宪法题中，如果看到州政府监管商业、经济或一般社会福利，且不涉及种族歧视或言论自由：

  1. 默认适用合理基础审查 (Rational Basis)。
  2. 寻找包含“合理 (Rationally)”、“合法利益 (Legitimate Interest)” 字眼的选项。
  3. 记住：在这类审查下，政府几乎总是赢家（法律被维持）。
© MBE 备考助手 | 宪法篇

questions.question:
A public high school has had a very high rate of pregnancy among its students. In order to assist students who keep their babies to complete high school, the school has established an infant day-care center for children of its students, and also offers classes in child care. Because the child-care classes are always overcrowded, the school limits admission to those classes solely to students who are the mothers of babies in the infant day-care center.
A male student at the high school has legal custody of his infant son. The school provides care for his son in its infant day-care center, but will not allow the student to enroll in the child-care classes. He brings suit against the school challenging, on constitutional grounds, his exclusion from the child-care classes.
Which of the following best states the burden of persuasion in this case?

choices.a: The male student must demonstrate that the admission requirement is not as narrowly drawn as possible to achieve a substantial governmental interest.
choices.b: The male student must demonstrate that the admission requirement is not rationally related to a legitimate governmental interest.
choices.c: The school must demonstrate that the admission policy is substantially related to an important governmental interest.
choices.d: The school must demonstrate that the admission policy is the least restrictive means by which to achieve a compelling governmental interest.

一所公立高中的学生怀孕率一直很高。为了帮助那些留下孩子并完成高中学业的学生，该学校为本校学生的孩子设立了一个婴儿日托中心，并提供育儿课程。由于育儿课程总是人满为患，学校将入学资格仅限于在学校婴儿日托中心有婴儿的母亲学生。

该高中的一名男学生拥有其幼子的合法监护权。学校在其婴儿日托中心为他的儿子提供照料，但不允许该男学生参加育儿课程。他以宪法为由对学校提起诉讼，质疑他被排除在育儿课程之外的决定。

以下哪项最能说明本案中的说服责任（burden of persuasion）？
options:
A. The male student must demonstrate that the admission requirement is not as narrowly drawn as possible to achieve a substantial governmental interest.
该男学生必须证明，该入学要求并非为实现某一重大的政府利益而尽可能地精准拟定。

B. The male student must demonstrate that the admission requirement is not rationally related to a legitimate governmental interest.
该男学生必须证明，该入学要求与合法的政府利益没有理性关联。

C. The school must demonstrate that the admission policy is substantially related to an important governmental interest.
学校必须证明，该招生政策与一项重要的政府利益有实质性关联。

D. The school must demonstrate that the admission policy is the least restrictive means by which to achieve a compelling governmental interest.
学校必须证明，该招生政策是为实现一项强制性的政府利益所采取的限制性最小的手段。
data.explanation:
A government action that treats similarly situated persons differently may be challenged under the equal protection clause. The action will only be deemed constitutional if there is adequate justification for the alleged discrimination. A law that discriminates based on gender or illegitimate birth (ie, quasi-suspect classes) is presumptively invalid unless it survives intermediate scrutiny - ie, the government demonstrates that the law is substantially related to an important government interest.

Here, a public high school offers child-care classes to students with children (government action). But enrollment is limited to female students with children in the school's infant day-care center (gender discrimination). And since the male student was excluded from these classes, the admission policy will only be found constitutional if the school meets its burden of persuasion under intermediate scrutiny.

(Choice A) The male student would have had the burden to prove that there was no adequate justification for the admission policy if rational basis review applied. And there is no burden of persuasion that requires proof that a government action be as narrowly drawn as possible to achieve a substantial government interest.

(Choice B) Generally, a challenger must prove that the government action does not rationally relate to a legitimate government interest (ie, rational basis review). But this burden of persuasion does not apply when the government action impacts a fundamental right, suspect class, or quasi- suspect class (as seen here).

(Choice D) The school would have had to demonstrate that the admission policy is the least restrictive means to achieve a compelling government interest (ie, strict scrutiny) had the policy impacted a fundamental right or suspect class. But here, the policy affected a quasi -suspect class (gender).

Educational objective: A government action challenged under the equal protection clause is subject to intermediate scrutiny if it discriminates against a quasi-suspect class (ie, sex/gender, legitimacy). Intermediate scrutiny requires the government to prove that its action is substantially related to an important government interest.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一项区别对待处境相似者的政府行为，可根据equal protection clause（平等保护条款）受到质疑。只有当对所指控的歧视行为有充分的正当理由时，该行为才会被视为合宪。一项基于性别或非婚生身份（即，准可疑分类，quasi-suspect classes）进行歧视的法律，应被推定为无效，除非其能通过intermediate scrutiny（中度审查标准）——即，政府证明该法律与一项重要的政府利益有实质性关联。

在本案中，一所公立高中向有子女的学生提供育儿课程（政府行为）。但入学资格仅限于在该校婴儿日托中心有子女的女性学生（性别歧视）。而且，由于该男学生被排除在这些课程之外，只有当学校满足中度审查标准下的说服责任时，该招生政策才会被认定为合宪。

(选项 A) 如果适用理性审查标准（rational basis review），该男学生将有责任证明该招生政策没有充分的正当理由。此外，不存在要求证明政府行为是为实现某一重大政府利益而尽可能精准拟定的说服责任。

(选项 B) 通常情况下，质疑方必须证明政府行为与合法的政府利益没有理性关联（即，理性审查标准）。但当政府行为影响到基本权利、可疑分类（suspect class）或准可疑分类（如本案所示）时，此说服责任不适用。

(选项 D) 如果该政策影响了基本权利或可疑分类，学校将必须证明该招生政策是为实现强制性的政府利益而采取的限制性最小的手段（即，严格审查标准，strict scrutiny）。但在本案中，该政策影响的是一个准可疑分类（性别）。

教学目标：一项根据equal protection clause受到质疑的政府行为，如果其歧视了准可疑分类（即，性/性别，婚生身份），则需接受intermediate scrutiny的审查。Intermediate scrutiny要求政府证明其行为与一项重要的政府利益有实质性关联。

References

  • U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).
  • Craig v. Boren, 429 U.S. 190, 197 (1976) (holding that state discrimination based on sex/gender places the burden on the state to show that its action is substantially related to an important government interest).
