一部城市法令规定，在该市运营出租车必须持有出租车驾驶员执照。该法令规定，颁发此类执照的唯一标准是驾驶能力和对该市地理的了解。申请人需通过该市组织的详细问卷、笔试、口试以及实际驾驶演示来测试这些资格。

该法令不限制可颁发执照的数量。然而，该法令允许任何公民对特定执照的颁发提出异议，但异议的理由仅限于申请人不具备所要求的资格。该法令还授权城市执照颁发官员自行裁量，在颁发执照前是否就异议举行证据听证会。

一名女子申请了出租车驾驶员执照，并在完成常规的执照申请程序后被认定完全合格。随后，她的名字作为准执照持有人被公示，仅需经过异议程序。一名已持有出租车驾驶员执照的男子对向该女子颁发执照提出异议，其唯一理由是，向她颁发执照会损害他现有执照的价值。他要求在该女子获得执照前举行听证会，以便他有机会证明其主张。城市执照颁发官员拒绝举行听证会，并向该女子颁发了执照。

该男子向相应法院申请对城市官员的这一行为进行审查，声称宪法要求城市执照颁发官员在向该女子颁发执照前，必须批准其举行听证会的请求。

在本案中，法院应为哪一方作出裁决？
options:
A. City officials, because the licensing ordinance does not give the man any property interest in being free of competition from additional licensees.
应为城市官员裁决，因为执照颁发法令并未赋予该男子免受新增执照持有人竞争的任何财产利益。

B. City officials, because the man had the benefit of the licensing ordinance and, therefore, may not now question actions taken under it.
应为城市官员裁决，因为该男子已从执照颁发法令中受益，因此现在不得质疑根据该法令采取的行动。

C. The man, because the determination of whether to hold a hearing may not constitutionally be left to the discretion of the same officials whose action is being challenged.
应为该男子裁决，因为根据宪法，决定是否举行听证会的权力不能交由其行为正受质疑的同一批官员自行裁量。

D. The man, because the due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment requires all persons whose property may be adversely affected by governmental action to be given an opportunity for a hearing before such action occurs.
应为该男子裁决，因为《第十四修正案》的正当程序条款要求，所有其财产可能受到政府行为不利影响的人，在该行为发生前都必须获得举行听证会的机会。
data.explanation:
Due process rights


RightApplicabilityExamples
LifeGovernment deprives person of lifeExecution
LibertyGovernment significantly restrains person's physical freedom, exercise of fundamental rights, or freedom of choice
  • Incarceration
  • Commitment to mental institution
  • Loss of parental rights
PropertyGovernment deprives benefit from person legally entitled to receive it
  • Suspension from public school
  • Termination of welfare benefits
  • Loss of public employment (not at will)
Procedural due process gives persons the right to notice and a hearing when the government intentionally deprives them of a life, liberty, or property interest. Persons have a property interest in any benefit that they are legally entitled to receive - eg, specific benefits associated with a business or professional license. But a unilateral expectation of, or desire for, a benefit does not amount to a property interest.

Here, the ordinance gives any citizen the right to object to the issuance of a license. And the man's license gives him the benefit of operating a taxicab in the city. But neither gives him a property interest in being free of competition from additional licensees (eg, the woman). Nor does his desire for that benefit create a protected interest. Therefore, the court should rule for the city officials and find that they were not required to grant a hearing.

(Choice B) The licensing ordinance gave the man the benefit of a taxicab license. But that does not preclude him from challenging actions taken under it. Instead, he can challenge an attempt to deprive him of his license (not the woman's) on due process grounds or file an objection to the issuance of a particular license (like any other citizen).

(Choice C) Had the man possessed a property interest, the determination of whether to hold a hearing could have been left to the discretion of the same officials whose action is being challenged. But those officials would have had to use the Mathews v. Eldridge balancing test when determining what process was due.

(Choice D) Due process often requires an opportunity for a hearing when a government action deprives a person of his/her property interest. However, a government action that merely has an adverse effect on such an interest is not sufficient to trigger due process safeguards.

Educational objective: The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause requires notice and a hearing before the government deprives a person of a life, liberty, or property interest. A property interest includes benefits a person is legally entitled to receive - not merely expecting or desiring.

选项正确率统计：A选项 88%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 5%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

正当程序权利


权利适用性示例
生命政府剥夺个人生命死刑
自由政府严重限制个人的身体自由、基本权利的行使或选择自由
  • 监禁
  • 送入精神病院
  • 丧失父母权利
财产政府剥夺个人依法有权获得的利益
  • 被公立学校停学
  • 福利待遇被终止
  • 失去公共部门职位（非任意解雇）
程序性正当程序赋予个人在政府有意剥夺其生命、自由或财产利益时，获得通知和听证的权利。个人对任何其依法有权获得的利益拥有财产利益——例如，与商业或专业执照相关的特定利益。但是，单方面的期望或对某项利益的渴望，并不构成财产利益。

在本案中，该法令赋予任何公民对执照颁发提出异议的权利。而该男子的执照给予了他在该市运营出租车的利益。但是，这两者均未赋予他免受新增执照持有人（例如，该女子）竞争的财产利益。他对该利益的渴望也并未创造出受保护的利益。因此，法院应为城市官员作出裁决，并认定他们没有被要求批准举行听证会。

（选项 B）执照颁发法令给予了该男子一张出租车执照的利益。但这并不妨碍他挑战在该法令下采取的行动。相反，他可以基于正当程序理由，挑战剥夺他自己的执照（而非该女子的执照）的企图，或者（像任何其他公民一样）对特定执照的颁发提出异议。

（选项 C）如果该男子拥有财产利益，决定是否举行听证会的权力本可以交由其行为正受质疑的同一批官员自行裁量。但是，这些官员在决定何种程序是正当时，将必须使用 Mathews v. Eldridge 案的平衡测试法。

（选项 D）当政府行为剥夺了个人的财产利益时，正当程序通常要求给予举行听证会的机会。然而，仅仅对该等利益产生不利影响的政府行为，不足以触发正当程序的保障。

教育目标：《第十四修正案》的正当程序条款要求，在政府剥夺个人的生命、自由或财产利益之前，必须给予通知和听证。财产利益包括个人依法有权获得的利益——而不仅仅是期望或渴望获得的利益。

References

Barry v. Barchi, 443 U.S. 55, 64 (1979) (holding that the plaintiff had a property interest in his state-issued horse trainer's license).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：程序性正当程序
(Procedural Due Process)

✅ 正确答案：选项 A
核心法律规则
1
第十四修正案 (14th Amendment)：
政府在剥夺一个人的生命 (Life)、自由 (Liberty) 或财产 (Property) 之前，必须提供正当程序（即通知和听证会）。
2
门槛问题 (Threshold Question)：
在讨论“需要什么样的听证会”之前，必须先问：
是否存在受宪法保护的利益？
本案深度解析

为什么该男子败诉？

关键事实：
1. 法令规定执照数量不设上限。
2. 男子反对的理由是“新执照会降低我现有执照的价值”（即竞争导致贬值）。

法律推理：
虽然营业执照本身通常被视为一种“财产利益”（因为它是政府授予的权利），但这种利益的范围是由相关法律界定的。

由于该市的法令明确规定不限制执照数量，因此现有的执照持有人没有权利要求免受竞争 (Freedom from competition)。

既然他没有“垄断经营”的财产权利，政府颁发新执照并没有剥夺他的任何受宪法保护的财产。没有财产剥夺，就不需要正当程序（听证会）。

干扰项陷阱
❌ 选项 D (The man...)

这是一个典型的过度概括 (Overbroad) 选项。

  • 它声称只要财产受到“不利影响 (Adversely affected)”就需要听证会。这是错误的。
  • 宪法标准：必须是剥夺 (Deprivation) 某种合法的权利 (Entitlement)，而不仅仅是造成经济损失或不利影响。
❌ 选项 C 错误，因为只有在确定存在受保护的权利后，才需要讨论听证会的裁量权问题。第一步（是否存在权利）都没通过，就不用讨论第二步了。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Due Process 题目，请遵循“两步走”策略：

  1. 第一步（本题考点）： 原告是否被剥夺了生命、自由或财产？
    • 如果是单纯的经济竞争、名誉受损（无形资产）或单方面的期待，通常不是受保护的利益。
  2. 第二步： 如果有受保护利益，政府提供的程序（通知+听证）是否足够？
    • 此时才使用 Mathews v. Eldridge 平衡测试。
NCBE © Question Analysis

questions.question:
In order to combat terrorism, Congress enacted a statute authorizing the president to construct surveillance facilities on privately owned property if the president determines that the construction of such facilities is "necessary to safeguard the security of the United States." The statute provides no compensation for the owner of the land on which such facilities are constructed and provides that the surveillance facilities are to be owned and operated by the United States government.
Pursuant to this statute, the president has determined that the construction of a surveillance facility on a very small, unused portion of an owner's large tract of land is necessary to safeguard the security of the United States. The construction and operation of the facility will not affect any of the uses that the owner is currently making of the entire tract of land.
The owner has filed suit to challenge the constitutionality of the construction of a surveillance facility on the portion of land at issue without compensation.
How should the court rule?

choices.a: The construction and operation of the facility would not interfere with any use the owner is currently making of the entire tract of land, and therefore the owner would not be entitled to any compensation.
choices.b: The construction of the facility would be a taking of the owner's property for which the owner must be compensated.
choices.c: The construction of the facility would be valid without any compensation, because it has been determined to be necessary to protect a compelling government interest in national security.
choices.d: The construction of the facility would single out the owner for adverse treatment in violation of the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment.

data.questionStem:
Q82152

In order to combat terrorism, Congress enacted a statute authorizing the president to construct surveillance facilities on privately owned property if the president determines that the construction of such facilities is "necessary to safeguard the security of the United States." The statute provides no compensation for the owner of the land on which such facilities are constructed and provides that the surveillance facilities are to be owned and operated by the United States government.

Pursuant to this statute, the president has determined that the construction of a surveillance facility on a very small, unused portion of an owner's large tract of land is necessary to safeguard the security of the United States. The construction and operation of the facility will not affect any of the uses that the owner is currently making of the entire tract of land.

The owner has filed suit to challenge the constitutionality of the construction of a surveillance facility on the portion of land at issue without compensation.

How should the court rule?

为了打击恐怖主义，国会颁布了一项法规，授权总统在私人拥有的土地上建造监视设施，前提是总统认定该设施的建造“对保障美国国家安全是必要的”。该法规规定，对于建造此类设施的土地所有权人不提供任何补偿，并规定监视设施由美国政府拥有和运营。

根据该法规，总统已确定，在一位所有权人的一大片土地中一小块未使用的部分上建造监视设施，对于保障美国国家安全是必要的。该设施的建造和运营不会影响该所有权人目前对整片土地的任何使用。

该所有权人已提起诉讼，对在涉案土地上建造监视设施而不给予补偿的合宪性提出质疑。

法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. The construction and operation of the facility would not interfere with any use the owner is currently making of the entire tract of land, and therefore the owner would not be entitled to any compensation.
该设施的建造和运营不会干扰所有权人目前对整片土地的任何使用，因此所有权人无权获得任何补偿。

B. The construction of the facility would be a taking of the owner's property for which the owner must be compensated.
该设施的建造将构成对所有权人财产的征收，所有权人必须为此获得补偿。

C. The construction of the facility would be valid without any compensation, because it has been determined to be necessary to protect a compelling government interest in national security.
该设施的建造在没有任何补偿的情况下是有效的，因为它已被确定为保护国家安全这一强制性政府利益所必需。

D. The construction of the facility would single out the owner for adverse treatment in violation of the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment.
该设施的建造会使该所有权人受到不公平对待，违反了第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment) 的平等保护条款。
data.explanation:
Fifth Amendment takings


TypeAttributes
PhysicalPossession or permanent physical invasion of property
RegulatoryDeprivation of all economically beneficial uses
Restricts use under totality of circumstances:
  • character of government action
  • economic impact
  • reasonable investment-back expectations
ExactionCondition to obtain building/development permit
A physical taking occurs when the government permanently and physically occupies private property - regardless of the size of the property or how the owner has used it. And the Fifth Amendment takings clause bars the government from taking private property unless (1) the taking is for a public use and (2) the owner receives just compensation (ie, the property's fair market value).

Here, the federal government seeks to construct and operate a surveillance facility on the owner's land (permanent and physical occupation) to combat terrorism (public use). Although the facility will only occupy a small, unused portion of the owner's land and will not interfere with his use of the rest of the land, the government's action constitutes a taking (Choice A). Therefore, the court should rule that the owner is entitled to just compensation.

(Choice C) Almost all takings require just compensation - even when the taking is necessary to protect a compelling government interest (eg, national security). The only minor exception to this rule is an imminent public emergency. But since there is no indication that a terror attack is imminent, this exception does not apply.

(Choice D) This government action may trigger the equal protection component of the Fifth Amendment, which applies when the federal government treats similarly situated persons differently. But this component is not violated since the government action is rationally related to the government's legitimate interest in national security.

Educational objective: The Fifth Amendment takings clause bars the government from taking - eg, permanently and physically occupying - private property for public use without just compensation, regardless of the size or use of the property.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 82%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment) 的征收


类型特征
物理性征收占有或对财产的永久性物理侵占
管制性征收剥夺所有经济上有利的用途
在整体情况的考量下限制使用：
  • 政府行为的性质
  • 经济影响
  • 合理的投资回报预期
征收附加条件获得建筑/开发许可的条件
当政府永久性地物理占有私人财产时，即构成物理性征收——无论该财产的大小或所有权人的使用方式如何。第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment) 的征收条款禁止政府征收私人财产，除非 (1) 征收是出于公共用途，且 (2) 所有权人获得公正补偿（即财产的公平市场价值）。

在本案中，联邦政府试图在所有权人的土地上建造和运营一个监视设施（永久性物理占有），以打击恐怖主义（公共用途）。尽管该设施只会占据所有权人土地上一小块未使用的部分，并且不会干扰其对剩余土地的使用，但政府的行为构成了征收(选项 A)。因此，法院应裁定所有权人有权获得公正补偿。

(选项 C) 几乎所有征收都需要公正补偿——即使征收是为了保护强制性的政府利益（例如国家安全）所必需。此规则唯一的小例外是迫在眉睫的公共紧急情况。但由于没有迹象表明恐怖袭击迫在眉睫，因此该例外不适用。

(选项 D) 此政府行为可能触及第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment) 的平等保护条款，该条款适用于联邦政府对处境相似的个人给予不同对待的情况。但该条款并未被违反，因为政府的行为与政府在国家安全方面的合法利益具有理性关联。

教育目标：第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment) 的征收条款禁止政府为公共用途而征收（例如，永久性地物理占有）私人财产而不给予公正补偿，无论该财产的大小或用途如何。

References

Loretto v. Teleprompter Manhattan Catv Corp., 458 U.S. 419, 434 (1982) (holding that a permanent, physical invasion of private property by the government always constitutes a taking).

26 Am. Jur. 2d Eminent Domain § 10 (2019) (explaining permanent and physical occupation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：第五修正案征收条款

本题考查的是美国宪法第五修正案（Fifth Amendment）中的征收条款 (Takings Clause)，具体涉及物理性征收 (Physical Takings) 的核心规则。

核心法则 (The Rule):
根据第五修正案，私人财产不得在未给予公正补偿 (Just Compensation) 的情况下被征收用于公共用途 (Public Use)。

1. 判例依据：Loretto 规则

Loretto v. Teleprompter Manhattan CATV Corp. (1982)

最高法院在该案中确立了一个明确的规则（Bright-line rule）：

当政府对私人财产进行永久性的物理占有 (Permanent Physical Occupation) 时，无论占用的面积多么微小，也无论对财产所有人的经济影响多么微不足道，这都本身构成征收 (Per se taking)。

2. 案情分析

政府行为：
在私人土地上建造并运营监视设施。
性质判定：
这是一个永久性的物理入侵 (Permanent Physical Invasion)。政府不仅进入了土地，还建造了建筑物并长期占有。
干扰程度（陷阱）：
题目强调该设施只占用了“很小一部分”且“未使用的”土地，且“不干扰”其他用途。
注意：对于物理性征收，这些因素无关紧要。只要是物理占有，就必须补偿。

3. 为什么选 B？

选项 B 正确指出，该设施的建造构成了对所有权人财产的征收，因此必须给予补偿。

这是对 Loretto 规则的直接应用。既然构成了 Taking，宪法强制要求 Just Compensation。法规中“不予补偿”的条款是违宪的。

4. 排除错误选项

  • 选项 A (干扰程度): 错误。
    这是管制性征收 (Regulatory Taking) 的分析思路（如 Penn Central 测试，考量经济影响）。但在物理性征收中，哪怕只占用了 1 平方英尺，只要是永久性的，就是征收，无需考虑对整体土地使用的影响。
  • 选项 C (国家安全): 错误。
    “国家安全”可以满足公共用途 (Public Use) 的要求，使征收行为本身合法化，但它不能免除补偿义务。政府不能因为目的崇高就“白拿”私人财产。
    *注：唯一的例外是极端的“紧急避险”情况（如战时炸毁房屋防止敌人使用），但本题并未达到那种迫在眉睫的战争紧急状态 (Imminent public peril)。
  • 选项 D (平等保护): 错误。
    虽然可能涉及平等保护问题，但本题最直接、最致命的宪法缺陷是违反了征收条款。且政府基于国家安全筛选地点通常能通过合理性审查 (Rational Basis Review)。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip):
在 MBE 宪法题中，一旦看到政府“永久性地”在私人土地上“安装”、“建造”或“允许他人占用”某种物体（哪怕是电缆、盒子），立刻联想 Physical Taking。此时，无论经济损失多小，答案几乎总是：必须补偿 (Compensation Required)。
MBE Constitutional Law Review | QID: Q82152

questions.question:
A state court issued a gag order that prohibited the publication of information about a pending murder trial until the jury had been impaneled. The purpose of the order was to avoid pretrial publicity that would prejudice the criminal defendant's right to an impartial jury.
Several newspapers that sought to report about the trial's pretrial events challenged the order, arguing that it was unconstitutional.
Is the court's order likely constitutional?

choices.a: No, because the Sixth Amendment right to an impartial jury does not apply to state criminal prosecutions.
choices.b: No, because there are less restrictive means to guarantee the defendant's right to an impartial jury.
choices.c: Yes, because the court has a compelling interest in protecting the defendant's right to an impartial jury.
choices.d: Yes, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states plenary authority over state criminal prosecutions.

A state court issued a gag order that prohibited the publication of information about a pending murder trial until the jury had been impaneled. The purpose of the order was to avoid pretrial publicity that would prejudice the criminal defendant's right to an impartial jury.

Several newspapers that sought to report about the trial's pretrial events challenged the order, arguing that it was unconstitutional.

一个州法院发布了一项禁言令，禁止在陪审团组成前公布有关一宗待审谋杀案的信息。该命令的目的是为了避免审前报导，因为这种报导可能会损害刑事被告获得公正陪审团的权利。

几家试图报导该审判审前事件的报社对该命令提出质疑，主张其违宪。

该法院的命令是否可能合宪？
options:
A. No, because the Sixth Amendment right to an impartial jury does not apply to state criminal prosecutions.
不合宪，因为第六修正案中关于公正陪审团的权利不适用于州的刑事诉讼。

B. No, because there are less restrictive means to guarantee the defendant's right to an impartial jury.
不合宪，因为有其他限制性较小的方式可以保障被告获得公正陪审团的权利。

C. Yes, because the court has a compelling interest in protecting the defendant's right to an impartial jury.
合宪，因为法院在保护被告获得公正陪审团的权利方面拥有强烈的政府利益（compelling interest）。

D. Yes, because the Tenth Amendment reserves to the states plenary authority over state criminal prosecutions.
合宪，因为第十修正案将州刑事诉讼的全权（plenary authority）保留给了各州。
data.explanation:
The First Amendment freedom of the press generally prohibits the government from restricting the right to publish lawfully obtained, truthful information about matters of public significance. A government action that abridges this right is presumptively unconstitutional and must survive strict scrutiny. This requires the government to prove that its action was the least restrictive means (ie, narrowly tailored) to achieve a compelling government interest.

A gag order is a judicial order that prohibits the press from reporting about court proceedings, which abridges the freedom of the press. Here, the state court likely has a compelling interest in ensuring that the criminal defendant is afforded the right to an impartial jury. However, the court has less restrictive means to achieve this interest - eg, changing the trial's venue, postponing the trial, or intensely questioning prospective jurors during voir dire (Choice C). Therefore, the court's order cannot survive strict scrutiny and is likely unconstitutional.

(Choice A) The Sixth Amendment guarantees the right to an impartial jury in federal criminal prosecutions and in state criminal prosecutions through the due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

(Choice D) The Tenth Amendment reserves to the states any power that the Constitution does not expressly grant to the federal government, including power over state criminal prosecutions. However, this power is not plenary (ie, absolute) because states must comply with other constitutional provisions.

Educational objective: A government action that abridges the First Amendment freedom of the press (eg, a gag order) must survive strict scrutiny, which requires the government to prove that its action was the least restrictive means to achieve a compelling government interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 62%（正确选项），C选项 35%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

第一修正案的新闻自由（freedom of the press）通常禁止政府限制发布合法获取的、关于具有公共重要性事宜的真实信息之权利。一项削减此项权利的政府行为是推定违宪（presumptively unconstitutional）的，并且必须通过严格审查（strict scrutiny）。这要求政府证明其行为是为达成强烈的政府利益（compelling government interest）所采取的限制性最小的手段（least restrictive means）（即，狭义限定的）。

禁言令是一项禁止媒体报导法院程序的司法命令，它削减了新闻自由。在此案中，州法院在确保刑事被告获得公正陪审团的权利方面，可能具有强烈的政府利益。然而，法院有其他限制性较小的方式来达成此利益——例如，更换审判地点、推迟审判、或在陪审员遴选（voir dire）期间对潜在陪审员进行深入质询（选项C）。因此，该法院的命令无法通过严格审查，并可能被认定为违宪。

（选项A）第六修正案保障了在联邦刑事诉讼中的公正陪审团权利，并通过第十四修正案的正当程序条款（due process clause）将该权利适用于州的刑事诉讼。

（选项D）第十修正案将宪法未明确授予联邦政府的任何权力保留给各州，包括对州刑事诉讼的权力。然而，这项权力并非全权（即，绝对的），因为各州必须遵守其他宪法规定。

教学目标：一项削减第一修正案新闻自由（例如，禁言令）的政府行为必须通过严格审查（strict scrutiny），这要求政府证明其行为是为达成强烈的政府利益（compelling government interest）所采取的限制性最小的手段（least restrictive means）。

References

Neb. Press Ass'n v. Stuart, 427 U.S. 539, 563 - 64 (1976) (explaining that a court has other means short of a gag order to achieve its compelling government interest in ensuring a criminal defendant's right to a fair trial).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law | First Amendment
核心法律原则
本题考察的是第一修正案中的事前限制 (Prior Restraint) 与第六修正案公正审判权 (Right to a Fair Trial) 之间的冲突。
关键规则：
法院发布的禁止媒体报道的“禁言令” (Gag Order) 属于对言论的事前限制。在宪法学中，事前限制被认为是“最严重且最不可容忍”的侵权形式，因此具有违宪的强烈推定 (Heavy Presumption Against Constitutionality)。
判例依据 (Case Law)
Nebraska Press Association v. Stuart (1976)
最高法院裁定，虽然刑事被告享有获得公正陪审团的权利，但法院不能轻易禁止媒体报道合法获取的公开信息。
深度解析正确答案 (B)
要使针对媒体的禁言令合宪，政府必须通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。这要求证明：
  1. 存在强烈的政府利益 (Compelling Interest)（例如保护被告获得公正审判的权利）；且
  2. 该命令是实现该利益的限制性最小的手段 (Least Restrictive Means)。
为什么选 B？
虽然保护被告的权利是“强烈的政府利益”，但法院几乎总是有限制性较小的替代方案来防止陪审团受到偏见影响，而无需直接封杀新闻报道。

常见的替代方案包括：
  • 更换审判地点 (Change of Venue)： 将案件移至受舆论影响较小的地区。
  • 延期审判 (Postponement/Continuance)： 等待舆论平息。
  • 陪审员遴选质询 (Voir Dire)： 仔细询问潜在陪审员以剔除有偏见者。
  • 隔离陪审团 (Sequestration of the Jury)： 审判期间将陪审员与外界隔绝。
因为存在这些替代手段，法院直接发布禁言令并非“限制性最小的手段”，因此违宪。
干扰项陷阱
选项 A 错误： Incorporation Doctrine（纳入原则）。第六修正案通过第十四修正案的正当程序条款适用于各州。州法院必须保障公正陪审团，但这不能作为无视第一修正案的理由。
选项 C 错误： 这是一个典型的“半对半错”选项。法院确实有 Compelling Interest（强烈的利益），但这只是严格审查的第一步。如果手段（禁言令）不是Narrowly Tailored（狭义限定）或Least Restrictive（限制最小），依然违宪。
选项 D 错误： 第十修正案（州权保留）不能凌驾于权利法案（Bill of Rights）之上。当州行使警察权（Police Power）进行刑事诉讼时，仍必须遵守第一修正案。
MBE 实战技巧
看到 "Gag Order" (禁言令) 针对媒体：
在 MBE 考试中，如果题目涉及法院禁止媒体报道合法获取的公开信息，答案几乎永远是违宪 (Unconstitutional)。法院应当控制的是律师、证人和法院工作人员的行为，或者是控制陪审团，而不是控制新闻界。

questions.question:
Twenty percent of a city's residents are members of minority racial groups. These residents are evenly distributed among the many different residential areas of the city. The five city council members of the city are elected from five single-member electoral districts that are nearly equally populated. No member of a minority racial group has ever been elected to the city council.
A group of citizens who are members of minority racial groups files suit in federal district court seeking a declaratory judgment that the single-member districts in the city are unconstitutional. The group claims that the single-member districting system in that city diminishes the ability of voters who are members of minority racial groups to affect the outcome of city elections. The group seeks an order from the court forcing the city to adopt an at-large election system in which the five candidates with the greatest vote totals would be elected to the city council. No state or federal statutes are applicable to the resolution of this suit.
Which of the following constitutional provisions provides the most obvious basis for the group's claim in this suit?

choices.a: The due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.b: The Fifteenth Amendment.
choices.c: The privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.d: The Thirteenth Amendment.

The five city council members of the city are elected from five single-member electoral districts that are nearly equally populated. A group of citizens who are members of minority racial groups files suit in federal district court seeking a declaratory judgment that the single- member districts in the city are unconstitutional. The group claims that the single-member districting system in that city diminishes the ability of voters who are members of minority racial groups to affect the outcome of city elections. The group seeks an order from the court forcing the city to adopt an at-large election system in which the five candidates with the greatest vote totals would be elected to the city council. No state or federal statutes are applicable to the resolution of this suit.

Which of the following constitutional provisions provides the most obvious basis for the group's claim in this suit?

某市百分之二十的居民是少数族裔群体成员。这些居民平均分布在该市的许多不同居住区。该市的五名市议会成员是从五个人口几乎相等的单一议员选区选举产生的。从未有少数族裔群体的成员当选为市议会议员。

一群属于少数族裔群体的公民向联邦地区法院提起诉讼，请求作出宣告性判决，认定该市的单一议员选区违宪。该团体声称，该市的单一议员选区制度削弱了属于少数族裔群体的选民影响市选举结果的能力。该团体请求法院下达命令，强制该市采用整体选区选举制，即得票总数最高的五名候选人将当选为市议会议员。没有州或联邦成文法适用于本案的解决。

以下哪项宪法条款为该团体在本案中的主张提供了最明显的依据？
options:
A. The due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
Fourteenth Amendment 的正当程序条款。

B. The Fifteenth Amendment.
Fifteenth Amendment。

C. The privileges or immunities clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
Fourteenth Amendment 的特权或豁免条款。

D. The Thirteenth Amendment.
Thirteenth Amendment。
data.explanation:
Voting protections


14th AmendmentProhibits substantial impairment of voting rights
15th AmendmentProhibits denial or abridgment of voting rights based on race, color, previous servitude
19th AmendmentProhibits denial or abridgment of voting rights based on sex
24th AmendmentAbolishes poll taxes
26th AmendmentEstablishes right to vote at 18 years old
The Fifteenth Amendment prohibits state and federal governments from abridging the right to vote - which includes the right to have that vote meaningfully counted - on the basis of race, color, or previous condition of servitude. As a result, the Fifteenth Amendment provides a basis to challenge both:
  • direct limitations on the ability to register to vote or cast a ballot (eg, only whites are allowed to vote) and
  • dilutions of voting power (eg, districting system purposely limits minority voters' ability to affect election outcomes).

Here, the group of citizens is challenging the city's districting system on the ground that it diminishes the ability of racial minority voters to affect the outcome of city elections. Since this alleges dilution of voting power based on race, the Fifteenth Amendment provides the most obvious basis for the group's claim.

(Choice A) The group could base its claim on the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause, which prohibits states from infringing upon a life, liberty, or property interest (eg, the right to vote) without adequate justification. But since the Fifteenth Amendment specifically prohibits a denial of voting rights based on race (as alleged here), it provides a more obvious basis for the group's claim.

(Choice C) The Fourteenth Amendment privileges or immunities clause prohibits states from interfering with the very limited rights of national citizenship - eg, the right to vote for national offices. But since the group's claim concerns city council elections, no right of national citizenship is at stake.

(Choice D) The Thirteenth Amendment prohibits both government and private actors from engaging in slavery or involuntary servitude - neither of which is at issue here.

Educational objective: The Fifteenth Amendment prohibits state and federal governments from abridging the right to vote - by direct limitation or diluting voting power - on the basis of race, color, or previous condition of servitude.

选项正确率统计：A选项 34%，B选项 47%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

投票权保护


14th Amendment禁止对投票权造成实质性损害
15th Amendment禁止基于种族、肤色或先前的奴役状况而剥夺或削弱投票权
19th Amendment禁止基于性别而剥夺或削弱投票权
24th Amendment废除人头税
26th Amendment确立18岁公民的投票权
Fifteenth Amendment 禁止州和联邦政府基于种族、肤色或先前的奴役状况而削弱投票权——这包括使投票得到有意义计数的权利。因此，Fifteenth Amendment 为挑战以下两种情况提供了依据：
  • 对登记投票或投下选票的能力的直接限制（例如，只允许白人投票）以及
  • 稀释投票权（例如，选区划分制度故意限制少数族裔选民影响选举结果的能力）。

在本案中，该公民团体挑战该市的选区划分制度，理由是该制度削弱了少数族裔选民影响市选举结果的能力。由于这主张了基于种族的投票权稀释，Fifteenth Amendment 为该团体的主张提供了最明显的依据。

(选项 A) 该团体可以将其主张建立在 Fourteenth Amendment 的正当程序条款之上，该条款禁止州在没有充分理由的情况下侵犯生命、自由或财产利益（例如，投票权）。但是，由于 Fifteenth Amendment 明确禁止基于种族（如本案所主张的）剥夺投票权，因此它为该团体的主张提供了更明显的依据。

(选项 C) Fourteenth Amendment 的特权或豁免条款禁止州干涉非常有限的国民公民权——例如，选举国家公职的权利。但是，由于该团体的主张涉及市议会选举，因此不涉及国民公民权。

(选项 D) Thirteenth Amendment 禁止政府和私人行为者从事奴役或非自愿劳役——这两者在本案中均不涉及。

教学目标：Fifteenth Amendment 禁止州和联邦政府基于种族、肤色或先前的奴役状况，通过直接限制或稀释投票权的方式，来削弱投票权。

References

Allen v. State Bd. of Elections, 393 U.S. 544, 569 (1969) (explaining that the "right to vote can be affected by a dilution of voting power as well as by an absolute prohibition on casting a ballot").

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: Voting Rights
核心考点：第十五修正案 (15th Amendment) 宪法第十五修正案明确规定：美国公民的投票权，不得因种族 (Race)、肤色或以前的奴役状况而被合众国或任何一州拒绝或削弱 (Abridged)。
题目逻辑分析

本题的核心在于寻找原告主张的宪法依据。我们需要将案件事实与最匹配的宪法条款对应起来。

案件事实：原告是少数族裔群体 (Minority racial groups)。他们声称现有的单一选区制度 (Single-member districts) 削弱了他们基于种族影响选举结果的能力。

推理步骤：

  1. 权利受损类型：涉及的是投票权 (Voting Rights) 的有效性/影响力。
  2. 受损原因：基于种族 (Based on Race)。
  3. 法律匹配：虽然第十四修正案 (14th Amendment) 的平等保护条款 (Equal Protection) 也常用于处理种族歧视问题，但第十五修正案 (15th Amendment) 是专门针对“基于种族的投票权剥夺或削弱”的条款。
  4. 关键词匹配：题目中没有成文法 (Statutes) 适用，因此必须直接引用宪法。第十五修正案中的 "Abridged" (削弱/缩减) 一词，涵盖了投票权稀释 (Vote Dilution) 的情况，即虽然能投票，但选票的影响力被系统性降低。

因此，选项 B (The Fifteenth Amendment) 是最直接、最明显的依据。

为什么其他选项不佳？
选项 A (14th Am. Due Process):
正当程序条款通常涉及剥夺生命、自由或财产的程序公正性，或者涉及隐私权等实质性权利。虽然投票是基本权利，但当涉及种族歧视时，第15修正案比第14修正案的正当程序条款更具体、更贴切。
选项 C (14th Am. P&I Clause):
第十四修正案的特权或豁免条款 (Privileges or Immunities Clause) 在法律史上几乎被架空（参见 Slaughter-House Cases）。它仅保护极其有限的联邦公民权利（如跨州迁徙），不适用于地方选举制度的挑战。
选项 D (13th Amendment):
第十三修正案废除了奴隶制。虽然它禁止“奴隶制的标志和后果” (Badges and incidents of slavery)，但对于现代选举选区划分的挑战来说，这并不是一个直接或常规的法律依据。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 当题目中同时出现 "Race" (种族) 和 "Voting" (投票) 这两个要素时：
  • 首选依据通常是 15th Amendment。
  • 如果选项中没有 15th Amendment，次选通常是 14th Amendment Equal Protection Clause (平等保护条款)。
  • 注意题目问的是“最明显的依据” (Most obvious basis)，这意味着要找最专门针对该问题的条款。

questions.question:
The open-air amphitheater in a city park has been utilized for concerts and other entertainment programs. Until this year, each of the groups performing in that city facility was allowed to make its own arrangements for sound equipment and sound technicians.
After recurring complaints from occupants of residential buildings adjacent to the city park about intrusive noise from some performances held in the amphitheater, the city council passed an ordinance establishing city control over all sound amplification at all programs held there. The ordinance provided that the city's parks department would be the sole provider in the amphitheater of sound amplification equipment and of the technicians to operate the equipment "to ensure a proper balance between the quality of the sound at such performances and respect for the privacy of nearby residential neighbors."
Which of the following standards should a court use to determine the constitutionality on its face of this content-neutral ordinance?

choices.a: The ordinance is narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of expression.
choices.b: The ordinance is rationally related to a legitimate government interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of expression.
choices.c: The ordinance is rationally related to a legitimate government interest and restricts the expressive rights involved no more than is reasonable under the circumstances.
choices.d: The ordinance is substantially related to a legitimate governmental interest and restricts the expressive rights involved no more than is reasonable in light of the surrounding circumstances.

某城市公园内的一个露天剧场一直被用于举办音乐会及其他娱乐节目。直到今年，每个在该市设施中表演的团体都被允许自行安排音响设备和音响技术人员。

由于邻近城市公园的住宅楼居民反复投诉，称剧场举行的某些表演噪音扰人，市议会通过了一项法令，规定由市政府控制所有在场节目中的扩音设备。该法令规定，市公园管理部门将是剧场内扩音设备及操作设备技术人员的唯一提供者，“以确保在此类表演中的音质与尊重附近居民的隐私之间取得适当平衡。”

法院应采用下列哪项标准来判定这项内容中立（content-neutral）法令的表面合宪性？
options:
A. The ordinance is narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of expression.
该法令经过精准制定，以服务于一项重大的政府利益，并且未不合理地限制其他的表达途径。

B. The ordinance is rationally related to a legitimate government interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of expression.
该法令与一项合法的政府利益有合理关联，并且未不合理地限制其他的表达途径。

C. The ordinance is rationally related to a legitimate government interest and restricts the expressive rights involved no more than is reasonable under the circumstances.
该法令与一项合法的政府利益有合理关联，并且在当时情况下，对所涉表达权的限制未超过合理范围。

D. The ordinance is substantially related to a legitimate governmental interest and restricts the expressive rights involved no more than is reasonable in light of the surrounding circumstances.
该法令与一项合法的政府利益有实质性关联，并且参照当时情况，对所涉表达权的限制未超过合理范围。
data.explanation:
The First Amendment primarily protects speech against content-based regulations (ie, restrictions on what is said). And though the government has more latitude to impose content-neutral regulations (ie, time, place, or manner restrictions ), such regulations are still subject to constitutional review. And in a public forum (as seen here), the government may only impose time, place, or manner restrictions if they are narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and leave open ample alternative channels of communication.

Here, the city ordinance regulates the manner of performances in the city park by requiring all performers to use city-provided sound equipment and technicians. This content-neutral ordinance is only valid if it is narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of expression. Therefore, the court should use this standard to determine the ordinance's constitutionality (Choices B, C, & D).

Educational objective: In a public forum, the government's time, place, or manner restrictions on speech must:
  • be narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and
  • leave open ample alternative channels of communication.




选项正确率统计：A选项 38%（正确选项），B选项 30%，C选项 15%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

美国宪法第一修正案主要保护言论免受基于内容的规制（即对言论内容的限制）。尽管政府在施加内容中立的规制（即对时间、地点或方式的限制）方面有更大的自由裁量权，但此类规制仍需接受合宪性审查。在一个公共论坛（如本案所示）中，政府只有在时间、地点或方式的限制是经过精准制定以服务于重大的政府利益并且保留了充足的其他沟通渠道的情况下，才能施加这些限制。

在此案中，市法令通过要求所有表演者使用市政府提供的音响设备和技术人员，规制了在城市公园内表演的方式。这项内容中立的法令只有在经过精准制定以服务于重大的政府利益，且未不合理地限制其他表达途径的情况下才有效。因此，法院应使用此标准来判定该法令的合宪性（因此选项B、C和D是错误的）。

教学目标：在一个公共论坛中，政府对言论施加的时间、地点或方式的限制必须：
  • 经过精准制定以服务于重大的政府利益，并且
  • 保留充足的其他沟通渠道。


References

Ward v. Rock Against Racism, 491 U.S. 781, 791 (1989) (setting forth the test for determining the validity of government restrictions on the time, place, or manner of protected speech in a public forum).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law: First Amendment
Topic: Time, Place, and Manner Restrictions

本题考察的是美国宪法第一修正案中，政府在公共论坛 (Public Forum) 对言论进行内容中立 (Content-Neutral) 规制时必须遵循的审查标准。

⚖️ 法律规则：TPM 限制标准

在公共论坛（如公园、街道）中，政府可以对言论的时间、地点和方式 (Time, Place, and Manner, TPM) 进行限制，但必须满足以下三个条件：

1. 内容中立 (Content-Neutral)：
规制不得基于言论的内容或观点。
2. 精准制定以服务于重大的政府利益 (Narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest)：
利益必须是“重大的”(Substantial)，而非仅仅是“合法的”(Legitimate)。
3. 保留充足的替代性沟通渠道 (Leave open ample alternative channels of communication)。
🔍 题目解析

1. 场所定性：
题目中的露天剧场位于城市公园内，属于典型的传统公共论坛 (Traditional Public Forum)。

2. 规制性质：
该法令是为了控制噪音（"intrusive noise"），适用于所有表演者，不针对特定信息，因此是内容中立 (Content-Neutral) 的。

3. 正确选项分析 (Choice A)：
选项 A 完整且准确地复述了上述法律标准。它要求法令必须是“narrowly tailored”（精准制定）且服务于“substantial interest”（重大权益）。

4. 错误选项排除：

  • 选项 B & C (Rational Basis)： 提到了 "Legitimate interest"（合法利益）和 "Rationally related"（合理相关）。这是合理性审查 (Rational Basis Review) 的标准，对于第一修正案的言论限制来说，这个标准太低了。
  • 选项 D： 混淆了术语，且标准描述不准确。

📚 经典判例：Ward v. Rock Against Racism (1989)

本题的案情几乎直接取自 Ward 案。在该案中，纽约市要求中央公园露天剧场的表演者使用市政府提供的音响设备和技术人员，以控制噪音。

最高法院裁定：该规定合宪。法院强调，只要规制手段能有效促进政府的重大实质利益（控制噪音），且不至于限制过多的言论，即符合“精准制定”的要求，不需要证明该手段是“限制最小的手段” (Least Restrictive Means)。

考试技巧： 看到“Public Forum”和“Content-Neutral”，立即寻找包含 "Narrowly Tailored", "Substantial Interest", 和 "Alternative Channels" 的选项。

questions.question:
A state wanted to prevent its only major league baseball team, which was privately owned and operated, from moving to a rival state. After a heated political debate in the legislature, the state enacted legislation providing for a one-time grant of $10 million in state funds to the team to cover part of the projected income losses the team would suffer during the next five years if it remained in that state. The legislation required that the team remain in the state for at least ten years if it accepted the grant.
After accepting the grant, the team owners decided to build a new $150 million stadium in the state. As plans for the construction of the new stadium proceeded, it became evident that all of the contractors and subcontractors would be white males, and that they had been chosen by the team owners without any public bids because these contractors and subcontractors had successfully built the only other new baseball stadium in the region.
Several contractors who were females or members of minority racial groups filed suit against the team owners in federal district court to compel public solicitation of bids for the construction of the team's new stadium on an equal opportunity basis, and to enjoin construction of the stadium until compliance was ensured. Their only claim was that the contracting practices of the team owners denied them the equal protection of the laws in violation of the Fourteenth Amendment.
In this suit, what will the court probably rule?

choices.a: In the absence of additional evidence of state involvement in the operations or decisions of the team owners, a one-time grant of state monies to them is insufficient to warrant treating their actions as subject to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.b: The intense public preoccupation with the activities of major league baseball teams coupled with the fact that baseball is considered a national pastime is sufficient to justify application of the Fourteenth Amendment to the activities of major league teams.
choices.c: The issues presented by this case are nonjusticiable political questions because there is a lack of judicially manageable standards to resolve them and the court is likely to be deeply involved in partisan politics.
choices.d: The nexus between the actions of the team owners and the one-time grant of monies to them by the state is sufficiently substantial to subject their actions to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.

一个州希望阻止其唯一一支由私人拥有和运营的职业棒球大联盟球队迁往竞争州。经过议会激烈的政治辩论，该州颁布了一项法案，向该球队一次性拨款1000万美元的州政府资金，以弥补如果该球队未来五年内继续留在该州将遭受的部分预期收入损失。该法案要求，如果球队接受这笔拨款，则必须在该州停留至少十年。

接受拨款后，球队所有者决定在该州耗资1.5亿美元建造一座新体育场。随着新体育场建设计划的推进，情况变得明朗，所有的承包商和分包商都是白人男性，他们是由球队所有者在未经任何公开招标的情况下挑选的，因为这些承包商和分包商曾成功建造了该地区唯一另一座新棒球场。

几名女性或少数族裔承包商向联邦地方法院对球队所有者提起诉讼，要求在平等机会的基础上，为球队新体育场的建设进行公开招标，并在确保合规前，禁止体育场的建设。他们唯一的诉求是，球队所有者的承包行为违反了Fourteenth Amendment，剥夺了他们受法律平等保护的权利。

在本案中，法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. In the absence of additional evidence of state involvement in the operations or decisions of the team owners, a one-time grant of state monies to them is insufficient to warrant treating their actions as subject to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.
在没有额外证据表明州政府参与了球队所有者的运营或决策的情况下，向他们提供的一次性州政府资金不足以使其行为受到Fourteenth Amendment的限制。

B. The intense public preoccupation with the activities of major league baseball teams coupled with the fact that baseball is considered a national pastime is sufficient to justify application of the Fourteenth Amendment to the activities of major league teams.
公众对职业棒球大联盟球队活动的强烈关注，加上棒球被视为一项全国性的消遣活动，足以成为将Fourteenth Amendment适用于职业棒球队活动的理由。

C. The issues presented by this case are nonjusticiable political questions because there is a lack of judicially manageable standards to resolve them and the court is likely to be deeply involved in partisan politics.
本案提出的问题是不可由司法裁决的政治问题，因为缺乏可由司法管理的标准来解决这些问题，并且法院很可能深陷党派政治之中。

D. The nexus between the actions of the team owners and the one-time grant of monies to them by the state is sufficiently substantial to subject their actions to the limitations of the Fourteenth Amendment.
球队所有者的行为与州政府向其提供的一次性拨款之间的关联足够重大，足以使其行为受到Fourteenth Amendment的限制。
data.explanation:
State-action doctrine


Traditional government functionPrivate actor performs traditional & exclusive government function (eg, running elections)
Significant government involvement
  • Government & private actor have mutually beneficial relationship (eg, joint activity or venture)
  • Government creates nexus by affirmatively facilitating or authorizing private action (eg, police officer acting under color of law)
  • Government is pervasively intertwined in private entity's management or control
The Constitution generally limits government actors. But under the state-action doctrine, a private actor is considered a government actor - and similarly bound by the Constitution - when (1) the private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or (2) the government is significantly involved in the private actor's activities. Therefore, the contractors can only challenge the private baseball team owners' discriminatory contracting practices on equal protection grounds if the state-action doctrine applies.

Here, the team owners are not performing a traditional and exclusive government function by building a baseball stadium. And though they received a one-time grant of state funds, government funding - however substantial - is insufficient to convert private conduct into state action (Choice D). Therefore, in the absence of additional evidence of significant state involvement in the team owners' operations or decisions, the court will probably rule that the team owners' actions are not subject to the Fourteenth Amendment.

(Choice B) Although major league baseball is a national pastime that intensely preoccupies the public, it is not a traditional government function that would trigger the state-action doctrine.

(Choice C) The political-question doctrine bars federal courts from hearing cases that present issues that (1) are reserved for the executive or legislative branches or (2) lack judicially manageable standards for resolution. But since courts often resolve equal protection claims involving discriminatory executive or legislative policies - without becoming involved in partisan politics - this doctrine does not apply.

Educational objective: The Constitution generally applies to government actors - not private actors. But under the state-action doctrine, a private actor will be treated as a government actor when (1) the private actor performs a traditional and exclusive government function or (2) the government is significantly involved in the private actor's activities.

选项正确率统计：A选项 83%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 2%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

州政府行为原则


传统的政府职能私人行为者履行传统且专属的政府职能（例如，组织选举）
重大的政府参与
  • 政府与私人行为者之间存在互利关系（例如，联合活动或合资企业）
  • 政府通过积极促进或授权私人行为来建立关联（例如，警官依法行事）
  • 政府普遍地交织在私人实体的管理或控制中
宪法通常只约束政府行为者。但根据州政府行为原则（state-action doctrine），当(1)私人行为者履行传统且专属的政府职能或(2)政府重大参与私人行为者的活动时，该私人行为者被视为政府行为者，并同样受宪法约束。因此，只有在州政府行为原则适用的情况下，承包商才能以平等保护为由，挑战私人棒球队所有者的歧视性承包行为。

在本案中，球队所有者建造棒球场并非在履行传统且专属的政府职能。而且，尽管他们获得了一次性的州政府资金拨款，但政府资助——无论多么巨大——都不足以将私人行为转变为州政府行为（选项D）。因此，在没有额外证据表明州政府重大参与了球队所有者的运营或决策的情况下，法院可能会裁定，球队所有者的行为不受Fourteenth Amendment的约束。

（选项B）尽管职业棒球大联盟是一项吸引公众强烈关注的全国性消遣活动，但这并非一项能够触发州政府行为原则的传统政府职能。

（选项C）政治问题原则（political-question doctrine）禁止联邦法院审理那些(1)属于行政或立法部门专属管辖，或(2)缺乏可由司法管理的解决标准的案件。但是，由于法院经常在不卷入党派政治的情况下解决涉及歧视性行政或立法政策的平等保护诉求，因此该原则不适用。

教学目标：宪法通常适用于政府行为者，而非私人行为者。但根据州政府行为原则，当(1)私人行为者履行传统且专属的政府职能，或(2)政府重大参与私人行为者的活动时，该私人行为者将被视为政府行为者。

References

Brentwood Acad. v. Tenn. Secondary Sch. Athletic Ass'n, 531 U.S. 288, 296 - 98 (2001) (listing scenarios in which the state-action doctrine is applied).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law / State Action
核心考点：州政府行为原则 (State Action Doctrine)

美国宪法第十四修正案（14th Amendment）的平等保护条款（Equal Protection Clause）通常只限制政府行为，不限制私人行为。

私人行为只有在极少数情况下才会被视为“州政府行为”：

  1. 公共职能 (Public Function)： 私人实体行使了传统上由政府专属的职能（如管理选举）。
  2. 纠缠/关联 (Entanglement/Nexus)： 政府肯定地授权、鼓励或促进了该违宪行为。
本案深度解析

本题的核心在于判断：接受政府拨款的私人球队，是否因此变成了“州政府行为者”？

1. 资金资助原则：

最高法院的判例（如 Rendell-Baker v. Kohn）明确指出，仅仅从政府接受资金（哪怕是巨额资金或主要收入来源），并不足以将私人实体的行为转化为州政府行为。

2. 缺乏因果联系 (Nexus)：

要构成州政府行为，政府的参与必须与被挑战的具体行为（即歧视性雇佣）有直接关联。在本案中：

  • 州政府给了钱是为了让球队“留下来”。
  • 州政府没有参与选择承包商的决策。
  • 歧视行为完全是私人球队所有者的独立决定。

因此，因为缺乏政府对歧视行为的直接参与或强制，球队仍被视为私人行为者，不受第十四修正案约束。

选项判读
正确 A 理由： 正确阐述了法律规则。除非有证据表明州政府直接参与了球队的运营或决策（特别是雇佣决策），否则单纯的“一次性拨款”不足以触发宪法限制。
错误 B 理由： “公众关注”或“国家消遣”不是法律标准。虽然棒球很重要，但它不是“传统且专属的政府职能”（如警务、选举）。
错误 C 理由： 这不是“政治问题”（Political Question）。法院经常审理涉及种族歧视和政府合同的案件，这完全在司法管辖范围内。
错误 D 理由： 这是最具迷惑性的干扰项。虽然有拨款，但拨款与“歧视性雇佣”之间缺乏逻辑关联 (Nexus)。如果州政府规定“必须雇佣白人才能拿钱”，那就是州政府行为；但这里州政府只是给钱，并未干预雇佣。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：

遇到“私人实体歧视”的题目，首先默认宪法不适用。

只有当题目明确出现以下情况时才选“适用宪法”：
1. 私人实体在做只有政府才做的事（如经营小镇、选举）。
2. 政府强制或显著鼓励了该歧视行为（不仅仅是发执照或给钱）。

记住口诀：License + Money ≠ State Action（发牌照+给钱不等于州政府行为）。

questions.question:
A city enacted an ordinance banning from its public sidewalks all machines dispensing publications consisting wholly of commercial advertisements. The ordinance was enacted because of a concern about the adverse aesthetic effects of litter from publications distributed on the public sidewalks and streets. However, the city continued to allow machines dispensing other types of publications on the public sidewalks. As a result of the ordinance, 30 of the 300 sidewalk machines that were dispensing publications in the city were removed.
Is this ordinance constitutional?

choices.a: No, because it does not constitute the least restrictive means with which to protect the aesthetics of the city's sidewalks and streets.
choices.b: No, because there is not a reasonable fit between the city's legitimate interest in preserving the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets and the means it chose to advance that interest.
choices.c: Yes, because regulations of commercial speech are subject only to the requirement that they be rationally related to a legitimate state goal, and that requirement is satisfied here.
choices.d: Yes, because the city has a compelling interest in protecting the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets, and such a ban is necessary to vindicate this interest.

questions.sourceExplanationHtml:
Commercial speech商业言论：以商业交易为主要目的的言论，如广告、推销等。 is protected by the First Amendment so long as it concerns lawful activity and is not false or misleading. As a result, the government can only regulate protected commercial speech if the government proves that its regulation (1) directly advances直接促进：政府的限制手段必须能切实解决其声称的问题，而非间接或微乎其微。 a substantial government interest实质性政府利益：政府必须证明其规制旨在实现一个重要且合法的行政目标。 and (2) is not more extensive than necessary不超过必要的范围：规制范围必须合理适度，不能过度限制合法的言论。 to serve that interest. The second element is met if there is a reasonable fit合理匹配：手段与目的之间必须成比例，虽然不要求是限制最少的手段，但必须是合理的设计。 between the means chosen and the interest served.

Here, a city ordinance banned all sidewalk machines dispensing solely commercial advertisements. The ordinance directly advances the city's legitimate (and likely substantial) interest in preserving the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets. But there is no reasonable fit between that interest and the means chosen to advance it since only 30 of the 300 machines were removed and there is no indication that the advertisements generate more litter than other publications. Therefore, the ordinance is unconstitutional.

(Choice A) In the context of commercial speech, "no more extensive than necessary" does not mean the least restrictive means限制最少的方式：严格审查标准下的要求，即政府必须证明没有任何其他对权利限制更小的手段能实现同样目的。 available. Instead, it means that there must be a reasonable fit between the relevant government interest and the means chosen to achieve it. And since there is no reasonable fit here, the ordinance is invalid.

(Choice C) Rational basis review合理基础审查：美国宪法中最宽松的司法审查标准，仅要求法律与合法的政府目标有合理关联。—which merely requires that a government regulation be rationally related to a legitimate government interest—does not apply to commercial speech.

(Choice D) Strict scrutiny严格审查：美国宪法中最严厉的司法审查标准，要求政府证明法律是实现迫切利益的必不可少的、限制最少的手段。 would require the city to prove that its ordinance is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest迫切政府利益：极高标准的政府利益，如国家安全、生命安全等。. But this stringent standard of review does not apply here. And if it did, the ordinance would fail since it cannot even meet the lower standard applicable to commercial speech.

📌 Educational Objective

Government regulations of protected commercial speech must (1) directly advance a substantial government interest and (2) not be more extensive than necessary to serve that interest. The second element is met if there is a reasonable fit between the government interest and the means chosen to achieve it.

📚 References
  • Bd. of Trs. of State Univ. of N. Y. v. Fox, 492 U.S. 469, 480 (1989) (explaining that government restrictions on protected commercial speech must have a reasonable fit between means and end).
  • Cincinnati v. Discovery Network, 507 U.S. 410, 424–25 (1993) (finding that there was no reasonable fit between city's ban only of commercial news racks and city's interest in sidewalk aesthetics).

Q82151

A city enacted an ordinance banning from its public sidewalks all machines dispensing publications consisting wholly of commercial advertisements. The ordinance was enacted because of a concern about the adverse aesthetic effects of litter from publications distributed on the public sidewalks and streets. However, the city continued to allow machines dispensing other types of publications on the public sidewalks. As a result of the ordinance, 30 of the 300 sidewalk machines that were dispensing publications in the city were removed.

Is this ordinance constitutional?

某市颁布了一项法令，禁止在其公共人行道上放置所有完全由商业广告构成的出版物分发机。该法令的颁布是出于对公共人行道和街道上分发的出版物所产生的垃圾对市容造成不利影响的担忧。然而，该市继续允许在公共人行道上放置分发其他类型出版物的机器。由于该法令的实施，该市300台人行道出版物分发机中有30台被移除。

该法令是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because it does not constitute the least restrictive means with which to protect the aesthetics of the city's sidewalks and streets.
否，因为它不构成保护该市人行道和街道市容的限制最少的方式。

B. No, because there is not a reasonable fit between the city's legitimate interest in preserving the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets and the means it chose to advance that interest.
否，因为在该市维护其人行道和街道市容的合法利益与其为促进该利益所选择的方式之间，缺乏合理的匹配。

C. Yes, because regulations of commercial speech are subject only to the requirement that they be rationally related to a legitimate state goal, and that requirement is satisfied here.
是，因为对商业言论的规制仅需满足与合法的州目标有合理关联的要求，而在此案中该要求已得到满足。

D. Yes, because the city has a compelling interest in protecting the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets, and such a ban is necessary to vindicate this interest.
是，因为该市在保护其人行道和街道市容方面有迫切利益，且此项禁令对于维护该利益是必要的。
data.explanation:
Commercial speech is protected by the First Amendment so long as it concerns lawful activity and is not false or misleading. As a result, the government can only regulate protected commercial speech if the government proves that its regulation
  • directly advances a substantial government interest and
  • is not more extensive than necessary to serve that interest.
The second element is met if there is a reasonable fit between the means chosen and the interest served.

Here, a city ordinance banned all sidewalk machines dispensing solely commercial advertisements. The ordinance directly advances the city's legitimate (and likely substantial) interest in preserving the aesthetics of its sidewalks and streets. But there is no reasonable fit between that interest and the means chosen to advance it since only 30 of the 300 machines were removed and there is no indication that the advertisements generate more litter than other publications. Therefore, the ordinance is unconstitutional.

(Choice A) In the context of commercial speech, "no more extensive than necessary" does not mean the least restrictive means available. Instead, it means that there must be a reasonable fit between the relevant government interest and the means chosen to achieve it. And since there is no reasonable fit here, the ordinance is invalid.

(Choice C) Rational basis review - which merely requires that a government regulation be rationally related to a legitimate government interest - does not apply to commercial speech.

(Choice D) Strict scrutiny would require the city to prove that its ordinance is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest. But this stringent standard of review does not apply here. And if it did, the ordinance would fail since it cannot even meet the lower standard applicable to commercial speech.

Educational objective: Government regulations of protected commercial speech must
  • directly advance a substantial government interest and
  • not be more extensive than necessary to serve that interest.
The second element is met if there is a reasonable fit between the government interest and the means chosen to achieve it.



选项正确率统计：A选项 49%，B选项 34%（正确选项），C选项 12%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

商业言论(Commercial speech)只要涉及合法活动且不具有虚假性或误导性，就受First Amendment的保护。因此，政府只有在证明其规制满足以下条件时，才能对受保护的商业言论进行规制：
  • 直接促进一项重大的政府利益，并且
  • 其范围不超过为实现该利益所必需的程度。
如果所选择的方式与所服务的利益之间存在合理的匹配，则第二个要素即被满足。

在本案中，某市法令禁止了所有仅分发商业广告的人行道机器。该法令直接促进了该市在维护其人行道和街道市容方面的合法（且可能是重大的）利益。但在该利益与为促进该利益而选择的方式之间，不存在合理的匹配，因为300台机器中仅有30台被移除，且没有迹象表明商业广告比其他出版物产生更多的垃圾。因此，该法令是违宪的。

(选项A) 在商业言论的语境下，“不超过必需的程度”并不意味着是可用的限制最少的方式。相反，它意味着在相关的政府利益与为实现它所选择的方式之间必须存在合理的匹配。由于本案中不存在合理的匹配，该法令是无效的。

(选项C) 合理基础审查——该审查标准仅要求政府规制与合法的政府利益有合理关联——不适用于商业言论。

(选项D) 严格审查会要求该市证明其法令对于实现某项迫切的政府利益是必要的。但这一严格的审查标准不适用于本案。即使适用，该法令也会因其甚至无法满足适用于商业言论的较低标准而失效。

教学目标：对受保护商业言论的政府规制必须
  • 直接促进一项重大的政府利益，并且
  • 其范围不超过为实现该利益所必需的程度。
如果在政府利益与为实现它所选择的方式之间存在合理的匹配，则第二个要素即被满足。

References

  • Bd. of Trs. of State Univ. of N. Y. v. Fox, 492 U.S. 469, 480 (1989) (explaining that government restrictions on protected commercial speech must have a reasonable fit between means and end).
  • Cincinnati v. Discovery Network, 507 U.S. 410, 424 - 25 (1993) (finding that there was no reasonable fit between city's ban only of commercial news racks and city's interest in sidewalk aesthetics).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law / Commercial Speech
⚖️ 核心法律规则：Central Hudson Test

政府规制受保护的商业言论 (Commercial Speech) 必须满足中间审查标准 (Intermediate Scrutiny)：

  1. 涉及合法活动且不具有误导性；
  2. 政府拥有实质性利益 (Substantial Interest)；
  3. 规制手段直接促进 (Directly Advance) 该利益；
  4. 规制手段与利益之间存在合理的匹配 (Reasonable Fit)。
🔍 深度解析：为何选 B？

本题考察的是上述测试的第四个要素：Reasonable Fit（合理匹配）。

关键事实：

  • 政府目的是为了市容整洁（Substantial Interest）。
  • 手段是禁止商业广告分发机。
  • 结果： 300台机器中只有30台（10%）被移除，剩下的90%非商业机器继续制造同样的视觉垃圾。

法律推理：

虽然政府不需要采用“限制最少的方式” (Least Restrictive Means)，但必须证明手段和目的之间有“合理的匹配”。

仅仅移除一小部分（30台）造成问题的机器，而保留绝大部分（270台）同样造成问题的机器，说明这种区分对待商业言论的做法与政府的市容目标之间缺乏合理的联系。这种规制既不充分，又具有歧视性。

📚 经典判例原型

City of Cincinnati v. Discovery Network, Inc. (1993)

本题几乎完全复刻了该案的事实。最高法院裁定辛辛那提市的禁令违宪，因为移除少量的商业新闻架对整体市容的改善微乎其微，构不成“合理匹配”。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A 错误原因：标准过高
商业言论不需要满足“限制最少的方式” (Least Restrictive Means)。这是严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny) 的要求，不适用于商业言论。商业言论只需“不超出必要的范围” (Not more extensive than necessary)，即“合理匹配”。
选项 C 错误原因：标准过低
商业言论不适用合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。政府不能仅仅证明有“合理关联” (Rationally Related) 就可以限制商业言论。
选项 D 错误原因：适用错误的审查标准
这里不需要政府证明有迫切利益 (Compelling Interest)。这是严格审查的标准。即使假设市容是迫切利益，该手段也因缺乏必要性而无法通过审查。
💡 考试技巧：
遇到商业言论题目，先看是否涉及非法或误导性内容。如果不是，直接套用 Central Hudson 测试。特别注意“手段”是否与其解决的“问题”成比例。如果政府只打压商业言论却放任同样造成问题的非商业言论，通常无法通过“合理匹配”测试。

questions.question:
A state has a statute providing that an unsuccessful candidate in a primary election for a party's nomination for elected public office may not become a candidate for the same office at the following general election by nominating petition or by write-in votes.
A woman sought her party's nomination for governor in the primary election. After losing in the primary, the woman filed nominating petitions containing the requisite number of signatures to become a candidate for the office of governor in the following general election. The chief elections officer of the state refused to certify the woman's petitions solely because of the above statute. The woman then filed suit in federal district court challenging the constitutionality of this statute.
If the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction, which of the following is the proper burden of persuasion in this suit?

choices.a: The state must demonstrate that the statute is rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
choices.b: The state must demonstrate that the statute is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.
choices.c: The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not necessary to achieve a compelling state interest.
choices.d: The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.

Q82156

A state has a statute providing that an unsuccessful candidate in a primary election for a party's nomination for elected public office may not become a candidate for the same office at the following general election by nominating petition or by write-in votes.

A woman sought her party's nomination for governor in the primary election. After losing in the primary, the woman filed nominating petitions containing the requisite number of signatures to become a candidate for the office of governor in the following general election. The chief elections officer of the state refused to certify the woman's petitions solely because of the above statute. The woman then filed suit in federal district court challenging the constitutionality of this statute.

If the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction, which of the following is the proper burden of persuasion in this suit?

某州有一项法规规定，在为竞选某政党公职提名的初选中落败的候选人，不得通过提名请愿或手写选票的方式，在接下来的普选中成为同一公职的候选人。

一名女性在初选中寻求其政党的州长提名。在初选失利后，该女性提交了包含法定数量签名的提名请愿书，以成为下一届普选中州长职位的候选人。该州的首席选举官仅依据上述法规拒绝认证该女性的请愿书。随后，该女性向联邦地区法院提起诉讼，质疑该法规的合宪性。

如果法院认定该法规构成一项严重限制，那么在本案中，以下哪项是正确的说服责任？
options:
A. The state must demonstrate that the statute is rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
该州必须证明该法规与一项合法的州利益具有理性关联。

B. The state must demonstrate that the statute is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.
该州必须证明该法规是为实现一项重大的州利益而采取的限制最少的方式。

C. The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not necessary to achieve a compelling state interest.
该女性必须证明该法规并非为实现一项重大的州利益所必需。

D. The woman must demonstrate that the statute is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
该女性必须证明该法规与一项合法的州利益不具有理性关联。
data.explanation:
State-election restrictions


RestrictionExamplesTest
Ordinary
(nondiscriminatory)
  • Voter registration
  • Photo-ID requirement
  • Disallowing write-in voting
Rational basis: challenger must show restriction lacks rational relationship to legitimate state interest
Severe
(discriminatory)
  • Poll tax
  • Disallowing third-party candidacies
  • Property-ownership requirement
Strict scrutiny: state must show restriction is necessary to achieve compelling state interest

States may regulate their own elections by requiring voters and candidates to abide by certain requirements. But these regulations must comply with the First Amendment and the Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause, which together secure an individual's right to vote and freely associate. If the electoral regulation is challenged under either constitutional provision, the standard for evaluating that regulation depends on the severity of the burden imposed. A court will apply either:

  • rational basis review - applies to ordinary (nondiscriminatory) burdens and requires the challenger to prove that the regulation is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest or
  • strict scrutiny - applies to severe (discriminatory) burdens and requires the state to prove that its regulation is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.

Here, a state statute prohibits a loser of a primary election from running for the same public office in the general election (ie, "sore-loser law"). This infringed upon the woman's right to access the ballot as a political candidate (ie, her right to vote and freely associate). And if the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction on that right, then the state must demonstrate that the statute is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest.

(Choices A & D) Rational basis review places the burden of persuasion on the challenging party - not the state - when ordinary electoral regulations are involved.

(Choice C) Strict scrutiny places the burden of persuasion on the state to demonstrate that a law is necessary (ie, the least restrictive means) to achieve a compelling state interest.

Educational objective:

When an electoral regulation imposes an ordinary burden, the challenging party must prove that the regulation is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest (ie, rational basis test). But if the burden is severe, the state must show that the regulation is the least restrictive means of achieving a compelling state interest (ie, strict scrutiny).



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 61%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 28%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

州选举限制


限制示例审查标准
普通
（非歧视性）
  • 选民登记
  • 照片身份证明要求
  • 禁止手写选票投票
理性基础审查：挑战方必须证明该限制与合法的州利益缺乏理性关联
严重
（歧视性）
  • 人头税
  • 禁止第三方参选
  • 财产所有权要求
严格审查：州政府必须证明该限制为实现重大的州利益所必需

各州可以通过要求选民和候选人遵守某些规定来规范本州的选举。但这些法规必须符合 First Amendment 和 Fourteenth Amendment 的平等保护条款，这两项条款共同保障了个人的投票权和自由结社权。如果该选举法规依据任一宪法条款受到质疑，对其进行评估的标准取决于所施加负担的严重程度。法院将适用以下任一标准：

  • 理性基础审查 - 适用于普通（非歧视性）负担，并要求挑战方证明该法规与合法的州利益没有理性关联或
  • 严格审查 - 适用于严重（歧视性）负担，并要求州政府证明其法规是实现重大的州利益的限制最少的方式。

在本案中，一项州法规禁止初选的失败者在普选中竞选同一公职（即“输不起的候选人”法）。这侵犯了该女性作为政治候选人参与竞选的权利（即她的投票权和自由结社权）。如果法院认定该法规对该权利构成了严重限制，那么州政府必须证明该法规是为实现一项重大的州利益而采取的限制最少的方式。

(选项 A & D) 当涉及普通选举法规时，理性基础审查将说服责任置于挑战方——而非州政府——身上。

(选项 C) 严格审查将说服责任置于州政府，要求其证明某项法律为实现重大的州利益所必需（即限制最少的方式）。

教学目标：

当选举法规施加普通负担时，挑战方必须证明该法规与合法的州利益没有理性关联（即理性基础测试）。但如果负担是严重的，州政府必须证明该法规是为实现重大的州利益而采取的限制最少的方式（即严格审查）。



References

  • U.S. Const. amend. I (freedom of association).
  • U.S. Const. amend. XIV (equal protection clause).
  • Burdick v. Takushi, 504 U.S. 428, 433 - 34 (1992) (explaining that the level of scrutiny of an election law depends on the severity of the restriction).

MBE 考点解析

宪法：选举权与审查标准

核心考点： 本题考察的是针对选举法规（Election Regulations）合宪性挑战时的审查标准（Standard of Review）以及相应的举证责任（Burden of Persuasion）。

1. 法律规则：安德森-伯迪克原则

在 Anderson-Burdick 理论下，法院审查选举法时采用“滑动标尺”标准：

🔴 严重限制 (Severe Restriction)

如果法规对第一修正案或第十四修正案权利施加了严重负担：

  • 适用标准：严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)
  • 举证责任：政府 (State) 必须证明。
  • 证明内容：该法律是实现重大的州利益 (Compelling State Interest) 所采取的限制最少的方式 (Least Restrictive Means)。
🟢 普通/合理限制 (Ordinary Restriction)

如果法规施加的负担是合理的、非歧视性的：

  • 适用标准：理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review) 的变体。
  • 举证责任：通常由 挑战者 (Challenger) 承担。
  • 证明内容：该法律与合法的州利益 (Legitimate State Interest) 具有理性关联。

2. 题目解析

本题的关键在于题干中的假设条件：

"If the court holds that the statute constitutes a severe restriction..."
（如果法院认定该法规构成一项严重限制……）

这一假设直接锁定了审查层级。既然是“严重限制”，就必须适用严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。

为什么选 B？

选项 B 准确描述了严格审查的两个核心要素：

  1. 责任主体：由州政府 (The State) 承担举证责任。
  2. 标准内容：必须证明是实现重大州利益 (Compelling Interest) 的限制最少手段 (Least Restrictive Means)（即必要性）。

其他选项为何错误？

  • 选项 A (Rational Basis - State Burden): 错误。这是理性基础测试的内容，但错误地将举证责任加给了政府。且本题已定性为“严重限制”，不适用理性基础。
  • 选项 C (Strict Scrutiny - Challenger Burden): 错误。虽然提到了“重大州利益”和“必要性”，但它错误地要求原告（该女性）去证明法律“不必要”。在严格审查下，举证责任倒置，必须由政府来辩护。
  • 选项 D (Rational Basis - Challenger Burden): 错误。这是标准的理性基础测试。如果题目说限制是“普通的”或“合理的”，这个选项才可能是对的。
✅ 正确答案：B
在认定为严重限制选举权的情况下，适用严格审查，州政府必须证明该法律是实现重大州利益的必要手段。
考试技巧： 在 MBE 宪法题中，一旦看到 "Severe Restriction" 或涉及基本权利（如投票权、言论自由）的核心限制，立即寻找 "Compelling Interest" 和 "Least Restrictive/Narrowly Tailored"，并确认举证责任在政府一方。

questions.question:
A city ordinance prohibits the location of "adult theaters and bookstores" (theaters and bookstores presenting sexually explicit performances or materials) in residential or commercial zones within the city. The ordinance was intended to protect surrounding property from the likely adverse secondary effects of such establishments. Adult theaters and bookstores are freely permitted in the areas of the city zoned industrial, where those adverse secondary effects are not as likely.
A storekeeper was denied a zoning permit to open an adult theater and bookstore in a building owned by him in an area zoned commercial. As a result, the storekeeper brought suit in an appropriate court challenging the constitutionality of the zoning ordinance.
Which of the following statements regarding the constitutionality of this city ordinance is most accurate?

choices.a: The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not enforce zoning regulations that deprive potential operators of adult theaters and bookstores of their freedom to choose the location of their businesses.
choices.b: The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not zone property in a manner calculated to protect property from the likely adverse secondary effects of adult theaters and bookstores.
choices.c: The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce this type of time, place, and manner regulation on speech-related businesses, so long as the regulation is designed to serve a substantial governmental interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication.
choices.d: The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce zoning restrictions on speech-related businesses to ensure that the messages they disseminate are acceptable to the residents of adjacent property.

data.questionStem:
Q82087

A city ordinance prohibits the location of "adult theaters and bookstores" (theaters and bookstores presenting sexually explicit performances or materials) in residential or commercial zones within the city. The ordinance was intended to protect surrounding property from the likely adverse secondary effects of such establishments. Adult theaters and bookstores are freely permitted in the areas of the city zoned industrial, where those adverse secondary effects are not as likely.

A storekeeper was denied a zoning permit to open an adult theater and bookstore in a building owned by him in an area zoned commercial. As a result, the storekeeper brought suit in an appropriate court challenging the constitutionality of the zoning ordinance.

Which of the following statements regarding the constitutionality of this city ordinance is most accurate?

某市的一项法令禁止在该市的住宅区或商业区内设立“成人影院和书店”（即放映或展示色情表演或材料的影院和书店）。该法令旨在保护周边财产免受此类场所可能带来的不良次生效应的影响。在被划为工业区的城市区域，成人影院和书店是被自由允许的，因为在这些区域，上述不良次生效应发生的可能性较小。

一名店主在一处被划为商业区的自有建筑内申请开设成人影院和书店，但其分区许可申请被驳回。因此，该店主向有管辖权的法院提起诉讼，质疑该分区法令的合宪性。

关于该市法令合宪性的以下哪项陈述最为准确？
options:
A. The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not enforce zoning regulations that deprive potential operators of adult theaters and bookstores of their freedom to choose the location of their businesses.
该法令无效，因为城市不得执行分区法规，剥夺成人影院和书店潜在经营者选择其营业地点的自由。

B. The ordinance is invalid, because a city may not zone property in a manner calculated to protect property from the likely adverse secondary effects of adult theaters and bookstores.
该法令无效，因为城市不得以旨在保护财产免受成人影院和书店可能的不良次生效应影响的方式来规划区域。

C. The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce this type of time, place, and manner regulation on speech-related businesses, so long as the regulation is designed to serve a substantial governmental interest and does not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication.
该法令有效，因为城市可以对与言论相关的商业活动执行此类关于时间、地点和方式的规制，只要该规制旨在服务于重大的政府利益，且未不合理地限制其他沟通渠道。

D. The ordinance is valid, because a city may enforce zoning restrictions on speech-related businesses to ensure that the messages they disseminate are acceptable to the residents of adjacent property.
该法令有效，因为城市可以对与言论相关的商业活动实施分区限制，以确保其传播的信息能为邻近物业的居民所接受。
data.explanation:
Speech regulations


TypeDefinitionTest
Strict scrutinyContent-basedFacial discrimination
Primary purpose targets message, subject, or idea		Necessary & narrowly tailored to achieve compelling interest
Intermediate scrutinyContent-neutralRegulates time, place, or manner of speechNarrowly tailored to achieve important interest
Alternative avenues of communication remain
Adult theaters and bookstores are speech-related businesses that are protected by the First Amendment. As a result, government regulation of such businesses is subject to constitutional review. If the regulation targets what is being said (ie, content-based restriction), it is subject to strict scrutiny and presumptively unconstitutional. But if the regulation targets the time, place, or manner of speech (ie, content-neutral restriction), it is subject to intermediate scrutiny and generally acceptable.

In Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc. , the Supreme Court held that zoning ordinances for adult-entertainment businesses are time, place, and manner restrictions. That is because such ordinances target the secondary effects that adult businesses have on the surrounding community - not the acceptability of their content. As a result, these ordinances are valid so long as they pass intermediate scrutiny - ie, are narrowly tailored to serve a substantial or important government interest and do not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication (Choice B).

(Choice A) A city can enforce zoning regulations that restrict adult theater and bookstore operators' freedom to choose the location of their businesses so long as the regulation survives intermediate scrutiny.

(Choice D) A zoning ordinance is a content-based restriction if its primary purpose is to ensure that the messages disseminated by speech-related businesses are acceptable to residents. Such a restriction is almost certainly invalid since it must pass strict scrutiny - ie, be necessary and narrowly tailored to achieve a compelling government interest.

Educational objective: Time, place, and manner restrictions (eg, zoning ordinances) are valid so long as they are narrowly tailored to serve a substantial government interest and do not unreasonably limit alternative avenues of communication.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 5%，C选项 82%（正确选项），D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

言论规制


类型定义审查标准
严格审查基于内容的表面歧视
主要目的针对信息、主题或观点		为实现紧迫的政府利益所必需且为狭义定制
中度审查内容中立的规制言论的时间、地点或方式为实现重要的政府利益而狭义定制
保留其他沟通渠道
成人影院和书店是受First Amendment（第一修正案）保护的与言论相关的商业活动。因此，政府对此类商业活动的规制需接受合宪性审查。如果该规制针对言论的内容（即基于内容的限制），则需接受严格审查，并被推定为违宪。但如果该规制针对言论的时间、地点或方式（即内容中立的限制），则需接受中度审查，且通常被接受。

在Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc.案中，最高法院裁定，针对成人娱乐业的分区法令属于对时间、地点和方式的限制。这是因为此类法令针对的是成人娱乐业对周边社区产生的次生效应——而非其内容的可接受性。因此，只要这些法令通过中度审查——即为服务于重大或重要的政府利益而狭义定制，且未不合理地限制其他沟通渠道——它们就是有效的（选项C）。

（选项A） 只要规制能通过中度审查，城市可以执行分区法规，限制成人影院和书店经营者选择其营业地点的自由。

（选项D） 如果分区法令的主要目的是确保与言论相关的商业活动所传播的信息能为居民所接受，那么该法令就是一项基于内容的限制。此类限制几乎可以肯定是无效的，因为它必须通过严格审查——即为实现紧迫的政府利益所必需且为狭义定制。

教学目的：对时间、地点和方式的限制（例如，分区法令），只要是为了服务于重大的政府利益而狭义定制，且未不合理地限制其他沟通渠道，即为有效。

References

Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc., 475 U.S. 41, 46 - 47 (1986) (explaining that zoning ordinances for adult-entertainment businesses are time, place, and manner restrictions).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

First Amendment: Speech Regulation
核心考点：成人娱乐场所的分区规制 虽然成人电影和书籍属于受宪法第一修正案保护的言论，但政府可以通过时间、地点和方式 (Time, Place, and Manner, TPM) 的规定对其进行限制，前提是该规定必须是“内容中立” (Content-Neutral) 的。
关键判例：
City of Renton v. Playtime Theatres, Inc. (1986)

最高法院确立了“次生效应原则” (Secondary Effects Doctrine)：如果一项分区法令旨在控制成人场所带来的犯罪、房产贬值等副作用，而非为了压制不受欢迎的言论内容，那么它被视为内容中立的规制。

⚖️ 法律分析与答案推导

本题考察的是对成人娱乐场所进行分区 (Zoning) 的合宪性审查标准。根据 Renton 案的规则，此类规制适用中度审查 (Intermediate Scrutiny)。

✅ 选项 C 正确 (The ordinance is valid...)

这是对法律规则最准确的陈述。一个城市可以对言论相关企业实施 TPM 限制，只要满足以下两个条件：

  • 旨在服务于重大的政府利益 (Substantial Governmental Interest)：如防止犯罪、保护社区环境（即针对“次生效应”）。
  • 未不合理地限制其他沟通渠道 (Alternative Avenues of Communication)：本题中，城市允许在工业区开设此类场所，通常被视为提供了合理的替代渠道。
❌ 选项 A 错误

理由： 城市可以限制经营者选择地点的自由。第一修正案并不保证你在任何你想开店的地方开店，只要政府留有合理的替代区域即可。

❌ 选项 B 错误

理由： 这恰恰是政府规制的正当理由。针对“不良次生效应” (Adverse Secondary Effects) 的规制是最高法院明确允许的，这正是使该法令被视为“内容中立”的关键。

❌ 选项 D 错误

理由： 这是一个陷阱选项。如果政府限制言论是为了确保信息“被居民接受” (Acceptable to residents)，那就是基于内容 (Content-Based) 的歧视。这种限制需要接受严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)，通常会被判定违宪。本题中的法令之所以有效，是因为它针对的是副作用，而不是信息内容本身。

💡 MBE 破题技巧

在遇到涉及色情/成人娱乐 (Adult Entertainment) 的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 是完全禁止吗？ 如果是 Total Ban，通常违宪。
  2. 是分区限制 (Zoning) 吗？ 如果是，检查题目是否提到“次生效应” (Secondary Effects, e.g., crime, property value)。
  3. 是否有替代渠道？ 如果允许在其他区域（如工业区）开设，通常能通过中度审查。

切记：只要是为了打击“次生效应”，就属于 Content-Neutral，不需要通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。

questions.question:
A state statute provides that assessments of real property for tax purposes must represent the "actual value" of the property. In one county of the state, the county tax commission, in making its assessments, has uniformly and consistently determined the "actual value" of real property solely by reference to the price at which the particular property was last sold. In recent years, the market values of real property in the county have been rising at the rate of 15% per year.
An owner is required to pay real estate taxes on her home in the county that are 200% to 300% higher than those paid by many other owners of similar homes in similar neighborhoods in that county, even though the current market values of their respective homes and the owner's home are nearly identical. The reason the taxes on the owner's home are higher than those imposed on the other similar homes in similar neighborhoods is that she bought her home much more recently than the other owners and, therefore, it is assessed at a much higher "actual value" than their homes. Persistent efforts by the owner to have her assessment reduced or the assessments of the others raised by the county tax commission have failed.
The owner has now filed suit against the county tax commission, claiming only that the comparative overvaluation of her property by the commission is unconstitutional.
What is the owner's strongest argument to support her claim?

choices.a: The tax assessment constitutes a taking of private property for public use without just compensation.
choices.b: The tax assessment constitutes an ex post facto law.
choices.c: The tax assessment deprives the owner of a privilege or immunity of national citizenship.
choices.d: The tax assessment deprives the owner of the equal protection of the laws.

data.questionStem:
Q82168

A state statute provides that assessments of real property for tax purposes must represent the "actual value" of the property. In one county of the state, the county tax commission, in making its assessments, has uniformly and consistently determined the "actual value" of real property solely by reference to the price at which the particular property was last sold. In recent years, the market values of real property in the county have been rising at the rate of 15% per year.

An owner is required to pay real estate taxes on her home in the county that are 200% to 300% higher than those paid by many other owners of similar homes in similar neighborhoods in that county, even though the current market values of their respective homes and the owner's home are nearly identical. The reason the taxes on the owner's home are higher than those imposed on the other similar homes in similar neighborhoods is that she bought her home much more recently than the other owners and, therefore, it is assessed at a much higher "actual value" than their homes. Persistent efforts by the owner to have her assessment reduced or the assessments of the others raised by the county tax commission have failed.

The owner has now filed suit against the county tax commission, claiming only that the comparative overvaluation of her property by the commission is unconstitutional.

What is the owner's strongest argument to support her claim?

某州法规规定，为税收目的而对不动产进行的估价必须代表该财产的“实际价值”。在该州的一个县，县税务委员会在进行估价时，统一且一贯地仅以特定财产的最后一次售出价格来确定其“实际价值”。近年来，该县不动产的市场价值以每年15%的速度上涨。

一名业主被要求为其在该县的住宅缴纳的房产税，比该县类似社区中许多拥有类似住宅的其他业主高出200%至300%，尽管他们各自住宅的当前市场价值与该业主的住宅几乎相同。该业主住宅的税收高于其他类似社区中类似住宅的原因是，她购买其住宅的时间比其他业主晚得多，因此，其住宅被估定的“实际价值”远高于他们的住宅。该业主为让县税务委员会降低其估价或提高其他人的估价而进行的持续努力均告失败。

该业主现已对县税务委员会提起诉讼，仅主张委员会对其财产的比较性过高估价是违宪的。

该业主支持其主张的最有力论点是什么？
options:
A. The tax assessment constitutes a taking of private property for public use without just compensation.
该税收估价构成了未经公正补偿而为公共用途征用私有财产的行为。

B. The tax assessment constitutes an ex post facto law.
该税收估价构成了一项溯及既往的法律（ex post facto law）。

C. The tax assessment deprives the owner of a privilege or immunity of national citizenship.
该税收估价剥夺了该业主的合众国公民特权或豁免权。

D. The tax assessment deprives the owner of the equal protection of the laws.
该税收估价剥夺了该业主受法律平等保护的权利。
data.explanation:
Tax assessments that treat similarly situated property differently can be challenged under the equal protection clause. Since these assessments are generally subject to rational basis review, they must rationally relate to a legitimate state interest. Rough equality in implementing tax assessments will satisfy this standard of review. But intentional and substantial inequality will not.

Here, the owner's real estate taxes are 200% to 300% higher than those paid by owners of similar homes (substantial inequality). And the county tax commission has repeatedly denied the owner's requests to reduce her assessment or raise the others' assessments (intentional inequality). Therefore, the owner's strongest argument is that the tax assessment deprives her of the equal protection of the laws.

  • (Choice A) The Fifth Amendment prohibits the government from taking private property for public use without just compensation. A taking occurs when the government (1) actually/physically appropriates the property or (2) extinguishes all economic benefits/uses of the property. But since the commission did neither, no taking occurred.
  • (Choice B) The Constitution prohibits the enactment of ex post facto laws - ie, criminal legislation that has a retroactive and punitive effect. But the tax assessment is not an ex post facto law because it is civil in nature.
  • (Choice C) The Fourteenth Amendment bars states from interfering with the narrowly defined privileges or immunities of national citizenship - none of which are affected here.

Educational objective: Equal protection challenges to unequal tax assessments are subject to rational basis review. Although some inequality in tax assessments is permissible, intentional and substantial inequality is unconstitutional.



选项正确率统计：A选项 12%，B选项 11%，C选项 3%，D选项 73%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

税收估价如果对情况相似的财产区别对待，可以根据平等保护条款提出质疑。由于这些估价通常受理性基础审查，它们必须与合法的州利益具有理性关联。在实施税收估价时，大致的平等即可满足这一审查标准。但故意且重大的不平等则不能满足。

在本案中，该业主的房产税比拥有类似住宅的业主高出200%至300%（重大的不平等）。并且，县税务委员会一再拒绝该业主降低其估价或提高他人估价的请求（故意的 不平等）。因此，该业主最有力的论点是，该税收估价剥夺了她受法律平等保护的权利。

  • （选项A）《第五修正案》禁止政府在没有公正补偿的情况下为公共用途征用私有财产。征用行为发生在政府（1）实际/物理上占用财产或（2）消除了财产的所有经济利益/用途时。但由于委员会并未采取上述任何一种行为，因此没有发生征用。
  • （选项B）《宪法》禁止制定溯及既往的法律（ex post facto laws）——即具有追溯和惩罚效力的刑事立法。但该税收估价并非溯及既往的法律，因为其本质上是民事性质的。
  • （选项C）《第十四修正案》禁止各州干涉狭义界定的合众国公民特权或豁免权——本案中并未涉及任何此类权利。

教学目标：针对不平等税收估价提出的平等保护质疑受理性基础审查。尽管税收估价中允许存在某些不平等，但故意且重大的不平等是违宪的。

References

Allegheny Pittsburgh Coal Co. v. Comm'r of Webster Cty., 488 U.S. 336, 345 - 46 (1989) (holding that an equal protection violation occurred when a tax commission intentionally and substantially undervalued similar property).
