MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law / Equal Protection
正确答案：D 该税收估价剥夺了该业主受法律平等保护的权利。
(Deprives the owner of the equal protection of the laws)
核心法律依据

本题考查的是美国宪法第十四修正案中的平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause) 在税收行政管理中的应用。

虽然各州在制定税收政策时拥有广泛的自由裁量权，且通常只需通过理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)，但行政机关在执行法律时，如果对处于相似情况的财产进行了故意且系统性的歧视 (Intentional and systematic discrimination)，则违反了平等保护条款。

推理逻辑：

  1. 州法规定： 法律明确要求按“实际价值” (Actual Value) 征税。
  2. 行政行为： 税务委员会无视市场价值的上涨，仅按“最后售价”估值。
  3. 后果： 导致新买家（原告）的税负比拥有同等价值房屋的邻居高出 200%-300%。
  4. 结论： 这种巨大的差异并非基于合理的分类，而是行政上的任意武断，构成了违宪的差别待遇。
相关判例：Allegheny Pittsburgh Coal Co. v. County Commission (1989)
最高法院在该案中裁定，如果州法律要求按市场价值统一征税，而评估官员故意且系统性地低估某些财产而按全额评估其他财产，导致巨大的税负差异，这违反了平等保护条款。本题的事实模式几乎与该案一致。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A (Takings Clause) 错误
征用条款： 只有当政府物理侵占财产或剥夺了财产的“所有经济价值”时，才构成征用。高额税收本身通常不构成征用（除非是没收性的）。
选项 B (Ex Post Facto) 错误
追溯既往法律： 宪法中的 Ex Post Facto 条款仅适用于刑事法规 (Criminal Statutes)，严禁具有追溯力的惩罚性法律。税收属于民事范畴。
选项 C (Privileges or Immunities) 错误
特权或豁免权条款： 第十四修正案的此条款被最高法院（如 Slaughter-House Cases）解释得非常狭窄，主要涉及跨州旅行权等国家公民权利，不适用于州内税收争议。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“税收不平等”题目时，请注意区分以下两种情况：

  • 情况 1（本题）： 州法律要求“统一市场价”，但行政官僚擅自搞双重标准，导致巨大差异 ➡️ 违反平等保护。
  • 情况 2（如加州 Prop 13）： 州法律或宪法本身明确规定按“购买价”而非“市场价”征税 ➡️ 合宪（因为这种分类通常能通过理性基础审查，旨在保护长期业主的信赖利益）。

questions.question:
A state initiated a criminal prosecution against the owner of a video store for selling a video that consisted entirely of pictures of nude sunbathers on a beach in a foreign country where nude public sunbathing is common. The state charged that selling the video violated its anti-obscenity law. The store owner defended on the ground that the prosecution violated his constitutional right to freedom of speech.
Should the store owner prevail in this defense?

choices.a: No, because the store owner is engaged in the commercial sale of the video, which is not protected by the First and Fourteenth Amendments.
choices.b: No, because the video consists entirely of portrayals of nudity, appeals to the prurient interest of viewers, and lacks serious social value as a whole.
choices.c: Yes, because mere portrayals of nudity are insufficient to justify a finding that the video is obscene as a matter of constitutional law.
choices.d: Yes, because the portrayals of nudity occurred outside the United States, and therefore the state lacks a compelling interest in applying its anti-obscenity law to the sale of the video.

data.questionStem:
Q82803 A state initiated a criminal prosecution against the owner of a video store for selling a video that consisted entirely of pictures of nude sunbathers on a beach in a foreign country where nude public sunbathing is common. The state charged that selling the video violated its anti-obscenity law. The store owner defended on the ground that the prosecution violated his constitutional right to freedom of speech.

Should the store owner prevail in this defense? 某个州对一家录像带店的老板提起了刑事起诉，因为他销售了一盘完全由在裸体公共日光浴很普遍的外国海滩上的裸体日光浴者照片组成的录像带。该州指控销售该录像带违反了其反淫秽法。店主辩称，该起诉侵犯了他受宪法保护的言论自由权。

店主的辩护应否获胜？
options:
A. No, because the store owner is engaged in the commercial sale of the video, which is not protected by the First and Fourteenth Amendments.
不应获胜，因为店主从事的是该录像带的商业销售，这不受《第一修正案》和《第十四修正案》的保护。

B. No, because the video consists entirely of portrayals of nudity, appeals to the prurient interest of viewers, and lacks serious social value as a whole.
不应获胜，因为该录像带完全由裸体描绘组成，迎合了观众的淫秽兴趣，并且整体上缺乏严肃的社会价值。

C. Yes, because mere portrayals of nudity are insufficient to justify a finding that the video is obscene as a matter of constitutional law.
应该获胜，因为根据宪法法律，仅仅是裸体描绘不足以证明该录像带是淫秽的。

D. Yes, because the portrayals of nudity occurred outside the United States, and therefore the state lacks a compelling interest in applying its anti-obscenity law to the sale of the video.
应该获胜，因为裸体描绘发生在美国境外，因此该州在对此录像带的销售适用其反淫秽法方面缺乏令人信服的利益。
data.explanation:
Unprotected speech

  • Fighting words/threats
  • Inciting crime
  • Defamation
  • Obscenity
Mnemonic: FIDO

The First Amendment free speech clause generally prohibits the government from regulating speech based on its content (ie, what is being said). Such content-based regulations are usually subject to strict scrutiny. But certain categories of speech—like obscenity—are not protected and can be freely regulated by the government. Under the Millertest, speech is considered obscene when it:
  • appeals to the prurient interest (ie, a shameful or morbid interest in sexual matters)
  • depicts sexual conduct in a patently offensive way and
  • lacks serious literary, artistic, political, or scientific value.
The first two elements of this test are evaluated under contemporary community standards, while the third element is evaluated under a national standard. But mere portrayals of nudity—as seen in the store owner's video—are never obscene (Choice B). As a result, this content-based restriction is invalid unless it survives strict scrutiny. This requires the state to prove that the restriction is necessary to achieve a compelling state interest. And since this is a nearly impossible task, the store owner should prevail.

(Choice A) The government can freely regulate the production, sale, and distribution of obscene materials. But since the video is not obscene, commercial sale of the video is protected by the First Amendment (as applied to the states through the Fourteenth Amendment).

(Choice D) The location of the video itself is relevant since it affects whether the state has jurisdiction to prosecute the store owner. But where the nudity in that video occurred is irrelevant and does not affect the state's interest in applying the anti-obscenity law.

Educational objective: Obscenity is not protected by the free speech clause. And under the three-part Miller test for evaluating obscenity, mere portrayals of nudity are never obscene.

不受保护的言论

  • 挑衅性言论/威胁
  • 煽动犯罪
  • 诽谤
  • 淫秽
助记词：FIDO

《第一修正案》的言论自由条款通常禁止政府基于言论内容（即所说的内容）对其进行规制。此类基于内容的规制通常受到严格审查。但某些类别的言论——如淫秽言论——是不受保护的，政府可以自由地对其进行规制。根据米勒测试 (Miller test)，当言论符合以下条件时，被认为是淫秽的：
  • 迎合淫秽兴趣（即对性问题的羞耻或病态的兴趣）
  • 以公然冒犯的方式描绘性行为并且
  • 缺乏严肃的文学、艺术、政治或科学价值。
该测试的前两个要素根据当代社区标准进行评估，而第三个要素则根据全国性标准进行评估。但是仅仅描绘裸体——如此案店主录像带中所示——绝不构成淫秽（选项B）。因此，这种基于内容的限制是无效的，除非它能通过严格审查。这要求州政府证明该限制对于实现令人信服的州利益是必要的。由于这几乎是一项不可能完成的任务，店主应该会胜诉。

（选项A）政府可以自由规制淫秽材料的制作、销售和分发。但由于该录像带并非淫秽，其商业销售受到《第一修正案》（通过《第十四修正案》适用于各州）的保护。

（选项D）录像带本身的位置是相关的，因为它影响到州政府是否有司法管辖权起诉店主。但录像带中裸体行为的发生地是无关紧要的，不影响州政府在适用反淫秽法方面的利益。

教学目标： 淫秽言论不受言论自由条款的保护。根据用于评估淫秽内容的三部分米勒测试，仅仅描绘裸体绝不构成淫秽。

References


  • Miller v. California, 413 U.S. 15, 24 (1973) (setting forth the three-prong obscenity test).

  • Erznoznik v. Jacksonville, 422 U.S. 205, 213–14 (1975) (holding that mere nudity is not obscene).

Constitutional Law

第一修正案与淫秽定义

✅ 正确答案解析
正确选项：C

仅仅描绘裸体（Mere Nudity）不构成法律意义上的淫秽。

本题的核心考点在于区分“裸体” (Nudity) 与 “淫秽” (Obscenity)。

美国最高法院在多个判例中明确指出，虽然淫秽言论不受《第一修正案》保护，但仅仅展示裸体本身并不等同于淫秽。如果录像带只是展示海滩上的裸体日光浴者，而没有包含具体的性行为或迎合病态的色欲兴趣，它就属于受保护的言论。

⚖️ 核心法则：Miller Test

判断言论是否构成不受保护的“淫秽” (Obscenity)，必须满足 Miller v. California (1973) 确立的三个条件：

  1. 迎合色欲 (Prurient Interest)：根据当地社区标准，整体上迎合对性无耻或病态的兴趣。
  2. 公然冒犯 (Patently Offensive)：根据当地社区标准，以公然冒犯的方式描绘了法律定义的性行为 (Sexual Conduct)。
  3. 缺乏价值 (Lacks Value)：根据全国标准，整体上缺乏严肃的文学、艺术、政治或科学价值。

关键点：题目中的录像带仅展示了“裸体日光浴者”(nude sunbathers)，并未提及任何“性行为”或“公然冒犯”的描绘。因此，它无法满足 Miller Test 的第二项要素，不属于淫秽物品。

❌ 陷阱选项分析
选项 A 错 商业言论不受保护？

错误。虽然商业言论 (Commercial Speech) 受到的保护程度略低于政治言论，但它仍然受到《第一修正案》的保护。除非是误导性的或涉及非法活动的商业言论，否则政府不能随意禁止。销售非淫秽的录像带是合法的商业行为。

选项 B 错 裸体即淫秽？

这是最常见的干扰项。选项声称录像带“完全由裸体描绘组成”所以缺乏价值。但在宪法法律下，裸体 ≠ 淫秽。没有性行为的描绘，单纯的裸体通常被视为受保护的表达形式。

选项 D 错 发生地点相关？

无关。无论裸体发生在外国还是美国，都不会改变该录像带是否“淫秽”的法律定义。州政府监管淫秽物品的利益并不取决于拍摄地点。

💡 MBE 提分技巧
  • 看到 Obscenity (淫秽) 考题，立即联想 Miller Test。
  • 记住：Mere Nudity (单纯裸体) 几乎总是受保护的言论，除非涉及儿童色情 (Child Pornography)，后者有完全不同的标准。
  • 政府想要规制基于内容 (Content-based) 的非淫秽言论，必须通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)，这通常很难通过。

questions.question:
A clerical employee of a city water department was responsible for sending out water bills to customers. His work in this respect had always been satisfactory. The employee's sister ran in a recent election against the incumbent mayor, but she lost. The employee had supported his sister in the election campaign. After the mayor found out about this, she fired the employee solely because his support for the sister indicated that he was "disloyal" to the mayor. The city's charter provides that "all employees of the city work at the pleasure of the mayor."
Is the mayor's action constitutional?

choices.a: No, because public employees have a property interest in their employment, which gives them a right to a hearing prior to discharge.
choices.b: No, because the mayor's action violates the employee's right to freedom of expression and association.
choices.c: Yes, because the employee has no property interest in his job since the city charter provides that he holds the job "at the pleasure of the mayor."
choices.d: Yes, because the mayor may require members of her administration to be politically loyal to her.

The employee's sister ran in a recent election against the incumbent mayor, but she lost. The employee had supported his sister in the election campaign. After the mayor found out about this, she fired the employee solely because his support for the sister indicated that he was "disloyal" to the mayor. The city's charter provides that "all employees of the city work at the pleasure of the mayor."

Is the mayor's action constitutional?

一名市自来水部门的文职雇员负责向客户寄送水费账单。他在这方面的工作一直令人满意。该雇员的姐姐在最近的一次选举中与在任市长竞选，但败选了。该雇员在竞选活动中支持了他的姐姐。市长发现此事后，仅仅因为该雇员支持其姐姐的行为表明他对市长“不忠”，就解雇了这名雇员。该市的章程规定，“所有城市雇员的任职皆凭市长之意愿。”

市长的行为是否合宪？
options:
A. No, because public employees have a property interest in their employment, which gives them a right to a hearing prior to discharge.
否，因为公职雇员在其雇佣关系中拥有财产权益，这赋予了他们在被解雇前举行听证会的权利。

B. No, because the mayor's action violates the employee's right to freedom of expression and association.
否，因为市长的行为侵犯了该雇员的言论自由和结社自由权。

C. Yes, because the employee has no property interest in his job since the city charter provides that he holds the job "at the pleasure of the mayor."
是，因为该雇员在其工作中没有财产权益，因为城市章程规定他的任职“皆凭市长之意愿”。

D. Yes, because the mayor may require members of her administration to be politically loyal to her.
是，因为市长可以要求其行政团队的成员在政治上对她忠诚。
data.explanation:
First Amendment freedoms


ExpressionRight to communicate information & ideas through speech or conduct
AssociationRight to form or participate in any group or organization
PressRight to publish truthful information
ReligionFree exercise - right to practice religion or no religion without government interference

Establishment - prohibits government from favoring particular religion or religion generally
The First Amendment protects a person's (including a public employee's) right to freedom of expression and association. Political belief and association are the core of these protected activities. As a result, the government cannot condition public employment on a person's political views or affiliations unless these factors are essential to effective performance of the job in question (eg, policymaking position).

Here, the mayor fired a city water department employee for "disloyalty" after the employee supported his sister in an election against the mayor. But since the employee was merely responsible for sending out water bills to customers, his political views and affiliations were irrelevant to performing his job. Therefore, the mayor's action is an unconstitutional violation of the employee's right to freedom of expression and association.

(Choices A & C) Procedural due process guarantees persons a fair opportunity to be heard when the government deprives them of life, liberty, or property. And public employees have a property interest in their employment if they can only be fired for cause . But since this city's employees work "at the pleasure of the mayor," they do not have a property interest in their jobs. Nevertheless, the mayor's action violates the First Amendment.

(Choice D) The mayor may only require members of her administration to be politically loyal to her if that loyalty is essential to the effective performance of the job in question - eg, chief of staff (not clerical employee).

Educational objective: The government cannot condition public employment on a person's political views or affiliations unless these factors are required for effective job performance.

选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 62%（正确选项），C选项 17%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

First Amendment 自由


言论自由通过言语或行为交流信息和思想的权利
结社自由组建或参与任何团体或组织的权利
新闻自由发布真实信息的权利
宗教自由自由行使条款 - 在不受政府干预的情况下信奉或不信奉宗教的权利

禁止国教条款 - 禁止政府偏袒特定宗教或宗教本身
First Amendment 保护个人（包括公职雇员）的言论自由和结社自由权。政治信仰和结社是这些受保护活动的核心。因此，政府不得以个人的政治观点或立场作为公职雇佣的条件，除非这些因素对于有效履行相关工作（例如，决策职位）至关重要。

在本案中，市长因一名市自来水部门的雇员在选举中支持其姐姐对抗市长，而以“不忠”为由将其解雇。但由于该雇员仅负责向客户寄送水费账单，其政治观点和立场与履行其工作职责无关。因此，市长的行为违宪，侵犯了该雇员的言论自由和结社自由权。

(选项 A & C) 当政府剥夺个人的生命、自由或财产时，程序性正当程序保障个人有获得公平听证的机会。如果公职雇员只能因故被解雇，那么他们在雇佣关系中就拥有财产权益。但由于该市的雇员任职“皆凭市长之意愿”，他们在工作中不享有财产权益。尽管如此，市长的行为仍然违反了 First Amendment。

(选项 D) 市长仅在其行政团队成员的政治忠诚对于有效履行相关工作至关重要时，才可以要求他们保持政治忠诚——例如，幕僚长（而非文职雇员）。

教学目标：政府不得以个人的政治观点或立场作为公职雇佣的条件，除非这些因素是有效履行工作所必需的。

References

Rutan v. Republican Party, 497 U.S. 62, 75 - 76 (1990) (holding that the government cannot base employment-related decisions on political views or affiliations unless required for effective job performance).

MBE 考点解析

宪法第一修正案与公职雇佣

✅ 正确答案：选项 B

理由：市长的行为侵犯了该雇员受宪法第一修正案（First Amendment）保护的言论自由和结社自由权。

⚖️ 核心法律规则
🏛️ 政治庇护与解雇 (Political Patronage)

根据美国最高法院的判例（如 Elrod v. Burns 和 Branti v. Finkel），政府不得仅仅因为公职人员的政治派别或政治支持对象而将其解雇。

这被视为对结社自由 (Freedom of Association) 和言论自由 (Freedom of Speech) 的侵犯。

🔍 关键区分：谁可以被解雇？

并非所有公职人员都受此保护。法院设立了一个重要的例外标准：

职位类型 能否因政治原因解雇？
非决策性职位
(Non-policymaking / Clerical)
例：文员、清洁工、甚至公设辩护人		 ❌ 不能
政治忠诚与工作表现无关。
决策性/机要职位
(Policymaking / Confidential)
例：幕僚长、新闻秘书、局长		 ✅ 可以
政治忠诚是有效履行职责的必要条件 (Essential requirement)。

本题应用：
该雇员是负责寄送账单的文职人员（Clerical employee）。他的政治观点完全不影响他把账单寄出去。因此，市长不能要求他保持政治忠诚。

⚠️ 常见 MBE 陷阱解析
陷阱 1：“听凭意愿” (At-will Employment)

题目中的干扰项：城市章程规定雇员工作 "at the pleasure of the mayor"。

解析：这确实意味着雇员没有财产权益 (Property Interest)，因此他没有权利要求听证会（排除了选项 A）。

但是！即使是 At-will 雇员，政府也不能因为违宪的理由（如种族、宗教、受保护的言论）解雇他。宪法权利高于雇佣合同条款。

💡 考试技巧

看到公职人员因支持竞选对手被解雇：

  1. 先看职位高低（是扫地的还是市长助理？）。
  2. 如果是低层/技术性职位 ➡️ 违宪（侵犯第一修正案）。
  3. 如果是高层/决策性职位 ➡️ 合宪（政治忠诚是必要的）。
  4. 不要被 "At-will" 条款迷惑，它只影响程序性正当程序 (Procedural Due Process)，不影响实体宪法权利。
相关判例参考：
Rutan v. Republican Party (1990)
Elrod v. Burns (1976)

questions.question:
Public schools in a state are financed, in large part, by revenue derived from real estate taxes imposed by each school district on the taxable real property located in that district. Public schools also receive other revenue from private gifts, federal grants, student fees, and local sales taxes. For many years, the state has distributed additional funds, which come from the state treasury, to local school districts in order to equalize the funds available on a per-student basis for each public school district. These additional funds are distributed on the basis of a state statutory formula that considers only the number of students in each public school district and the real estate tax revenue raised by that district. The formula does not consider other revenue received by a school district from different sources.
The school boards of two school districts, together with parents and schoolchildren in those districts, bring suit in federal court to enjoin the state from allocating the additional funds from the state treasury to individual districts pursuant to this formula. They allege that the failure of the state, in allocating this additional money, to take into account a school district's sources of revenue other than revenue derived from taxes levied on real estate located there violates the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment. The complaint does not allege that the allocation of the additional state funds based on the current statutory formula has resulted in a failure to provide minimally adequate education to any child.
Which of the following best describes the appropriate standard by which the court should review the constitutionality of the state statutory funding formula?

choices.a: Because classifications based on wealth are inherently suspect, the state must demonstrate that the statutory formula is necessary to vindicate a compelling state interest.
choices.b: Because no fundamental right or suspect or quasi-suspect classification is implicated in this case, the plaintiffs must demonstrate that the funding allocation formula bears no rational relationship to any legitimate state interest.
choices.c: Because the funding formula inevitably leads to disparities among the school districts in their levels of total funding, the plaintiffs must only demonstrate that the funding formula is not substantially related to the furtherance of an important state interest.
choices.d: Because the statutory funding formula burdens the fundamental right to education, the state must demonstrate that the formula is necessary to vindicate a compelling state interest.

Public schools in a state are financed, in large part, by revenue derived from real estate taxes imposed by each school district on the taxable real property located in that district. Public schools also receive other revenue from private gifts, federal grants, student fees, and local sales taxes. For many years, the state has distributed additional funds, which come from the state treasury, to local school districts in order to equalize the funds available on a per-student basis for each public school district. These additional funds are distributed on the basis of a state statutory formula that considers only the number of students in each public school district and the real estate tax revenue raised by that district. The formula does not consider other revenue received by a school district from different sources.

The school boards of two school districts, together with parents and schoolchildren in those districts, bring suit in federal court to enjoin the state from allocating the additional funds from the state treasury to individual districts pursuant to this formula. They allege that the failure of the state, in allocating this additional money, to take into account a school district's sources of revenue other than revenue derived from taxes levied on real estate located there violates the equal protection clause of the Fourteenth Amendment. The complaint does not allege that the allocation of the additional state funds based on the current statutory formula has resulted in a failure to provide minimally adequate education to any child.

Which of the following best describes the appropriate standard by which the court should review the constitutionality of the state statutory funding formula?

某州的公立学校的资金，在很大程度上，来源于每个学区对该区内应税不动产征收的房地产税收入。公立学校也从私人捐赠、联邦拨款、学生费用和地方销售税中获得其他收入。多年来，该州一直向地方学区分配来自州财政的额外资金，以使每个公立学区人均可用的资金均等化。这些额外资金的分配依据是一项州成文法公式，该公式仅考虑每个公立学区的学生人数和该学区征收的房地产税收入。该公式不考虑学区从不同来源获得的其他收入。

两个学区的教育委员会，连同这些学区的家长和学童，向联邦法院提起诉讼，请求禁止该州根据此公式向各个学区分配来自州财政的额外资金。他们声称，州政府在分配这笔额外资金时，未能考虑到学区除当地不动产税收之外的其他收入来源，这违反了《第十四修正案》的平等保护条款。起诉状并未声称，基于现行成文法公式的额外州资金分配已导致未能为任何儿童提供最低限度的充分教育。

以下哪项最恰当地描述了法院在审查该州成文法资助公式的合宪性时应采用的适当标准？
options:
A. Because classifications based on wealth are inherently suspect, the state must demonstrate that the statutory formula is necessary to vindicate a compelling state interest.
由于基于财富的分类本质上是可疑的，州政府必须证明该成文法公式对于维护一项重大的州利益是必要的。

B. Because no fundamental right or suspect or quasi-suspect classification is implicated in this case, the plaintiffs must demonstrate that the funding allocation formula bears no rational relationship to any legitimate state interest.
由于本案未涉及任何基本权利、可疑分类或准可疑分类，原告必须证明该资助分配公式与任何合法的州利益均无合理关联。

C. Because the funding formula inevitably leads to disparities among the school districts in their levels of total funding, the plaintiffs must only demonstrate that the funding formula is not substantially related to the furtherance of an important state interest.
由于该资助公式不可避免地导致各学区总资金水平的差异，原告只需证明该资助公式与促进一项重要的州利益没有实质性关联。

D. Because the statutory funding formula burdens the fundamental right to education, the state must demonstrate that the formula is necessary to vindicate a compelling state interest.
由于该成文法资助公式对受教育的基本权利构成了负担，州政府必须证明该公式对于维护一项重大的州利益是必要的。
data.explanation:
Laws that unevenly distribute benefits can be challenged on equal protection grounds. These challenges are generally subject to rational basis review, where the challenger must show that the law is not rationally related to any legitimate state interest. But intermediate scrutiny is used for laws that substantially impact a quasi-suspect class. And strict scrutiny is used for laws that substantially impact a suspect class or fundamental right.

Here, a state statute calculates the distribution of funds from the state treasury based on the number of students in each public school district and the real estate tax revenue raised by that district. This formula has a disparate impact on school districts because it fails to account for other sources of revenue. But since this law does not affect a fundamental right, suspect class, or quasi-suspect class, rational basis review will apply.

(Choices A & D) The state must show that its law is necessary to vindicate a compelling state interest (ie, strict scrutiny) when the law substantially impacts a suspect class or fundamental right. In San Antonio Indep. Sch. Dist. v. Rodriguez, the Supreme Court held that (1) wealth-based classifications do not impact suspect or quasi-suspect classes and (2) education is not a fundamental right. Therefore, rational basis scrutiny will apply here.

(Choice C) The state would have had to demonstrate that its statutory funding formula is substantially related to an important state interest (ie, intermediate scrutiny) had the formula impacted a quasi-suspect class (ie, gender, legitimacy). But the statute does not do so.

Educational objective: Under the equal protection clause, a discriminatory law that does not substantially impact a fundamental right, suspect class, or quasi-suspect class will be reviewed under the rational basis test - ie, the challenging party must show that the law is not rationally related to any legitimate state interest.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

不均衡分配利益的法律可以基于平等保护的理由受到挑战。这些挑战通常受到合理基础审查，挑战者必须证明该法律与任何合法的州利益均无合理关联。但是，对于实质性影响准可疑分类的法律，则采用中度审查。而对于实质性影响可疑分类或基本权利的法律，则采用严格审查。

在本案中，一项州级成文法根据每个公立学区的学生人数和该学区征收的房地产税收入来计算州财政资金的分配。该公式对各学区产生了差异性影响，因为它未能考虑其他收入来源。但由于该法律不影响基本权利、可疑分类或准可疑分类，因此将适用合理基础审查。

(选项 A & D) 当法律实质性影响可疑分类或基本权利时，州政府必须证明其法律对于维护一项重大的州利益是必要的（即严格审查）。在 San Antonio Indep. Sch. Dist. v. Rodriguez 案中，最高法院裁定 (1) 基于财富的分类不影响可疑或准可疑分类，以及 (2) 教育并非一项基本权利。因此，本案将适用合理基础审查。

(选项 C) 如果该公式影响了准可疑分类（如性别、婚生地位），州政府将必须证明其成文法资助公式与一项重要的州利益有实质性关联（即中度审查）。但该成文法并未如此。

教育目标：根据平等保护条款，一项歧视性法律若未实质性影响基本权利、可疑分类或准可疑分类，将接受合理基础测试的审查——即，挑战方必须证明该法律与任何合法的州利益均无合理关联。

References

  • U.S. Const. amend. XIV, § 1 (equal protection clause).
  • San Antonio Indep. Sch. Dist. v. Rodriguez, 411 U.S. 1, 28, 37 (1973) (explaining that education is not a fundamental right and wealth is not a quasi-suspect or suspect class).

MBE 宪法考点解析

平等保护条款与审查标准

正确答案：B

因为本案不涉及基本权利或可疑分类，原告必须证明该资助公式与任何合法的州利益均无合理关联。

⚖️ 核心法律规则

在处理第十四修正案的平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause) 问题时，首先要确定适用的审查标准 (Standard of Review)。

严格审查
(Strict Scrutiny) 涉及基本权利或可疑分类（如种族、国籍）。
政府举证：必要且为重大利益。
中度审查
(Intermediate Scrutiny) 涉及准可疑分类（如性别、非婚生子女）。
政府举证：实质关联且为重要利益。
合理基础审查
(Rational Basis) 不涉及上述情况（如社会经济立法、财富、年龄）。
原告举证：无合理关联。
🔍 判例与本案分析

本题直接对应美国最高法院的经典判例 San Antonio Independent School District v. Rodriguez (1973)。

  • 教育不是基本权利： 尽管教育非常重要，但在美国联邦宪法下，受教育权并非一项基本权利 (Fundamental Right)。
  • 财富不是可疑分类： 基于贫富差异（Wealth）的分类不是可疑分类 (Suspect Classification)。穷人并不构成一个受特殊宪法保护的群体。

结论：

由于既不涉及基本权利，也不涉及可疑分类，法院必须适用最低级别的合理基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。

🛡️ 举证责任 (Burden of Proof)

在合理基础审查下，举证责任在于挑战者（原告）。原告必须证明该法律是任意的 (Arbitrary) 或不合理的 (Irrational)。

只要州政府能提出任何一个合法的利益 (Legitimate State Interest)（例如：地方对学校的控制权），且法律与该利益有合理关联 (Rational Relationship)，法律即合宪。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A (错误)： 声称财富是“可疑分类”并要求严格审查。这是错误的法律陈述。财富分类仅适用合理基础审查。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 描述的是中度审查标准（实质性关联/重要利益）。这通常用于性别歧视案件，不适用于学校资助或财富分类。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 声称教育是“基本权利”。虽然许多州宪法将教育列为基本权利，但在联邦宪法MBE考试中，教育不是基本权利，因此不适用严格审查。
MBE Constitutional Law Tip: Always check if the classification is Suspect (Race), Quasi-Suspect (Gender), or Other (Wealth/Age).

questions.question:
A state statute permits a person's name to appear on the general election ballot as a candidate for statewide public office if the person pays a $100 filing fee and provides proof from the State Elections Board that he or she was nominated in the immediately preceding primary election by one of the state's two major political parties. It also permits the name of an independent candidate or a candidate of a smaller party to appear on the general election ballot if that person pays a filing fee of $1,000 and submits petitions signed by at least 3% of the voters who actually cast ballots for the office of governor in the last state election. The state maintains that these filing requirements are necessary to limit the size of the election ballot, to eliminate frivolous candidacies, and to help finance the high cost of elections.
Historically, very few of the state's voters who are members of racial minority groups have been members of either of the two major political parties. Recently, a new political party has been formed by some of these voters.
Which of the following constitutional provisions would be most helpful to the new political party as a basis for attacking the constitutionality of this state statute?

choices.a: The First Amendment.
choices.b: The Thirteenth Amendment.
choices.c: The Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.d: The Fifteenth Amendment.

一项州法律规定，如果一个人支付100美元的登记费，并提供州选举委员会的证明，证明其在紧接其前的初选中被本州两大主要政党之一提名为全州公职候选人，那么其名字可以出现在大选选票上。该法律还允许独立候选人或小党派候选人的名字出现在大选选票上，前提是该人支付1000美元的登记费，并提交在上次州长选举中实际投票的选民中至少3%的人签署的请愿书。该州主张，这些登记要求对于限制选票规模、消除无意义的参选以及资助高昂的选举费用是必要的。

历史上，该州属于少数族裔的选民中，很少有人是两大主要政党的成员。最近，其中一些选民成立了一个新的政党。

以下哪项宪法条款对于这个新政党作为攻击该州法律合宪性的依据最为有用？
options:
A. The First Amendment.
The First Amendment.

B. The Thirteenth Amendment.
The Thirteenth Amendment.

C. The Fourteenth Amendment.
The Fourteenth Amendment.

D. The Fifteenth Amendment.
The Fifteenth Amendment.
data.explanation:
State-election restrictions


RestrictionExamplesTest
Ordinary
(nondiscriminatory)		Voter registration Photo-ID requirement Disallowing write-in votingRational basis: challenger must show restriction lacks rational relationship to legitimate state interest
Severe
(discriminatory)		Poll tax Disallowing third-party candidacies Property-ownership requirementStrict scrutiny: state must show restriction is necessary to achieve compelling state interest
States have the power to regulate their own elections. But electoral regulations (as seen here) must comply with two constitutional provisions:

First Amendment freedom of association - protecting the right to freely engage in group expression and Fourteenth Amendment equal protection - requiring that similarly situated people be treated equally.

If an electoral regulation is challenged under either constitutional provision, the standard for evaluating that regulation depends on whether the burden imposed is ordinary (triggering rational basis review) or severe (triggering strict scrutiny). And since the First Amendment is applied to the states through the Fourteenth Amendment, the Fourteenth Amendment would be most helpful in attacking this state statute (Choice A).

(Choice B) The Thirteenth Amendment prohibits both government and private actors from engaging in slavery or involuntary servitude - neither of which is at issue here.

(Choice D) The Fifteenth Amendment prohibits both state and federal governments from denying any citizen the right to vote on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude. Here, the statute places a higher burden on independent and small-party candidates seeking ballot access - but it does not deny anyone the right to vote.

Educational objective: State electoral regulations must comply with the First Amendment freedom of association (applicable through the Fourteenth Amendment) and Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clauses. The standard for reviewing such regulations depends on whether the burden imposed is ordinary (rational basis) or severe (strict scrutiny).

不允许另书候选人		合理基础审查：挑战方必须证明该限制与合法的州利益缺乏合理关联

各州有权规范其自身的选举。但是，选举法规（如本案所示）必须遵守两项宪法条款：

First Amendment的结社自由——保护自由从事集体表达的权利以及Fourteenth Amendment的平等保护——要求处境相同的人得到平等待遇。

如果一项选举法规根据任一宪法条款受到挑战，评估该法规的标准取决于其施加的负担是普通的（触发合理基础审查）还是严格的（触发严格审查）。并且，由于First Amendment是通过Fourteenth Amendment适用于各州的，因此Fourteenth Amendment对于攻击该州法律最为有用（选项A）。

（选项B） Thirteenth Amendment禁止政府和私人行为者从事奴役或非自愿劳役——本案均未涉及。

（选项D） Fifteenth Amendment禁止州和联邦政府因种族、肤色或先前的奴役状况而剥夺任何公民的投票权。在本案中，该法律对寻求获得选票资格的独立候选人和小党派候选人施加了更重的负担——但它并未剥夺任何人的投票权。

教育目标：州的选举法规必须遵守First Amendment的结社自由（通过Fourteenth Amendment适用）和Fourteenth Amendment的平等保护条款。审查此类法规的标准取决于所施加的负担是普通的（合理基础审查）还是严格的（严格审查）。

References

Burdick v. Takushi, 504 U.S. 428, 433 - 34 (1992) (explaining that the level of scrutiny of an election law depends on the extent to which it burdens First and Fourteenth Amendment rights).

MBE 宪法题解析

Individual Rights / Ballot Access
正确答案：C The Fourteenth Amendment（第十四修正案）
⚖️ 法律解析

本题的核心在于选票准入资格（Ballot Access）的限制是否违宪。新政党要挑战该州法律，第十四修正案是最有力的武器，原因有二：

1. 平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause)

该州法律对“主要政党”和“小党/独立候选人”设定了截然不同的标准：

  • 主要政党：$100 费用 + 提名证明。
  • 小党/独立候选人：$1,000 费用 + 严苛的签名请愿（3%）。

这种基于政党规模的差别待遇（Disparate Treatment）直接触发了第十四修正案的平等保护条款分析。最高法院在 Lubin v. Panish 和 Williams v. Rhodes 等案件中裁定，对小党派施加过重的负担（尤其是没有替代性准入方式的高额费用）违反了平等保护原则。

2. 权利法案的适用 (Incorporation)

虽然结社自由（Freedom of Association）是第一修正案（First Amendment）的权利，但第一修正案仅限制联邦政府。要限制州政府（State Statute），必须通过第十四修正案的正当程序条款（Due Process Clause）将第一修正案的权利“纳入/吸收”（Incorporated）进来。

因此，即使论点涉及结社自由，第十四修正案也是连接宪法权利与州法律的必要桥梁。

❌ 为什么其他选项不佳？
选项 A (First Amendment)：
虽然法律确实侵犯了结社自由，但如上所述，第一修正案必须通过第十四修正案才能适用于州。在MBE中，如果选项同时出现 1st 和 14th，且涉及州法律对权利的限制，通常 14th 是更基础、更全面的依据（特别是涉及分类歧视时）。
选项 B (Thirteenth Amendment)：
该修正案禁止奴隶制（Slavery）和强迫劳役。与选举权无关。
选项 D (Fifteenth Amendment)：
这是一个强干扰项。题目提到了“少数族裔选民”，这让人联想到第十五修正案（禁止因种族剥夺投票权）。
排除理由：该法律表面上是基于“政党规模”和“金钱”进行限制，而非直接基于“种族”。虽然有种族影响，但第十五修正案主要针对直接剥夺投票权的行为。对于候选人资格和选票准入的结构性障碍，第十四修正案的平等保护（Equal Protection）是更标准的审查路径。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 当题目涉及州选举法（State Election Laws）对小党派或独立候选人施加比大党派更重的负担（如高额费用、复杂的请愿程序）时：

1. 这种限制通常受到严格审查（Strict Scrutiny）或一种严格的平衡测试。
2. 攻击此类法律的最佳宪法依据通常是第十四修正案的平等保护条款（因为它涉及对不同类型候选人的分类歧视）。

questions.question:
A group of students at a state university's law school wished to debate the future of affirmative action in that state and at that law school. For this debate, the students requested the use of a meeting room in the law school that is available on a first-come, first-served basis for extracurricular student use. Speakers presenting all sides of the issue were scheduled to participate. The law school administration denied the use of its meeting room for this purpose solely because it believed that "such a debate, even if balanced, would have a negative effect on the morale of the law school community and might cause friction among the students that would disrupt the institution's educational mission."
Is the law school's denial of the use of its meeting room for this purpose likely constitutional?

choices.a: No, because the law school cannot demonstrate that its action was necessary to serve a compelling state interest.
choices.b: No, because the law school cannot demonstrate that its action was rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
choices.c: Yes, because the law school's only concern was the adverse effect of such a discussion of affirmative action on the immediate audience and the mission of the institution.
choices.d: Yes, because the law students do not have a right to use a state-owned law school facility for a meeting that is not organized and sponsored by the law school itself.

一所州立大学法学院的一群学生希望就平权法案在该州及该法学院的未来进行辩论。为此，学生们申请使用法学院内一间供学生课外活动使用的会议室，该会议室遵循先到先得的原则。计划邀请代表各方观点的发言人参加。法学院行政部门拒绝了他们为此目的使用会议室的请求，唯一的理由是其认为“这样一场辩论，即使是平衡的，也会对法学院社区的士气产生负面影响，并可能在学生之间引起摩擦，从而扰乱该机构的教育使命。”

法学院为此目的拒绝使用其会议室的行为是否可能合宪？
options:
A. No, because the law school cannot demonstrate that its action was necessary to serve a compelling state interest.
不合宪，因为法学院无法证明其行为对于达成一项“紧迫的政府利益”而言是“必要”的。

B. No, because the law school cannot demonstrate that its action was rationally related to a legitimate state interest.
不合宪，因为法学院无法证明其行为与一项“合法的政府利益”存在“理性关联”。

C. Yes, because the law school's only concern was the adverse effect of such a discussion of affirmative action on the immediate audience and the mission of the institution.
合宪，因为法学院唯一关心的是，对此类平权法案的讨论对现场听众及该机构使命产生的负面影响。

D. Yes, because the law students do not have a right to use a state-owned law school facility for a meeting that is not organized and sponsored by the law school itself.
合宪，因为法学生无权使用州属法学院的设施来举办并非由法学院自身组织或赞助的会议。
data.explanation:
The First Amendment protects the right to free expression and encourages the free flow of ideas - even on government property. As a result, speech that occurs in a public forum cannot be regulated based on its message, subject, or ideas (ie, content-based restriction ) unless that regulation meets strict scrutiny. This standard of constitutional review gives the government the nearly impossible burden of proving that the restriction is necessary to serve a compelling government interest.

Here, a state-owned law school has a meeting room that is designated for extracurricular student use. A student group asked to use the room to debate affirmative action. However, the school denied this request because it feared that the content of the debate would negatively affect the school. As a result, the denial is subject to strict scrutiny. And since this is such a difficult standard to meet, the denial is likely unconstitutional.

(Choice B) Rational basis scrutiny requires the challenger (eg, students) to demonstrate that the government's content-based restriction was not rationally related to any legitimate state interest and viewpoint neutral. But this standard of review only applies when the government restricts use of (1) a nonpublic forum or (2) a public forum for an undesignated purpose (eg, something other than extracurricular student use).

(Choice C) The debate's effect on the immediate audience and the mission of the institution are important - but not compelling - concerns for the state-owned school. But even if they were compelling, the denial was not necessary to achieve those interests.

(Choice D) The meeting room is a designated public forum available for extracurricular student use. Therefore, the students had the right to use the room for a meeting - regardless of whether it was organized or sponsored by the law school - for that limited purpose.

Educational objective: The government cannot impose content-based restrictions on speech in public forums unless it can satisfy strict scrutiny - ie, show that the restrictions are necessary to achieve a compelling government interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 70%（正确选项），B选项 10%，C选项 14%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

First Amendment（第一修正案）保护自由表达的权利，并鼓励思想的自由交流——即使是在政府财产上。因此，在公共论坛上发表的言论，不能因其信息、主题或思想而受到规制（即基于内容的限制），除非该规制能满足严格审查标准。这一宪法审查标准赋予政府一项几乎不可能完成的举证责任，即证明该限制对于服务于一项紧迫的政府利益是必要的。

在本案中，一所州属法学院有一间指定用于学生课外活动的会议室。一个学生团体请求使用该会议室就平权法案进行辩论。然而，学校拒绝了这一请求，因为其担心辩论的内容会对学校产生负面影响。因此，该拒绝行为需接受严格审查。由于这是一个极难满足的标准，该拒绝行为很可能违宪。

(选项 B) 理性基础审查要求挑战方（例如，学生）证明政府基于内容的限制与任何合法的州利益并非理性相关，并且是观点中立的。但此审查标准仅适用于政府限制使用 (1) 非公共论坛或 (2) 将公共论坛用于非指定目的（例如，除学生课外活动之外的其他用途）的情况。

(选项 C) 辩论对现场听众和机构使命的影响对州属学校来说是重要的关切——但并非紧迫的关切。但即使这些是紧迫的利益，该拒绝行为对于实现这些利益也并非必要。

(选项 D) 该会议室是一个指定的公共论坛，可供学生用于课外活动。因此，学生有权为该限定目的而使用该会议室举行会议——无论会议是否由法学院组织或赞助。

教学目标：政府不得对公共论坛上的言论施加基于内容的限制，除非其能满足严格审查标准——即证明该限制对于实现一项紧迫的政府利益是必要的。

References

Widmar v. Vincent, 454 U.S. 263, 269 - 70 (1981) (holding that a state university's exclusion of a religious student group from using university facilities is a content-based restriction on speech subject to strict scrutiny).

MBE 考点解析

宪法第一修正案：言论自由与公共论坛
Individual Rights / First Amendment

本题考察的核心是公共论坛原则 (Public Forum Doctrine) 以及政府对言论进行基于内容的限制 (Content-Based Restriction) 时所需的审查标准。

1. 识别论坛类型 (Forum Analysis)

首先，我们需要确定发生言论限制的地点性质。本案中：

  • 地点：州立大学法学院的会议室。
  • 性质：学校将其开放供学生课外活动使用（first-come, first-served）。

结论：这是一个指定公共论坛 (Designated Public Forum)。一旦政府自愿将财产开放用于表达活动，它就必须遵守与传统公共论坛（如街道、公园）相同的规则。

2. 识别限制类型

学校拒绝的理由是基于辩论的主题（平权法案）及其可能带来的负面影响。

结论：这是基于内容的限制 (Content-Based Restriction)。学校不是在规制时间、地点或方式，而是在针对言论的内容进行规制。

3. 适用审查标准

在公共论坛（包括指定公共论坛）中，基于内容的言论限制必须通过严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。

严格审查的要求：

  1. 政府必须证明该限制是为了实现一项紧迫的政府利益 (Compelling State Interest)。
  2. 该限制手段必须是实现该利益所必要的 (Necessary) 或狭义剪裁的 (Narrowly Tailored)。

✅ 正确答案分析：选项 A

"No, because the law school cannot demonstrate that its action was necessary to serve a compelling state interest."

解析：

  • 由于学校的行为构成了在指定公共论坛上的基于内容的限制，因此必须适用严格审查。
  • 学校提出的理由（士气低落、学生摩擦）通常不足以构成“紧迫的政府利益”。
  • 即使这些利益是紧迫的，完全禁止使用会议室也不是“必要”的手段（手段过于宽泛）。
  • 因此，学校无法满足严格审查的举证责任，其拒绝行为违宪。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 B (Rational Basis)： 错误。理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review) 仅适用于非公共论坛 (Nonpublic Forum) 或观点中立的限制。本案涉及指定公共论坛的内容限制，标准过低。
选项 C (Adverse Effect)： 错误。这就是所谓的“起哄者的否决” (Heckler's Veto)。政府不能仅仅因为担心听众的负面反应或潜在的摩擦而禁止言论，除非达到“迫在眉睫的不法行为” (Imminent Lawless Action) 的程度。
选项 D (Right to Use)： 错误。虽然学生没有天生的权利使用任何政府设施，但一旦政府将该设施指定为公共论坛（如本案中的会议室），政府就不能随意剥夺学生的使用权，必须遵守宪法第一修正案的约束。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理涉及学校、政府办公楼等场所的言论自由题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 定性：这是什么类型的论坛？(传统、指定、还是非公共？)
  2. 定规：限制是针对内容 (Content) 还是仅仅针对时间/地点/方式 (TPM)？
  3. 定标：
    - 内容限制 ➝ 严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)
    - 中立的TPM限制 ➝ 中度审查 (Intermediate Scrutiny)

本题中：指定论坛 + 内容限制 = 严格审查。

Reference Case: Widmar v. Vincent (1981)

questions.question:
A state barber licensing statute provides that the Barber Licensing Board may revoke a barber license if it finds that a licensee has used his or her business premises for an illegal purpose.
A licensed barber in the state was arrested by federal narcotics enforcement agents on a charge of selling cocaine in his barbershop in violation of federal laws. However, the local United States Attorney declined to prosecute, and the charges were dropped.
Nevertheless, the Barber Licensing Board commenced a proceeding against the barber to revoke his license on the ground that he used his business premises for illegal sales of cocaine. At a subsequent hearing before the board, the only evidence against the barber was affidavits by unnamed informants, who were not present or available for cross-examination. Their affidavits stated that they purchased cocaine from the barber in his barbershop. Based solely on this evidence, the board found that the barber used his business premises for an illegal purpose and ordered his license revoked.
In a suit to have this revocation set aside, what is the barber's best constitutional argument?

choices.a: Article III requires a penalty of the kind imposed on the barber to be imposed by a court rather than an administrative agency.
choices.b: The administrative license revocation proceeding was invalid because it denied full faith and credit to the dismissal of the criminal charges by the United States Attorney.
choices.c: The barber's inability to cross-examine his accusers denied him a fair hearing and caused him to be deprived of his barber license without due process of law.
choices.d: The existence of federal laws penalizing the illegal sale of cocaine preempts state action relating to drug trafficking of the kind involved in the barber's case.

data.questionStem:
Q82073

A state barber licensing statute provides that the Barber Licensing Board may revoke a barber license if it finds that a licensee has used his or her business premises for an illegal purpose.

A licensed barber in the state was arrested by federal narcotics enforcement agents on a charge of selling cocaine in his barbershop in violation of federal laws. However, the local United States Attorney declined to prosecute, and the charges were dropped.

Nevertheless, the Barber Licensing Board commenced a proceeding against the barber to revoke his license on the ground that he used his business premises for illegal sales of cocaine. At a subsequent hearing before the board, the only evidence against the barber was affidavits by unnamed informants, who were not present or available for cross-examination. Their affidavits stated that they purchased cocaine from the barber in his barbershop. Based solely on this evidence, the board found that the barber used his business premises for an illegal purpose and ordered his license revoked.

In a suit to have this revocation set aside, what is the barber's best constitutional argument?

某州的理发师执照法规规定，如果理发师执照委员会 (Barber Licensing Board) 发现持照人将其营业场所用于非法目的，委员会有权吊销其理发师执照。

该州一名持照理发师因被指控在其理发店内出售可卡因，违反了联邦法律，而被联邦缉毒人员逮捕。然而，当地联邦检察官 (United States Attorney) 决定不予起诉，该指控被撤销。

尽管如此，理发师执照委员会仍以该理发师利用其营业场所非法销售可卡因为由，启动了吊销其执照的程序。在委员会随后的听证会上，对该理发师不利的唯一证据是来自匿名举报人的宣誓书，而这些举报人并未出庭，也无法接受交叉询问。他们的宣誓书中称，他们在该理发师的理发店内向其购买了可卡因。委员会仅凭此证据，便认定该理发师将其营业场所用于非法目的，并下令吊销其执照。

在请求撤销此吊销决定的诉讼中，该理发师的最佳宪法论点是什么？
options:
A. Article III requires a penalty of the kind imposed on the barber to be imposed by a court rather than an administrative agency.
《宪法》第三条 (Article III) 要求，施加于该理发师的此类处罚应由法院而非行政机构作出。

B. The administrative license revocation proceeding was invalid because it denied full faith and credit to the dismissal of the criminal charges by the United States Attorney.
该行政执照吊销程序无效，因为它未对联邦检察官 (United States Attorney) 撤销刑事指控的决定给予充分信任与尊重 (full faith and credit)。

C. The barber's inability to cross-examine his accusers denied him a fair hearing and caused him to be deprived of his barber license without due process of law.
理发师无法对指控人进行交叉询问，这剥夺了他获得公平听证的机会，并导致他在未经正当法律程序的情况下被剥夺了理发师执照。

D. The existence of federal laws penalizing the illegal sale of cocaine preempts state action relating to drug trafficking of the kind involved in the barber's case.
惩罚非法销售可卡因的联邦法律的存在，优先适用 (preempts) 于与理发师案件中所涉此类毒品贩运相关的州级行动。
data.explanation:
A person has a property interest in a benefit that is conferred by state law (eg, professional license, welfare benefits). The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause safeguards this interest by requiring states to follow certain procedures before intentionally depriving persons thereof. This typically includes providing persons with:
  • adequate notice of the charges or proceedings against them and
  • a meaningful opportunity to be heard - ie, to confront adverse witnesses and present arguments - before a neutral decision-maker.

Here, the Barber Licensing Board commenced a proceeding to revoke the barber's license. The only evidence presented against the barber was affidavits by unnamed informants, who were not present or available for cross-examination. Therefore, the barber's best argument to have his revocation set aside is that his inability to confront his accusers denied him a fair hearing and due process of law.

(Choice A) Article III limits the power of the federal courts. It does not apply to state courts or any other state proceedings (as seen here).

(Choice B) The full faith and credit clause requires states to recognize valid judgments issued by other states - not charges dismissed by the United States Attorney (or other states).

(Choice D) Under the Article IV supremacy clause, a state law is void if it is preempted by federal law. But federal laws penalizing the illegal sale of cocaine do not preempt state action relating to drug trafficking because these laws are not in conflict.

Educational objective: Due process requires that the government provide persons with (1) adequate notice and (2) a meaningful opportunity to be heard by a neutral decision-maker - and to confront adverse witnesses - before intentionally depriving them of life, liberty, or property.



选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 7%，C选项 86%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

个人对于州法律授予的利益（例如，专业执照、福利）拥有财产权益。第十四修正案 (Fourteenth Amendment) 的正当程序 (due process) 条款通过要求各州在有意剥夺个人该项权益之前遵守特定程序来保障此项权益。这通常包括向当事人提供：
  • 关于对其提出的指控或程序的充分通知以及
  • 在一个中立的决策者面前获得有意义的被听证机会——即与不利证人对质并提出论点的机会。

在本案中，理发师执照委员会 (Barber Licensing Board) 启动了吊销该理发师执照的程序。对该理发师不利的唯一证据是来自匿名举报人的宣誓书，而这些举报人并未出庭，也无法接受交叉询问。因此，该理发师请求撤销吊销决定的最佳论点是，他无法与指控人对质，这剥夺了他获得公平听证的机会和正当法律程序。

(选项 A) 《宪法》第三条 (Article III) 限制的是联邦法院的权力。它不适用于州法院或任何其他州级程序（如本案所示）。

(选项 B) 充分信任与尊重条款 (full faith and credit clause) 要求各州承认其他州作出的有效判决——而不是联邦检察官 (United States Attorney)（或其他州）撤销的指控。

(选项 D) 根据至上条款 (Supremacy Clause)，如果一项州法律被联邦法律所优先适用 (preempted)，则该州法律无效。但是，惩罚非法销售可卡因的联邦法律并没有优先适用 (preempt) 于涉及毒品贩运的州级行动，因为这些法律并不冲突。

教学目标：正当程序 (Due process) 要求政府在有意剥夺个人的生命、自由或财产之前，必须向其提供 (1) 充分的通知，以及 (2) 在中立的决策者面前获得有意义的被听证机会——包括与不利证人对质的机会。

References

Willner v. Comm. on Character & Fitness, 373 U.S. 96, 103 (1963) (explaining that "procedural due process often requires confrontation and cross-examination of those whose word deprives a person of his livelihood").

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

程序性正当程序 (Procedural Due Process)
核心法律规则

第十四修正案 (14th Amendment) 禁止各州在未经正当法律程序 (Due Process of Law) 的情况下剥夺任何人的生命、自由或财产。

当政府剥夺个人的职业执照 (Professional License) 时，必须提供：

  • 充分的通知 (Notice)
  • 有意义的听证机会 (Opportunity to be heard)
🔍 案件深度解析

本案的关键在于听证的质量是否符合宪法要求。

1. 财产权益 (Property Interest)：
理发师执照是由州法律授予的，属于持照人的财产权益。剥夺它必须经过正当程序。

2. 听证缺陷 (The Defect)：
委员会仅依据匿名举报人的宣誓书 (Affidavits by unnamed informants) 做出决定。理发师无法见到这些人，也无法进行交叉询问 (Cross-examination)。

3. 法律结论：
在涉及生计剥夺的行政听证中，如果事实存在争议，正当程序通常要求给予当事人与不利证人对质 (Confrontation) 和交叉询问的权利。仅凭无法质证的传闻证据 (Hearsay) 剥夺执照违反了正当程序。

✅ 正确答案分析
选项 C 最佳论点

理由：理发师无法对指控者进行交叉询问，剥夺了他获得公平听证的机会。

这是经典的程序性正当程序抗辩。最高法院在 Willner v. Comm. on Character & Fitness (1963) 等案件中确立，当个人的生计受到威胁时，正当程序要求有权对不利证据进行质证。

❌ 陷阱选项排除
选项 A Article III (司法权)

错误点：宪法第三条限制的是联邦法院的权力。它并不禁止行政机构（Administrative Agencies）进行裁决或吊销执照。行政法体系允许机构行使准司法权。

选项 B Full Faith and Credit (充分信任与尊重)

错误点：该条款要求各州承认其他州的司法判决。联邦检察官决定“不起诉”并非司法判决，且行政程序（执照吊销）与刑事程序（定罪）的标准不同，互不冲突。

选项 D Preemption (联邦优先权)

错误点：联邦毒品法律并不“占领”整个领域从而禁止州政府管理职业执照。州政府有权根据其治安权 (Police Power) 监管职业行为，即使涉及违反联邦法律的行为。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“行政听证 (Administrative Hearing)” + “剥夺执照/福利 (Revocation of License/Benefits)” 的题目时：

  1. 首先确认是否存在财产权益 (Property Interest)（执照通常都是）。
  2. 检查程序是否公平。如果题目提到“无法交叉询问 (No cross-examination)” 或 “仅凭传闻证据 (Solely on hearsay)”，这通常就是违反 Due Process 的关键点。
© MBE 宪法考点复习 | Individual Rights

questions.question:
A doctor is a resident of state A and is licensed to practice medicine in State A as well as neighboring State B. The doctor finds that the most convenient place to treat her patients who need hospital care is in a publicly owned and operated hospital located in State B. For many years, the doctor had successfully treated her patients in that hospital.
Early this year, the hospital adopted a new rule in conformance with all required procedures. The new rule stated that every doctor who practices in that hospital must be a resident of State B. The doctor was then notified that she could no longer treat patients in that hospital because she was not a resident of State B.
Which of the following constitutional provisions would be most helpful to the doctor in an action to challenge her exclusion from the State B hospital solely on the basis of this hospital rule?

choices.a: The bill of attainder clause.
choices.b: The due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
choices.c: The ex post facto clause.
choices.d: The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.

Q82120

A doctor is a resident of state A and is licensed to practice medicine in State A as well as neighboring State B. The doctor finds that the most convenient place to treat her patients who need hospital care is in a publicly owned and operated hospital located in State B. For many years, the doctor had successfully treated her patients in that hospital.

Early this year, the hospital adopted a new rule in conformance with all required procedures. The new rule stated that every doctor who practices in that hospital must be a resident of State B. The doctor was then notified that she could no longer treat patients in that hospital because she was not a resident of State B.

Which of the following constitutional provisions would be most helpful to the doctor in an action to challenge her exclusion from the State B hospital solely on the basis of this hospital rule?

一名医生是A州的居民，并且拥有在A州及邻近的B州行医的执照。该医生发现，对于需要住院治疗的病人来说，最方便的治疗地点是位于B州的一家公立医院。多年来，该医生一直在那家医院成功地为她的病人进行治疗。

今年年初，该医院依据所有法定程序通过了一项新规定。新规定指出，在该医院行医的每位医生都必须是B州的居民。随后，该医生被告知，由于她不是B州的居民，她不能再在该医院治疗病人。

在仅基于此医院规定而对该医生进行排除的诉讼中，下列哪项宪法条款对该医生最具帮助？
options:
A. The bill of attainder clause.
剥夺公权法案条款。

B. The due process clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.
《第十四修正案》的正当程序条款。

C. The ex post facto clause.
溯及既往法条款。

D. The privileges and immunities clause of Article IV.
《宪法》第四条的特权与豁免条款。
data.explanation:
Rights of state citizenship (Article IV privileges & immunities clause)


Travel/reside in statePursue employmentPractice commercial trade/business
Own/transfer propertySeek medical servicesAccess state courts
Civil libertiesCreditor's rightsTax exemptions
The Article IV privileges and immunities clause generally prohibits states from discriminating against citizens of other states by denying them a right of state citizenship. But such discrimination is valid if the state can show a substantial reason for the difference in treatment - ie:

nonresidents cause or contribute to the problem that the state is attempting to solve and there are no less restrictive means to solve this problem.

Here, the State B hospital rule discriminates against out-of-state doctors by excluding them from practicing in that hospital. This denies out-of-state doctors a right of state citizenship - to practice their profession in State B. And since there is no evidence that out-of-state doctors contribute to any problem the state is trying to solve, the hospital rule likely violates the Article IV privileges and immunities clause. Therefore, this clause would be most helpful to the State A doctor in challenging her exclusion.

(Choice A) The hospital rule is not a prohibited bill of attainder - ie, a legislative act that punishes a specified person or group without a judicial trial - since it is not a legislative act and does not seek to punish the doctor.

(Choice B) The Fourteenth Amendment due process clause prohibits states from depriving persons of life, liberty, or property without adequate justification. When no fundamental right is involved (as seen here), the state action need only be rationally related to a legitimate state interest.

And since state action is almost always upheld under this rational basis test, the hospital rule likely complies with due process.

(Choice C) The Article I ex post facto clauses bar state and federal governments from enacting criminal statutes that punish actions retroactively. But the hospital rule is not an ex post facto law since it is civil in nature.

Educational objective: The Article IV privileges and immunities clause prohibits states from discriminating against out-of-state citizens by denying them a right of state citizenship unless (1) nonresidents cause or contribute to the problem that the state is attempting to solve and (2) there are no less restrictive means to solve it.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 16%，C选项 2%，D选项 79%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

州公民权 (《宪法》第四条特权与豁免条款)


在一州内旅行/居住寻求就业从事商业贸易/经营
拥有/转让财产寻求医疗服务使用州法院
公民自由债权人权利税收豁免
《宪法》第四条的特权与豁免条款通常禁止各州歧视其他州的公民，即剥夺他们的州公民权。但如果州政府能够为这种差别对待提出充分的理由，那么这种歧视就是有效的——即：

非居民导致或促成了州政府试图解决的问题，并且没有限制性更小的手段来解决该问题。

在本案中，B州医院的规定歧视了外州医生，将他们排除在该医院的执业范围之外。这剥夺了外州医生的一项州公民权——即在B州执业的权利。并且，由于没有证据表明外州医生导致了州政府试图解决的任何问题，该医院规定很可能违反了《宪法》第四条的特权与豁免条款。因此，在挑战将其排除在外的诉讼中，该条款对A州的医生最有帮助。

(选项A) 医院的规定并非被禁止的剥夺公权法案——即未经司法审判就惩罚特定个人或群体的立法行为——因为它不是一项立法行为，也并非意图惩罚该医生。

(选项B) 《第十四修正案》的正当程序条款禁止各州在没有充分理由的情况下剥夺任何人的生命、自由或财产。当不涉及基本权利时（如本案所示），州政府的行为只需与合法的州利益有理性关联即可。

而且，由于在这种理性基础审查下，州政府的行为几乎总能被维持，因此医院的规定很可能符合正当程序的要求。

(选项C) 《宪法》第一条的溯及既往条款禁止州和联邦政府制定对行为进行追溯惩罚的刑事法规。但医院的规定并非溯及既往法，因为其本质上是民事性质的。

教学目标：《宪法》第四条的特权与豁免条款禁止各州通过剥夺州公民权来歧视外州公民，除非 (1) 非居民导致或促成了州政府试图解决的问题，并且 (2) 没有限制性更小的手段来解决该问题。

References

Ward v. Maryland, 79 U.S. 418, 430 (1870) (holding that the Article IV privileges and immunities clause protects the right of non-state citizens to enter another state to conduct business or practice a trade).

16B Am. Jur. 2d Constitutional Law § 800 (listing examples of privileges and immunities of state citizenship).

MBE 宪法考点解析

Individual Rights / Privileges & Immunities

✅ 正确答案：D
《宪法》第四条的特权与豁免条款
(The Privileges and Immunities Clause of Article IV)
核心考点：第四条特权与豁免条款

规则定义：
《宪法》第四条（Article IV, Section 2）禁止各州在涉及“基本权利” (Fundamental Rights) 或 重要经济活动 时，歧视外州公民 (Non-residents/Citizens of other states)。

保护范围：
这里的“基本权利”主要指对国家统一至关重要的权利，最常见的考点是：

  • 谋生权 / 从事商业贸易 (To pursue a livelihood / practice a trade)
  • 拥有和转让财产
  • 进入该州法院诉讼

本题案情分析

本题中，B州医院（政府实体）出台规定，禁止非B州居民的医生在此行医。

  1. 歧视行为： 规定直接基于“居住地” (Residency) 区别对待，将A州医生排除在外。
  2. 涉及权利： 医生行医属于谋生权 (Right to earn a living)，受到第四条特权与豁免条款的保护。
  3. 审查标准： 州政府必须证明：
    • 非居民是导致某种“特定罪恶” (Peculiar evil) 的原因；且
    • 歧视手段与解决该问题有实质性联系 (Substantial Relationship)，且没有限制性更小的替代方案。

由于B州没有正当理由（如外州医生导致了医疗事故增加等），该规定极有可能违宪。因此，该条款是医生挑战该规定最有力的武器。

为什么不选其他选项？

这是MBE中常见的干扰项陷阱，特别是选项B。

选项 法律依据 为何本题不适用/不“最有帮助”
B. 第十四修正案正当程序 (Due Process) 禁止未经正当程序剥夺生命、自由、财产。 虽然医生有从业的“自由/财产”利益，但对于经济管制，法院仅适用理性基础审查 (Rational Basis Review)。只要州政府有一个“合理的理由”，规定就会被维持。这对原告（医生）非常不利。
A. 剥夺公权法案 (Bill of Attainder) 禁止立法机关未经审判惩罚特定个人/群体。 医院的规定是行政规则，且目的是管理而非“惩罚”，不符合定义。
C. 溯及既往法 (Ex Post Facto) 禁止追溯既往的刑事法律。 此条款仅适用于刑事法规 (Criminal Statutes)，不适用于民事或行政许可规定。
💡 MBE 破题技巧

当你看到题目中出现：

“State A vs. State B” (跨州)
+
“歧视非居民” (Discrimination against non-residents)
+
“工作/商业/谋生” (Commercial activity/Livelihood)

👉 首选 Article IV Privileges and Immunities Clause。

注意区分： 如果是歧视“外国人” (Aliens/Non-citizens)，则通常适用第十四修正案的平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause)，审查标准为严格审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。

questions.question:
A man, who is a resident noncitizen, applied for employment as a state trooper with the state highway patrol. After the man passed a psychological examination and completed the requisite training courses, he was denied employment. The state highway patrol agency explained that the man was ineligible for employment as a state trooper pursuant to a policy that the agency had enacted six months prior. The policy disqualifies all noncitizens from employment with the state highway patrol, restricting employment to U.S. citizens.
The man has filed an action for a declaratory judgment that the agency's policy is unconstitutional as applied to him.
Which of the following best states the burden of persuasion in this action?

choices.a: The agency must demonstrate a rational relationship between the citizenship requirement and a legitimate state interest.
choices.b: The agency must demonstrate that the citizenship requirement is the least restrictive means to achieve a compelling government interest.
choices.c: The man must demonstrate that the citizenship requirement is not narrowly tailored to achieve a compelling state interest.
choices.d: The man must demonstrate that the citizenship requirement is not rationally related to a legitimate state interest.

questions.question:
A federal criminal law imposes penalties for the intentional publication of communications by individuals who know or have reason to know that the communications were unlawfully recorded.
A teachers' union and school board were engaged in contentious negotiations over a collective-bargaining agreement. One of the members of the teachers' union unlawfully placed a wiretap on the president of the school board's telephone. The teachers' union member anonymously sent the recordings of several of the president's phone conversations about the negotiations to a local radio talk show host. The talk show host received the recordings in a box with no return address, sender information, or label. After listening to the recordings, the talk show host played them on her show. In the conversations, the president made several derogatory and embarrassing remarks.
A prosecutor subsequently filed charges against the radio talk show host for playing the recordings on her show in violation of the federal law. The radio talk show host claims that the federal law is unconstitutional.
Is the prosecution of the radio talk show host under the federal law likely constitutional?

choices.a: No, because the federal law is a prior restraint.
choices.b: No, because the host did not unlawfully obtain the recordings.
choices.c: Yes, because private phone conversations are not a matter of public concern.
choices.d: Yes, because the host knew that the recordings were unlawfully obtained.

一项联邦刑事法律规定，对于知悉或有理由知悉通讯内容系被非法录制，而故意公布该通讯内容的个人，将处以刑罚。

一个教师工会和一个学校董事会正在就一份集体谈判协议进行充满争议的谈判。该教师工会的一名成员在学校董事会主席的电话上非法安装了窃听器。该教师工会成员匿名将主席几次关于谈判的电话交谈录音寄给了一位当地电台脱口秀主持人。该脱口秀主持人在一个没有任何回邮地址、发件人信息或标签的盒子里收到了这些录音。在听完录音后，该脱口秀主持人在她的节目中播放了这些录音。在交谈中，主席发表了一些贬损性和令人尴尬的言论。

一名检察官随后对该电台脱口秀主持人提起指控，因其在节目中播放录音违反了该联邦法律。该电台脱口秀主持人声称该联邦法律违宪。

根据该联邦法律对该电台脱口秀主持人的起诉是否可能合宪？
options:
A. No, because the federal law is a prior restraint.
不合宪，因为该联邦法律是一种事先限制。

B. No, because the host did not unlawfully obtain the recordings and does not know who did.
不合宪，因为该主持人并非非法获取录音，也不知道是谁获取的。

C. Yes, because private phone conversations are not a matter of public concern.
合宪，因为私人电话交谈不属于公众关注的事务。

D. Yes, because the host knew that the recordings were unlawfully obtained.
合宪，因为该主持人知悉该录音系非法获取。
data.explanation:
The First Amendment shields the media from criminal and civil liability for publishing lawfully obtained private facts (eg, crime victim's identity) and other truthful information involving matters of public concern (ie, newsworthy events). This amendment also shields the media from liability for publishing truthful information that is unlawfully obtained by a third party if the information involves a matter of public concern and the publisher neither obtained it unlawfully nor knows who did.

Here, the federal government prosecuted the radio talk show host for publishing the recordings of the school board president's phone conversations, which were unlawfully obtained by a member of the teachers' union. The conversations involve a matter of public concern since they relate to the ongoing collective-bargaining negotiations. Additionally, the host did not unlawfully obtain the recordings herself and did not know the member who anonymously sent them to her. Therefore, the prosecution is likely unconstitutional.

(Choice A) A prior restraint is a government action (eg, an injunction) that prohibits a publication before it occurs. Since the federal law here penalizes a publication after it occurs, it is not a prior restraint.

(Choice C) The phone conversations are a matter of public concern because public and private statements about collective-bargaining negotiations between a school board and a teachers' union are newsworthy.

(Choice D) The host may have had reason to believe that the recordings were unlawfully obtained. However, she did not unlawfully obtain them herself or know who did because they were sent in box with no return address, sender information, or label. Therefore, she had the right to publish the information without punishment.

Educational objective: The First Amendment shields the media from liability for publishing truthful information that was unlawfully obtained by a third party if
  • the information involves a matter of public concern and
  • the publisher neither obtained it unlawfully nor knows who did.


选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 48%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

First Amendment 保护媒体在公布合法获取的私密事实（如犯罪受害人身份）以及其他涉及公众关注事务（即具有新闻价值的事件）的真实信息时，免于承担刑事和民事责任。该修正案也保护媒体免于承担责任，当其公布由第三方非法获取的真实信息时，前提是该信息涉及公众关注的事务，并且公布者既非非法获取该信息，也不知悉非法获取者是谁。

在本案中，联邦政府因电台脱口秀主持人公布了由教师工会成员非法获取的学校董事会主席的电话录音而对其提起诉讼。由于这些谈话内容与正在进行的集体谈判有关，因此涉及公众关注的事务。此外，主持人本人并非非法获取这些录音，也不知道是哪位成员匿名将录音寄给了她。因此，此项起诉很可能违宪。

(选项A) “事先限制”是一种政府行为（例如，禁令），其在出版物发行前即予以禁止。由于本案中的联邦法律是在出版物发行后进行处罚，因此它不构成“事先限制”。

(选项C) 电话交谈内容确实属于公众关注的事务，因为关于学校董事会与教师工会之间集体谈判的公开和私下言论具有新闻价值。

(选项D) 主持人或许有理由相信录音系非法获取。然而，她本人并未非法获取这些录音，也不知道是谁获取的，因为这些录音是装在一个没有回邮地址、发件人信息或标签的盒子里寄来的。因此，她有权公布该信息而不受处罚。

教学目的： First Amendment 保护媒体在公布由第三方非法获取的真实信息时免于承担责任，如果：
  • 该信息涉及公众关注的事务，且
  • 公布者既非非法获取该信息，也不知悉非法获取者是谁。


References

Bartnicki v. Vopper, 532 U.S. 514, 535 (2001) (holding that the First Amendment prevents liability for the publication of truthful information about a matter of public concern unlawfully obtained by an unknown third party).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

宪法第一修正案与非法获取的信息

正确答案：B

不合宪，因为该主持人并非非法获取录音，也不知道是谁获取的。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)

本题考察的是 First Amendment（第一修正案）对媒体发布非法获取信息的保护范围。核心判例是 Bartnicki v. Vopper (2001)。

规则如下：如果媒体发布的信息满足以下三个条件，即使该信息最初是由第三方非法获取的（如非法窃听），媒体也受到宪法保护，免受刑事或民事处罚：

  1. 信息涉及公众关注的事务 (Matter of public concern)；
  2. 发布者本人没有参与非法获取行为 (Did not participate in the interception)；
  3. 发布者是通过合法途径获得该信息的（例如匿名邮件）。
🔍 案情逻辑分析
1
公众关注 (Public Concern)：
录音内容涉及学校董事会与工会的集体谈判。这是典型的公共事务，具有新闻价值。
2
发布者行为 (Publisher's Conduct)：
主持人收到的是匿名包裹。虽然她可能猜到录音是非法的（因为是窃听），但她本人并没有安装窃听器，也不知道是谁安装的。
3
结论：
根据 Bartnicki 案，政府对隐私的保护利益不足以压倒针对公共事务的言论自由利益。因此，起诉违宪。
❌ 干扰项解析
选项 A (Prior Restraint) 错误：
“事先限制”是指政府在信息发布之前禁止其发布（如禁令 Injunction）。本案是对发布之后的行为进行刑事处罚，这属于事后惩罚 (Subsequent Punishment)，而非事先限制。
选项 C (Public Concern) 错误：
这在事实认定上是错误的。公立学校董事会的谈判显然属于公众关注的事务，而非纯粹的私事。
选项 D (Knowledge) 错误：这是最强的干扰项。
虽然法律条文规定“知悉非法录制”即犯罪，但在宪法层面，仅仅“知悉来源非法”并不足以剥夺媒体的 First Amendment 保护权。只要媒体本身没有参与非法行为（Clean Hands），且内容涉及公共利益，即便知道来源不仅是违规的甚至是犯罪的，媒体仍有权发布。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到涉及媒体发布泄密/非法材料的题目时，请检查：

  • 内容：是否涉及公共利益？(通常是的)
  • 手段：媒体自己偷了吗？还是别人偷了给媒体的？

如果是别人偷了给媒体，且媒体没有教唆或参与盗窃，First Amendment 通常会保护媒体。

MBE Constitutional Law Review

questions.question:
A city's personnel handbook contains all of that city's personnel policies. One section of the handbook states that "where feasible and practicable supervisors are encouraged to follow the procedures specified in this handbook before discharging a city employee." Those specified procedures include a communication to the employee of the reasons for the contemplated discharge and an opportunity for a pre-termination trial-type hearing at which the employee may challenge those reasons.
After a year of service, the secretary to the city council was discharged without having received any communication of reasons for her contemplated discharge and without having received an opportunity for a pre-termination trial-type hearing.
The former secretary files suit in federal district court to challenge her discharge solely on constitutional grounds.
Which of the following best describes the initial burden of persuasion in that suit?

choices.a: The city council must demonstrate that its personnel handbook created no constitutionally protected interest in city employment or in the procedures by which such employment is terminated.
choices.b: The city council must demonstrate that the former secretary's termination was for good cause.
choices.c: The former secretary must demonstrate that she reasonably believed that she could work for the city for as long as she wished.
choices.d: The former secretary must demonstrate that state law creates a constitutionally protected interest in her employment or in the procedures by which her employment is terminated.

One section of the handbook states that "where feasible and practicable supervisors are encouraged to follow the procedures specified in this handbook before discharging a city employee." Those specified procedures include a communication to the employee of the reasons for the contemplated discharge and an opportunity for a pre-termination trial-type hearing at which the employee may challenge those reasons.

After a year of service, the secretary to the city council was discharged without having received any communication of reasons for her contemplated discharge and without having received an opportunity for a pre-termination trial-type hearing.

The former secretary files suit in federal district court to challenge her discharge solely on constitutional grounds.

Which of the following best describes the initial burden of persuasion in that suit?

某市的员工手册包含了该市所有的人事政策。手册中有一节规定，「在可行和切实的情况下，鼓励主管在解雇市政雇员之前，遵循本手册中规定的程序。」这些规定的程序包括：向雇员告知计划解雇的理由，并提供一次解雇前审讯式听证会的机会，雇员可以在听证会上对这些理由提出质疑。

在服务一年后，市议会的秘书被解雇，但她并未收到任何关于计划解雇理由的通知，也未获得解雇前审讯式听证会的机会。

该前任秘书在联邦地区法院提起诉讼，完全基于宪法理由对其解雇提出质疑。

以下哪项最能描述该诉讼中的初步说服责任？
options:
A. The city council must demonstrate that its personnel handbook created no constitutionally protected interest in city employment or in the procedures by which such employment is terminated.
市议会必须证明，其员工手册并未在市政雇佣关系中或在终止此类雇佣关系的程序中，创设任何受宪法保护的利益。

B. The city council must demonstrate that the former secretary's termination was for good cause.
市议会必须证明，解雇前任秘书是基于正当理由的。

C. The former secretary must demonstrate that she reasonably believed that she could work for the city for as long as she wished.
前任秘书必须证明，她有合理理由相信，只要她愿意，就可以一直为该市工作。

D. The former secretary must demonstrate that state law creates a constitutionally protected interest in her employment or in the procedures by which her employment is terminated.
前任秘书必须证明，州法律在其雇佣关系中或在终止其雇佣关系的程序中，创设了一项受宪法保护的利益。
data.explanation:
The former secretary's claim raises the Fourteenth Amendment right to procedural due process , which requires states and municipalities to follow certain procedures when they intentionally deprive a person of life, liberty, or property. These procedures include giving persons:

notice of the charges, proceedings, or other actions against them and a meaningful opportunity to be heard by a neutral decision-maker.

In a due process claim, the challenging party has the initial burden of showing that he/she has a protected life, liberty, or property interest at stake. Therefore, the former secretary must demonstrate that state law created a constitutionally protected interest in her employment or the procedures by which she was terminated (Choice A).

(Choice B) The city council would only need to demonstrate that the former secretary's termination was for good cause if she first demonstrates that she has a constitutionally protected interest in her employment.

(Choice C) Public employees have a property interest in their jobs if they
  • have an ongoing employment contract,
  • can only be fired for cause, or
  • receive assurances of continued employment.
But the former secretary's reasonable belief that she could work for the city as long as she wished would not create this interest.

Educational objective: Procedural due process requires the government to follow certain procedures when it intentionally deprives a person of life, liberty, or property. And in a due process claim, the challenger has the initial burden of showing that he/she has a protected interest at stake.



选项正确率统计：A选项 23%，B选项 7%，C选项 6%，D选项 62%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

前任秘书的主张提出了《Fourteenth Amendment》下的 procedural due process 权利，该权利要求州和市政府在有意剥夺个人生命、自由或财产时，必须遵循特定程序。这些程序包括给予个人：

关于对其提起的指控、诉讼或其他行动的通知以及由中立决策者听取其陈述的有意义的机会。

在正当程序索赔中，质疑方负有初步举证责任，需证明其有受保护的生命、自由或财产利益受到威胁。因此，前任秘书必须证明州法律在其雇佣关系中或终止其雇佣的程序中创设了受宪法保护的利益（选项A）。

（选项B）只有在前任秘书首先证明她在其雇佣关系中拥有受宪法保护的利益之后，市议会才需要证明解雇她是基于正当理由的。

（选项C）公职雇员在满足以下条件时，其工作即构成一项财产利益：
  • 拥有持续的雇佣合同，
  • 只能因正当理由被解雇，或者
  • 获得持续雇佣的保证。
但是，前任秘书关于只要她愿意就可以一直为该市工作的合理信念，并不会创设此种利益。

教学目标：Procedural due process 要求政府在有意剥夺个人的生命、自由或财产时，必须遵循特定程序。并且，在正当程序索赔中，质疑方负有初步举证责任，需证明其有受保护的利益受到威胁。

References

Cleveland Bd. of Educ. v. Loudermill, 470 U.S. 532, 538 (1985) (holding that a state cannot terminate an employee without due process when the employee has a property right in his/her employment).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law
✅ 正确答案：D

前任秘书必须证明，州法律在其雇佣关系中或在终止其雇佣关系的程序中，创设了一项受宪法保护的利益。

⚖️ 核心考点：程序性正当程序 (Procedural Due Process)

本题考察的是第十四修正案下的程序性正当程序条款。在分析此类问题时，必须遵循两步走的逻辑：

  1. 第一步（门槛问题）：当事人是否被剥夺了受宪法保护的生命、自由或财产利益 (Life, Liberty, or Property Interest)？
  2. 第二步：如果是，政府提供的程序是否符合正当程序 (Due Process) 的要求？

1. 举证责任 (Burden of Persuasion)

在宪法诉讼中，原告（前任秘书）负有初步的举证责任。她必须首先证明自己拥有受保护的“财产利益”(Property Interest)。如果她不能证明这一点，宪法的正当程序条款就不适用，案件就会被驳回。

2. 财产利益的来源 (Source of Interest)

这是一个非常关键的 MBE 考点：
宪法本身并不创造财产利益。

财产利益是由独立的法律渊源（如州法、地方法规、雇佣合同或具有约束力的员工手册）所创设和定义的。因此，原告必须证明根据州法律 (State Law)，该员工手册的条款足以构成一种“合法的权利主张” (legitimate claim of entitlement)，而不仅仅是一种单方面的期望。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A (City's Burden)： 错误。举证责任不在被告。原告必须先证明权利存在，被告才需要抗辩。
  • 选项 B (Good Cause)： 错误。这是实体问题。只有当原告先证明她拥有“非经正当理由不得解雇” (For-cause) 的财产权利后，政府才需要证明解雇是有正当理由的。
  • 选项 C (Reasonable Belief)： 错误。主观的“相信”或“愿望”不足以构成财产利益。必须是基于法律或规则的相互理解 (Mutual understanding)。
📚 经典判例 (Key Precedents)

Board of Regents v. Roth (1972): 确立了财产利益必须基于“合法的权利主张”，而非抽象的需求或单方面的期望。

Cleveland Bd. of Educ. v. Loudermill (1985): 一旦州法律确立了财产权利（如规定只能因正当理由解雇），宪法即要求在剥夺该权利前提供最低限度的程序（通知 + 听证机会）。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

看到“政府雇员被解雇” + “Due Process” 的题目：

  1. 先看雇佣性质：是 At-will (随意雇佣) 还是 For-cause (正当理由)？
  2. 如果是 At-will，通常没有财产利益，没有听证权。
  3. 如果是 For-cause（或手册创造了这种预期），则有财产利益。
  4. 陷阱警示：题目中的手册使用了 "encouraged" (鼓励) 和 "where feasible" (可行时) 这种软性词汇。这使得原告很难证明这构成了有约束力的合同（财产利益）。但这正是为什么选项 D 正确的原因——她必须去证明这一点，否则她就输了。

questions.question:
A state enacted a statute providing for the closure of the official state records of arrest and prosecution of all persons acquitted of a crime by a court or against whom criminal charges were filed and subsequently dropped or dismissed. The purpose of this statute is to protect these persons from further publicity or embarrassment relating to those state proceedings. However, this statute does not prohibit the publication of such information that is in the possession of private persons.
A prominent businessman in the state was arrested and charged with rape. Prior to trial, the prosecutor announced that new information indicated that the charges should be dropped. He then dropped the charges without further explanation, and the records relating thereto were closed to the public pursuant to the state statute. A newspaper in the state conducted an investigation to determine why the businessman was not prosecuted but was refused access to the closed official state records.
In an effort to determine whether the law enforcement agencies involved were properly doing their duty, the newspaper filed suit against appropriate state officials to force opening of the records and to invalidate the statute on constitutional grounds.
Which of the following would be most helpful to the state in defending the constitutionality of this statute?

choices.a: The argument that the rights of the press are no greater than those of citizens generally.
choices.b: The argument that the state may seal official records owned by the state on any basis its legislature chooses.
choices.c: The fact that the statute only prohibits public access to these official state records and does not prohibit the publication of information they contain that is in the possession of private persons.
choices.d: The fact that the statute treats in an identical manner the arrest and prosecution records of all persons who have been acquitted of a crime by a court or against whom criminal charges were filed and subsequently dropped or dismissed.

However, this statute does not prohibit the publication of such information that is in the possession of private persons.

He then dropped the charges without further explanation, and the records relating thereto were closed to the public pursuant to the state statute. Which of the following would be most helpful to the state in defending the constitutionality of this statute?

某一州颁布了一项法规，规定封存所有被法院宣告无罪，或被提起刑事指控但随后被撤销或驳回的人的官方逮捕和起诉记录。该法规的目的是保护这些人免受与这些州级诉讼程序相关的进一步宣传或尴尬。然而，该法规并不禁止公布私人持有的此类信息。

该州一位知名商人因强奸罪被逮捕和起诉。在审判前，检察官宣布新信息表明应撤销指控。随后，他在没有进一步解释的情况下撤销了指控，相关记录根据州法规对公众关闭。该州一家报纸进行了一项调查，以确定该商人为何未被起诉，但其查阅已封存的官方州记录的请求被拒绝。

为了确定相关执法机构是否正当履行其职责，该报纸对相应的州政府官员提起诉讼，要求强制公开记录，并以违宪为由宣告该法规无效。

以下哪一项最有助于州政府为该法规的合宪性进行辩护？
options:
A. The argument that the rights of the press are no greater than those of citizens generally.
主张新闻界的权利不大于普通公民的权利。

B. The argument that the state may seal official records owned by the state on any basis its legislature chooses.
主张州政府可以根据其立法机构选择的任何基础，封存其拥有的官方记录。

C. The fact that the statute only prohibits public access to these official state records and does not prohibit the publication of information they contain that is in the possession of private persons.
该法规仅禁止公众查阅这些官方州记录，但并不禁止公布私人持有的、这些记录中所包含的信息这一事实。

D. The fact that the statute treats in an identical manner the arrest and prosecution records of all persons who have been acquitted of a crime by a court or against whom criminal charges were filed and subsequently dropped or dismissed.
该法规以相同方式对待所有被法院宣告无罪，或被提起刑事指控但随后被撤销或驳回的人的逮捕和起诉记录这一事实。
data.explanation:
There is no constitutional right to access government information. Therefore, the government can deny the public (and media) access to official state records. But since there is a First Amendment right to publish truthful information, any government restriction on this right is unconstitutional unless it survives strict scrutiny - ie, the government proves that the restriction is necessary to achieve a compelling government interest. Therefore, the fact that the statute only prohibits public access to state records and does not prohibit the publication of information they contain would help the state defend the statute's constitutionality.

(Choice A) The argument that the press has no greater rights than citizens generally, while true, merely shows that the same standard applies to claims by the press and ordinary citizens. But it does not explain why the newspaper's claim will fail.

(Choice B) A state may seal its official records on any legal or constitutional basis - not any basis that its legislature chooses.

(Choice D) The fact that the statute treats the records of all persons charged with, but not convicted of, a crime identically shows that the statute complies with the Fourteenth Amendment equal protection clause. But this fact will not help the state because it does not address the First Amendment issue - accessing and publishing those records.

Educational objective: Although there is no right to access government information, there is a First Amendment right to publish truthful information. As a result, any government restriction on this right is unconstitutional unless it survives strict scrutiny.



选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 5%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

宪法没有规定查阅政府信息的权利。因此，政府可以拒绝公众（及媒体）查阅官方州记录。但由于《第一修正案》(First Amendment) 规定了公布真实信息的权利，任何对该权利的政府限制都是违宪的，除非其能通过严格审查——即政府证明该限制对于实现紧迫的政府利益是必要的。因此，该法规仅禁止公众查阅州记录，而不禁止公布其所含信息这一事实，将有助于州政府为该法规的合宪性进行辩护。

(选项A) 主张新闻界的权利不大于普通公民的权利，虽然正确，但仅表明相同的标准适用于新闻界和普通公民的主张。但这并不能解释为何该报纸的主张会失败。

(选项B) 州政府可以基于任何合法或合宪的基础封存其官方记录——而不是其立法机构选择的任何基础。

(选项D) 该法规以相同方式对待所有被指控但未被定罪的人的记录，这一事实表明该法规符合《第十四修正案》(Fourteenth Amendment) 的平等保护条款。但这一事实对州政府没有帮助，因为它没有解决《第一修正案》(First Amendment) 中关于查阅和公布这些记录的问题。

教学目标：尽管没有查阅政府信息的权利，但《第一修正案》(First Amendment) 规定了公布真实信息的权利。因此，任何对该权利的政府限制都是违宪的，除非其能通过严格审查。

References

  • U.S. Const. amend. I (free press).
  • Houchins v. KQED, Inc., 438 U.S. 1, 14 - 15 (1978) (holding that there is no constitutional right to access government information).

MBE 考点解析

Constitutional Law / First Amendment
正确答案：C
该法规仅禁止公众查阅官方记录，但不禁止公布从其他渠道获得的私人信息。
⚖️ 核心法律逻辑

这道题考察的是美国宪法第一修正案中关于“获取信息的权利” (Right of Access) 与“发布信息的权利” (Right to Publish) 之间的关键区别。

为了证明该法规的合宪性，州政府需要证明它并没有侵犯第一修正案的核心保护范围。选项 C 最有力地指出了这一点：

1. 没有普遍的“查阅权” 最高法院在 Houchins v. KQED, Inc. 等判例中确立，媒体并没有比普通公众更大的宪法权利去查阅政府信息。如果政府决定封存某些记录（特别是为了保护隐私），只要程序合法，通常不违反宪法。
2. 区分“查阅”与“发布” 如果法规禁止报纸发布它们已经获得的真实信息（例如从私人侦探或知情人士处获得），那将构成“事前限制” (Prior Restraint)，通常是违宪的，需要通过极严格的审查 (Strict Scrutiny)。

然而，本案中的法规仅仅是关闭了政府的文件柜（拒绝查阅），并没有禁止报纸发布它们通过其他手段挖掘到的信息。这使得该法规更容易通过宪法审查。
❌ 为什么其他选项不是最佳辩护？
选项 A (媒体权利=公民权利): 虽然这是一个正确的法律陈述，但它只是一个前提，并没有直接解释为什么这个特定的封存法规是合法的。它没有触及案件的核心——即政府拒绝提供信息的权力范围。
选项 B (州可以任意封存): 这个说法太绝对了。州政府不能基于“任何”理由封存记录（例如，不能基于种族歧视或掩盖政府非法行为的恶意）。这种说法在法律上站不住脚。
选项 D (平等待遇): 这主要涉及第十四修正案的平等保护条款 (Equal Protection Clause)。虽然这证明了法规没有歧视特定人群，但报纸起诉的理由是基于第一修正案（言论/新闻自由）。因此，平等保护的论据无法回应新闻自由的挑战。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在处理涉及媒体 (Press) 和政府记录 (Government Records) 的题目时，请记住以下公式：

  • 禁止发布真实信息 = 几乎总是违宪 (Strict Scrutiny)。
  • 拒绝提供政府信息 = 通常合宪 (No general right of access)。

如果题目问什么能帮助政府辩护，请寻找强调“仅限制查阅，不限制发布”的选项。
